description:
**Job Title:**
Manager – Direct Tax Litigation
  
  
**Job Location:**
Chennai
  
  
**Work Model:**
Work from Office
  
  
**Candidate Expectations**
**Total Experience:**
7+ Years
  
  
**Relevant Experience:**
7+ Years in Direct Tax Litigation and Compliance.
  
  
**Candidate Location:**
As per the designated job location.
  
  
**Mandatory Skills**
Direct Tax Litigation and Dispute Resolution.
  
  
Income Tax Assessments, Scrutiny and Appeals.
  
  
Tax Audit Defence and Representation before Tax Authorities.
  
  
Indian Income Tax Act, 1961 and Income Tax Act, 2025.
  
  
Transfer Pricing and Tax Compliance.
  
  
Experience handling proceedings before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).
  
  
**Diversity:**
Any
  
  
**Education and Certification**
**Mandatory Qualification**
Chartered Accountant (CA) or Bachelor of Laws (LLB) from a recognized university.
  
  
**Good To Have**
Exposure to Ind AS / IFRS and their tax implications.
  
  
**Specific Remarks**
Qualification must be from a recognized institution.
  
  
**Detailed Job Description**
The Manager – Direct Tax Litigation will be responsible for managing direct tax matters, litigation, disputes and compliance requirements relating to Indian operations. The role involves providing strategic tax advisory, defending tax positions before administrative and judicial authorities, and ensuring compliance with applicable Indian direct tax legislation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Direct Tax Litigation & Dispute Management**
Act as the primary in-house resource for direct tax matters and manage interactions with Income Tax Department officials during assessments, scrutiny and appeals.
  
  
Represent the organization in tax disputes and proceedings before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals).
  
  
Manage tax audit defence, statutory notices and responses to information requests from tax authorities.
  
  
Develop appropriate strategies for defending complex tax positions and resolving disputes.
  
  
**Direct Tax Compliance & Advisory**
Develop and implement direct tax compliance strategies aligned with business objectives and organizational risk appetite.
  
  
Provide strategic tax advice on business decisions, corporate transactions and their direct tax implications.
  
  
Prepare tax position papers, legal opinions, submissions and responses to tax authorities.
  
  
Monitor changes in direct tax legislation, applicable rules and judicial precedents.
  
  
**Transfer Pricing & International Taxation**
Advise on transfer pricing policies, documentation and tax implications of intercompany transactions.
  
  
Oversee Advance Pricing Agreements (APAs) and ensure compliance with the arm's length principle.
  
  
Support cross-border taxation matters and international tax treaty requirements.
  
  
Coordinate with internal tax teams and external legal counsel on complex domestic and international tax matters.
  
  
**Stakeholder & Team Management**
Collaborate with finance, business and operations teams on direct tax matters.
  
  
Coordinate with external consultants, legal counsel and internal tax stakeholders.
  
  
Guide and mentor junior legal and tax professionals.
  
  
Ensure timely resolution of tax disputes and compliance-related matters.
  
  
**Key Skills**
**Mandatory Key Skills:**
Direct Tax Litigation and Dispute Resolution.
  
  
Indian Income Tax Act, 1961 and Income Tax Act, 2025.
  
  
Tax Assessments, Scrutiny and Appeals.
  
  
Income Tax Audit Defence.
  
  
Representation before Income Tax Authorities.
  
  
Transfer Pricing and Tax Compliance.
  
  
Legal Opinions, Tax Submissions and Position Papers.
  
  
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  
  
**Good To Have Skills**
Advance Pricing Agreements (APA).
  
  
Cross-Border Taxation and International Tax Treaties.
  
  
Ind AS / IFRS.
  
  
In-house MNC or large corporate experience.
  
  
Microsoft Excel and Word.
  
  
Stakeholder and external counsel management.
  
  
**Other Specific Remarks**
Prior experience in an in-house corporate/MNC environment or Big 4 firm is mandatory.
  
  
Demonstrated experience in successfully defending complex direct tax positions and managing litigation matters.
  
  
Exposure to international taxation and cross-border transactions will be preferred.
  
  
Strong ownership, independent decision-making and stakeholder management capabilities are expected.

* Maintain advanced proficiency in contract lifecycle management and business systems, including SalesHub, and Costpoint.

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to conduct initial contract negotiations with clients and procurement representatives.
* Organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to work independently while exercising sound judgment regarding escalation of legal, commercial, and compliance issues.

title: Legal Analyst - Venture Capital
description:
**About VCMint**

VCMint is a venture capital firm and family office (AVNM) that invests its own capital in India, the US, Singapore and other markets. We invest across asset classes, but most of our work is in VC and PE:

* Direct investments in early and growth-stage startups, including follow-ons and SPVs
* LP commitments to VC/PE funds
* Pre-IPO and secondary deals
* Companies we own and operate

We have 75+ companies in the portfolio and a small team. You will work directly with the CIO and partners on live deals.

**The Role**

The role starts on the legal side. Over time it grows into a full investment role covering deal evaluation, portfolio management and fund allocation. How quickly that happens depends on you.

**Legal Responsibilities**

* Review and negotiate term sheets, SHAs, SSAs, convertible notes and SPV documents
* Track investor rights across the portfolio: anti-dilution, ROFR, tag/drag, information rights
* Manage closings, including CP/CS checklists, board and shareholder resolutions, share allotment and fund transfers
* Handle FEMA, ODI/FDI and RBI filings for cross-border investments
* Work with company secretaries on ongoing compliance
* Review fund documents (PPMs, LPAs, side letters) when we evaluate external managers
* Draft documents for acquisitions, earn-outs and debt-to-equity conversions
* Maintain the legal repository and a tracker of rights, obligations and deadlines
* Brief and manage external counsel
* Act as point of contact for all external diligence firms and other agencies

**As the role grows**

* Source and screen new opportunities, and take first calls with founders
* Run diligence on business, market, financials and legal, and write the investment memo
* Build return, valuation and fee models, and present your recommendation to the investment committee
* Structure and negotiate deals with founders and co-investors
* Track portfolio companies, flag issues early and prepare monthly portfolio reviews
* Support follow-on decisions, fundraises and exits across the portfolio
* Take board-level responsibility at companies we own
* Evaluate external fund managers and help shape the family office's allocation and liquidity plans

**Must have**

* Strong, hands-on use of AI tools for research, drafting, document review and analysis, and the judgment to check their output
* Ability to break down a messy problem and explain it clearly, whether to a founder, a lawyer or a partner
* 1–4 years of work experience
* Working knowledge of Indian company law, FEMA and SEBI regulations
* Comfortable with numbers and Excel
* Clear, concise writing. You should be able to summarise a 60-page SHA in one page
* Discretion with confidential information

**Nice to have**

* Experience at a law firm, in-house legal team or VC/PE fund, especially on corporate, M&A or venture deals
* Familiarity with US or Singapore structures
* LLB, CS or CFA (any level)

**What we offer**

* Involvement in every deal, from first call to closing
* Mentorship from the CIO and partners, who have built and exited companies and invested at institutional VC funds
* A clear path from legal into investments
* Competitive pay based on experience

In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**
You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
  
  

* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.
* Technology and innovation: Proficient in leveraging technology such as data analytics, automation, and AI in project delivery. Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and core business systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficient across the Microsoft Office suite (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel and Word). Ability to develop dashboards across key data visualization tools and produce visual reports to track key risks and control metrics, noted as desirable but not essential.
* Professional attributes: Self-stater with a proactive mindset, natural curiosity and commitment to delivering excellence for our clients. Ability to work in areas of uncertainty and navigate ambiguous situations, adaptable and inclusive, with strong self-awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams. Up to date with industry trends, emerging risks, and the UK regulatory landscape. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Other desirable skills and experience: Professional experience, skills and knowledge in the following areas is desirable but not essential; finance transformation, controls automation, programme assurance, IT control including analysing core systems (e.g., SAP and Oracle) to identify control weaknesses

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Significant managerial and professional experience in risk, process and controls services in a consulting, industry or public sector setting.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US), ACCA (UK) or MBA with 5-10 years of experience with a large global corporate Process, Risk and Control and/or similar experience
* Experience on the following Process and Control / SOX areas:

+ Governance, controls and regulation
+ Governance, Risk & Compliance
+ Process and Control
+ Process reviews
+ Standard Operating Procedures
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Revenue Assurance
+ SOX
+ Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
+ Design and Implementation testing
+ Process walkthroughs and testing effectiveness of controls

* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Strong sales, presentation and client management skills
* Strong training and mentoring skills
* Ability to manage a team and to establish credibility as a trusted advisor with clients
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex information in a concise and clear manner
* Strong executive presence and ability to interface with all levels of management (EY and clients)
* Strong project management and organizational experience
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**What we look for:**
We are interested to hear from entrepreneurial people who feed on the energy of a thriving global team. We seek a high level of drive, commitment to achieving solutions, and ability to work under pressure. We need people worthy of trust, who demonstrate enthusiasm, passion to grow fast and are highly motivated to support this purpose.
  
  
We invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. If you want to know more about our people and our culture, search #EyCulture on LinkedIn.
  
  
**What we offer:**
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
  
  
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next, including having the opportunity to gain an EY Tech MBA which is an accredited MBA program offered to all EY professionals globally
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:

This role goes beyond traditional legal support—you will enable growth by building scalable legal processes, ensuring regulatory compliance, and driving risk-aware decision-making in a fast-paced, D2C/startup environment.

**Responsibilities:**

**Legal – Commercial & Contracts**

* Draft, review, vet and negotiate commercial agreements, including marketplace and quick-commerce agreements, distributor/super-stockist agreements, contract manufacturing and supply agreements, retail (MT/EBO) agreements, salon and B2B tie-ups, influencer and celebrity endorsement agreements, agency/vendor contracts, NDAs, leases and service agreements.
* Build and maintain standard contract templates, a clause library and a contract approval matrix.
* Maintain a central contract repository with tracking of renewals, expiry and key obligations.
* Advise business teams (Marketing, Offline Sales, Marketplace, Supply Chain, HR) on legal risk in day-to-day decisions.

**Legal – Regulatory & Brand Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with regulations applicable to cosmetics and personal care, including the Drugs & Cosmetics Act and Cosmetics Rules 2020 (CDSCO), Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, BIS where applicable, the Consumer Protection Act and E-Commerce Rules, and the ASCI advertising code and influencer guidelines.
* Review product labels, packaging claims, marketing content, website and app T&Cs, and the privacy policy.
* Ensure compliance with the DPDP Act, 2023 for customer data handling across D2C and CRM platforms.

**Legal – IP, Litigation & Notices**

* Manage the trademark and copyright portfolio: filing, prosecution, oppositions, renewals and infringement and counterfeit action.
* Handle legal notices, consumer complaints and consumer forum matters, recovery suits and commercial disputes.
* Manage external counsel, including briefing, cost control and tracking case outcomes.
* Maintain a litigation tracker and provide contingent liability inputs to Finance for financial statements and audit.

**Company Secretarial & Governance**

* Oversee Companies Act, 2013 compliance: board, committee and general meetings, minutes, statutory registers and ROC filings.
* Coordinate FEMA/RBI compliance for foreign investment (FC-GPR, FC-TRS, FLA return) along with share allotments and transfers.
* Support fundraise and investor processes, including SHA/SSA review, conditions precedent and subsequent, due diligence data requests and investor rights compliance.
* Support ESOP administration on the legal and secretarial side (grants, exercise, allotment and filings).
* Work with external PCS on secretarial compliance and maintain an annual compliance calendar.

**Process & Governance**

* Build a legal compliance tracker and periodic reporting to management.
* Conduct internal training for business teams on contracts, advertising claims and data privacy.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 7–8 years of post-qualification experience in corporate legal and secretarial profile, with at least 4–5 years in-house at a consumer brand, FMCG, D2C, e-commerce or retail company.
* Hands-on experience in drafting and negotiating high-volume commercial contracts end to end.
* Working knowledge of cosmetics and consumer regulations (CDSCO, Legal Metrology, ASCI, Consumer Protection/E-Commerce Rules).
* Experience managing a trademark portfolio and counterfeit/infringement matters.
* Exposure to VC/PE-funded company environments, including fundraise documentation, investor due diligence and FEMA filings.
* Experience managing external law firms and PCS.
* Ability to work independently as a lean, single-point legal function.

Andheri, Mumbai

We are looking for an experienced compliance professional to manage and strengthen the regulatory compliance framework across our business. The role will focus on ensuring adherence to applicable SEBI regulations, managing regulatory audits and inspections, implementing compliance policies, monitoring regulatory developments, and maintaining effective governance and reporting practices.
  
  
**Expected Responsibilities**

* Regulatory Compliance: Ensure compliance with applicable SEBI regulations, guidelines, circulars, and other regulatory requirements relevant to the business, particularly those governing Research Analysts (RAs) and Investment Advisers (IAs), wherever applicable.
* Audit & Inspection Management: Coordinate regulatory audits, internal reviews, and onsite or surprise inspections. Prepare documentation, identify compliance gaps, track observations, and ensure timely closure of findings.
* Regulatory Liaison: Act as a point of contact for regulatory authorities and exchanges, managing submissions, clarifications, approvals, and periodic reporting requirements.
* Compliance Monitoring: Monitor business activities, research recommendations, investment strategies, advertisements, and customer-facing communications to ensure adherence to applicable regulatory guidelines.
* Policy & Process Development: Develop, review, and implement compliance policies, standard operating procedures, checklists, and internal controls to strengthen the compliance framework.
* Investor Grievance Management: Oversee investor complaints and grievances through applicable regulatory platforms, including SCORES, and ensure timely resolution and closure.
* Membership & Registration Compliance: Manage registration and post-registration compliance requirements, documentation, approvals, renewals, and ongoing regulatory obligations, as applicable.
* Regulatory Reporting & MIS: Prepare periodic compliance reports, management updates, audit trackers, and MIS reports highlighting key risks, observations, pending actions, and compliance status.
* Regulatory Updates: Track changes in applicable laws, regulations, and circulars, assess their business impact, and coordinate implementation of necessary changes.
* Stakeholder Management: Work closely with business, operations, technology, product, and senior management teams to embed compliance requirements into business processes and systems.
* Training & Awareness: Conduct compliance awareness sessions and provide guidance to employees on regulatory requirements, internal policies, and best practices.
* Risk Mitigation: Identify potential compliance risks, recommend corrective measures, and drive timely resolution of non-compliance issues.

**Expected Skills**

* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Commerce, Finance, Law, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Relevant professional experience in regulatory compliance within financial services, capital markets, securities markets, or a regulated fintech environment.
* Strong understanding of SEBI regulations and compliance requirements, particularly those applicable to Research Analysts and Investment Advisers, wherever relevant.
* Experience in regulatory audits, inspections, compliance monitoring, reporting, and documentation.
* Familiarity with investor grievance redressal mechanisms, regulatory submissions, and compliance MIS.
* Relevant NISM certifications will be an added advantage.
* Strong regulatory interpretation and compliance management skills.
* Excellent documentation, analytical, and reporting capabilities.
* Attention to detail and a structured approach to risk identification and resolution.
* Effective stakeholder management and cross-functional coordination.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, regulatory deadlines, and time-sensitive deliverables.
* High standards of integrity, accountability, and professional judgment.

Job Description

**Job Description: Senior Manager – Legal**

  
  

**Target Experience: 8–12 years**

**Job Summary**

As a Senior Legal professional, you will be responsible for managing and driving the legal function with a sharp focus on business enablement, compliance, and governance. This role requires an experienced legal professional with proven expertise in managing end-to-end complex contractual negotiations and closures, conducting due diligence, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements, and safeguarding the company’s interests while enabling strategic growth.

The position demands a proactive leader who can anticipate risks, balance business objectives with legal safeguards, engage effectively with senior management, regulators, investors, and law firms, and ensure the highest standards of corporate governance in a listed environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Contractual Drafting & Deal Negotiations**

* Lead the closure of complex, high-value agreements, including strategic partnerships, technology collaborations, customer/vendor contracts, and IP licensing.

* Draft, review, and negotiate contracts with a focus on practical risk mitigation, business objectives, and long-term enforceability.

* Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Sales, Procurement, Finance, Tech, R&D) to ensure business needs are achieved while safeguarding legal boundaries.

* Build contract negotiation strategies, clearly defining fallback positions, escalation mechanisms, and closure timelines.

* Maintain contract lifecycle management processes and ensure effective use of digital tools for execution and tracking.

**2. M&A Transactions & Due Diligence (DD)**

* Lead and manage end-to-end legal due diligence (DD) for target acquisitions, strategic investments, and cross-border ventures.

* Draft, vet, and review comprehensive transaction documents related to M&A transactions, Joint Ventures, fund-raises, and shareholder agreements.

**3. Cross-Border Transactions & International Engagement**

* Lead engagement with global law firms and external counsel on cross-border contracts and compliance across key global markets (US, EU, APAC).

* Drive foreign customer and vendor agreement closures, ensuring strict compliance with US laws, export controls, and international insurance frameworks.

* Oversee and navigate dispute resolution and arbitration in overseas jurisdictions where required.

**4. Litigation & Dispute Management**

* Manage disputes, arbitrations, commercial claims, and litigation matters, coordinating overarching strategy with external law firms where needed.

* Manage end-to-end civil proceedings, including drafting and reviewing pleadings, plaints, written statements, affidavits, and appeals.

* Ensure strict adherence to procedural timelines, court processes, and evidentiary requirements under applicable civil procedure codes.

* Represent the company and coordinate effectively with external counsel during court hearings, mediation, and conciliation proceedings.

* Develop and execute litigation strategies to defend the company''s interests in commercial suits, recovery proceedings, and injunction matters.

* Handle regulatory notices, inquiries, or audits with proactive strategy preparation.

* Oversee civil, criminal, and IP-related litigations, ensuring cost-efficient and business-sensitive resolutions.

**5. Regulatory & Sectoral Compliance**

* Ensure continuous compliance with Drone Rules, DGCA regulations, export control laws, Import-Export policies, insurance, and defense procurement compliances.

* Conduct legal research on various topics related to drone manufacturing, intellectual property, contract law, regulatory compliance, and various allied legislations related to the drone industry.

* Monitor global regulatory developments affecting drones and assess business impact.

* Build internal compliance frameworks, policies, and SOPs for proactive adherence to domestic and international laws.

**6. Risk & Strategic Advisory**

* Provide clear legal inputs to senior leadership on business-related matters, cybersecurity/data privacy implications, and export transactions.

* Identify and assess legal, regulatory, contractual, and reputational risks; propose actionable mitigations.

* Act as a strategic partner, not just a legal reviewer, enabling senior management to take informed business decisions confidently.

**7. Training & Awareness**

* Conduct internal training for leadership and teams on evolving industry-specific regulations, drone laws, corporate compliance, anti-bribery/anti-trust, and contract best practices.

* Build a compliance culture across functions through awareness programs and practical guidance.

  
  

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Education: LLB/LLM from a recognized institution (Company Secretary qualification is a plus).

* Experience: 7–10 years of progressive legal experience, preferably within the manufacturing, tech, aerospace, or defense industries.

* Core Competencies:

* Strong expertise in contract negotiation and closure of complex business agreements.
* Proven track record in conducting legal due diligence (DD) for M&A and corporate transactions.
* Strong litigation and law firm coordination background, particularly in civil procedure and court processes.
* In-depth knowledge of corporate, securities, and compliance laws relevant to a listed company.
* Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with CXOs, business teams, regulators, and investors.
* Environment: Proven ability to thrive in a fast-evolving, regulated, high-growth listed company environment.

**Key Traits for Success**

* Business-enabling mindset with strong negotiation and stakeholder management skills.

title: New-FAAS FO Manager
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Manager – Control & Compliance**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support. We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS, having expertise across the FAAS solutions and specifically for engagements related to Process and Control, Process compliance and reviews, SOX and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Enterprise Risk Management & Payment application.
  
  
FAAS is a dynamic group of people focused on helping our clients solving tomorrow’s problems today through integrated solution service offerings in the area of risk, such as internal control assessment, risk management and financial controls. Risk continues to move up the agenda and our team work with many of today's front-running companies. Our clients want integrated, strategic, tech-enabled, end-to-end solutions and we deliver tailored risk offerings putting client value and relationships at the core of what we do. You can expect to work with senior client personnel and drive high quality work products.
  
  
Our Risk team consists of talented colleagues who invite you to bring your natural curiosity and innovative thoughts to work each day. Working within our team, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We offer excellent career development, diverse opportunities and fantastic work life balance including hybrid working. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated manager to join our dynamic Control & Compliance team. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise in risk management, internal control assessment and implementation of internal control framework. In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**
You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
  
  

* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.
* Technology and innovation: Proficient in leveraging technology such as data analytics, automation, and AI in project delivery. Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and core business systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficient across the Microsoft Office suite (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel and Word). Ability to develop dashboards across key data visualization tools and produce visual reports to track key risks and control metrics, noted as desirable but not essential.
* Professional attributes: Self-stater with a proactive mindset, natural curiosity and commitment to delivering excellence for our clients. Ability to work in areas of uncertainty and navigate ambiguous situations, adaptable and inclusive, with strong self-awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams. Up to date with industry trends, emerging risks, and the UK regulatory landscape. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Other desirable skills and experience: Professional experience, skills and knowledge in the following areas is desirable but not essential; finance transformation, controls automation, programme assurance, IT control including analysing core systems (e.g., SAP and Oracle) to identify control weaknesses

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Significant managerial and professional experience in risk, process and controls services in a consulting, industry or public sector setting.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US), ACCA (UK) or MBA with 5-10 years of experience with a large global corporate Process, Risk and Control and/or similar experience
* Experience on the following Process and Control / SOX areas:

+ Governance, controls and regulation
+ Governance, Risk & Compliance
+ Process and Control
+ Process reviews
+ Standard Operating Procedures
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Revenue Assurance
+ SOX
+ Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
+ Design and Implementation testing
+ Process walkthroughs and testing effectiveness of controls

* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Strong sales, presentation and client management skills
* Strong training and mentoring skills
* Ability to manage a team and to establish credibility as a trusted advisor with clients
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex information in a concise and clear manner
* Strong executive presence and ability to interface with all levels of management (EY and clients)
* Strong project management and organizational experience
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**What we look for:**
We are interested to hear from entrepreneurial people who feed on the energy of a thriving global team. We seek a high level of drive, commitment to achieving solutions, and ability to work under pressure. We need people worthy of trust, who demonstrate enthusiasm, passion to grow fast and are highly motivated to support this purpose.
  
  
We invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. If you want to know more about our people and our culture, search #EyCulture on LinkedIn.
  
  
**What we offer:**
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
  
  
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next, including having the opportunity to gain an EY Tech MBA which is an accredited MBA program offered to all EY professionals globally
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

description:
**About S&A Law Offices**

S&A Law Offices is a full-service law firm headquartered in Delhi NCR. The firm has 300+ professionals, including experienced lawyers (with advocacy expertise and dual qualified professionals), chartered accountants, company secretaries, patent and trademark agents, engineers, industry experts, and specialized paralegal staff. S&A practice groups have been broadly divided into the following practice groups: Alternate Dispute Resolution (ADR), Litigation, Corporate and M&A, Restructuring and Insolvency, Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), Taxation (Direct and Indirect), Customs & Trade, Real Estate and Energy.

Role Summary

The Secretary provides comprehensive administrative, documentation, and matter management support to lawyers and legal teams. The role is responsible for the accurate preparation, formatting, filing, and maintenance of legal documents, correspondence, court papers, and records while ensuring efficient coordination of schedules, communications, and filing requirements. The position requires exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, confidentiality, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced legal environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

Legal Documentation & Matter Support

* Prepare, format, proofread, and manage legal documents, correspondence, agreements, pleadings, affidavits, opinions, reports, and presentations.
* Incorporate revisions, mark-ups, and redlines while ensuring compliance with firm formatting standards.
* Maintain matter files, document repositories, and records in both physical and electronic formats.
* Assist in the preparation of transaction documents, hearing bundles, court briefs, and closing sets.

Administrative & Communication Support

* Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence, emails, courier dispatches, and document distribution.
* Coordinate meetings, conference calls, and appointments for lawyers and practice teams.
* Track key deadlines, hearing dates, filing schedules, and other critical milestones.
* Handle telephone calls, take messages, and facilitate communication between clients, courts, counsels, and internal teams.

Court & Regulatory Filing Support

* Coordinate the preparation, indexing, pagination, and submission of court filings, applications, pleadings, and supporting documents.
* Monitor cause lists, hearing schedules, and filing deadlines.
* Liaise with court clerks, filing teams, process servers, and regulatory authorities to ensure timely filings and compliance.
* Assist with regulatory and e-filings, where applicable.

Records Management & Compliance

* Ensure proper maintenance, storage, retrieval, and archiving of legal records and matter-related documentation.
* Adhere to firm policies on confidentiality, information security, and data protection.
* Handle sensitive client and firm information with the highest level of discretion and professionalism.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Graduate in any discipline.
* 2-5 years of relevant experience in a law firm, legal department, or professional services environment.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint).
* Familiarity with legal documentation, court procedures, document management systems, and e-filing platforms will be an advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Excellent typing, formatting, and proofreading skills.
* Strong organizational and record management abilities.
* Attention to detail and accuracy.
* Effective verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Professionalism, discretion, and confidentiality.
* Flexibility to support urgent filings, hearings, and transaction-related requirements.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹56,000.00 per month

**Job Summary**
We are looking for an Enterprise IT Privacy Advisor to join our growing Data Privacy Team. In this role, you will be the primary custodian of privacy and GDPR compliance across our internal IT environments. You will safeguard our information assets by embedding Privacy-by-Design principles into our tools and workflows, managing risk, and maintaining alignment with global privacy laws, standards, and corporate regulations.

* Privacy Leadership: Provide strategic direction and guidance on all GDPR and privacy-related matters within Enterprise IT.

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Law, or equivalent practical experience.
* Core Privacy Experience: Minimum of 5+ years of dedicated, hands-on experience managing Data Privacy and GDPR compliance frameworks.

* Domain Expertise: Strong mastery of GDPR, Privacy-by-Design, Data Inventory/Mapping, and Data Governance, with a solid supporting knowledge of information security standards (ISO 27001, ISO 27701, ISO 27018, ISO/IEC 42001).

* Multidisciplinary Approach: Ability to evaluate and discuss Privacy/GDPR requirements across legal, risk, operational, and technical spectrums.

title: New-FAAS FO Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS – Assurance FAAS – Manager – Control & Compliance**
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provides advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support. We are looking for a professional to join EY FAAS, having expertise across the FAAS solutions and specifically for engagements related to Process and Control, Process compliance and reviews, SOX and, Developing Standard Operating Procedure manuals, Enterprise Risk Management & Payment application.
  
  
FAAS is a dynamic group of people focused on helping our clients solving tomorrow’s problems today through integrated solution service offerings in the area of risk, such as internal control assessment, risk management and financial controls. Risk continues to move up the agenda and our team work with many of today's front-running companies. Our clients want integrated, strategic, tech-enabled, end-to-end solutions and we deliver tailored risk offerings putting client value and relationships at the core of what we do. You can expect to work with senior client personnel and drive high quality work products.
  
  
Our Risk team consists of talented colleagues who invite you to bring your natural curiosity and innovative thoughts to work each day. Working within our team, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. We offer excellent career development, diverse opportunities and fantastic work life balance including hybrid working. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated manager to join our dynamic Control & Compliance team. The ideal candidate will bring technical expertise in risk management, internal control assessment and implementation of internal control framework. In this role, you will lead the delivery of high-quality outcomes across a portfolio of clients in the internal audit and internal controls space. You will manage multiple engagement teams and stakeholders, both internally and externally, taking full ownership of projects and relationships. Your focus will be on delivering impactful results, on time, within budget and in line with EY’s quality and risk management practices. Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Client Delivery and Project Management: Lead and manage multiple client engagements. Oversee planning, fieldwork and reporting of findings and recommendations to senior stakeholders. Ensuring high-quality deliverables, on time within budget.
* Technical Expertise: Act as a key trusted advisor in discussing complex regulations with clients, including UK Corporate Reform, US Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance, Global Internal Audit Standards and other industry-specific regulatory compliance requirements.
* Quality and Risk Management: Ensure compliance with EY’s quality and risk management processes across client acceptance, contracting and engagement delivery. Proactively identify and manage risks across engagements, escalating issues where appropriate.
* Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and proactively manage client expectations to ensure alignment on project goals, timelines and deliverables. Collaborate cross-functionally with other EY service lines and subject matter experts to deliver high quality insights. Collaborate with internal leader/s, provide regular updates on engagement progress and support internal decision-making through clear communication and proactive escalation and the ability to flex communication styles.
* Team Leadership and Development: Mentor and coach junior team members through effective supervision to develop their technical and professional skills. Support career development through performance reviews and providing timely, regular and actionable feedback. You will contribute to a positive team environment by demonstrating consistent commitment and optimism toward work challenges.
* Business Development: Build the EY brand through high quality delivery. Support in the identification of new opportunities and development of proposals. Build EY’s market presence through contribution to thought leadership and client events.
* Promoting EY’s values: Champion EY’s commitments to integrity, respect and teaming in all client and internal interactions. Foster an inclusive and diverse working environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute.
* Practice development: contribute to practice development and internal initiatives such as learning and development programmes and solution development.

**Skills And Experience**
You will be a trusted manager with proven technical expertise in risk, control and compliance that will complement our teams in delivering high-quality solutions to our clients. Your skills and experience will include:
  
  

* Control & Compliance experience: Proven and relevant professional experience across core process and controls solutions (e.g. internal audit, SOX and internal controls) in consulting, government or industry. Extensive experience in process mapping, walkthroughs, risk analysis (strategic, financial, operational and compliance) and control identification and design assessment. The ability to act as a trusted advisor to clients on risk and control issues, such as controls remediation or Enterprise Risk Management.
* Technical skills and knowledge: In depth understanding of core business processes, associated risks, and leading practice controls. Strong leadership and communication skills, technical knowledge, and the ability to write at a publication quality level in order to communicate findings and recommendations to clients. Strong business acumen, including the ability to compile information quickly and accurately, and to test data and assumptions for informed decision-making.
* Engagement management: Track record demonstrating success in leading high-performing teams, mentor junior staff and foster a culture of continuous learning. Experienced in managing complex project and multiple stakeholder groups including senior clients and internal leadership. Demonstrated ability to balance project management and delivery skills across a range of clients, including financial management, quality, and risk management requirements.
* Communication and interpersonal skills: Strong communication (written and verbal) and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels. Being an active listener, having self-awareness when dealing with others, and adapting your own approach to differences in individual style and backgrounds, recognising the risk of unconscious biases.
* Client delivery: Demonstrated success in delivering high-quality, client-focused solutions on time and within budget with a commitment to going above and beyond for clients.
* Commercial acumen: Commercially aware, with a track record of developing relevant propositions and sales collateral and supporting business development efforts.
* Technology and innovation: Proficient in leveraging technology such as data analytics, automation, and AI in project delivery. Experience with data visualisation tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) and core business systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle). Proficient across the Microsoft Office suite (e.g. PowerPoint, Excel and Word). Ability to develop dashboards across key data visualization tools and produce visual reports to track key risks and control metrics, noted as desirable but not essential.
* Professional attributes: Self-stater with a proactive mindset, natural curiosity and commitment to delivering excellence for our clients. Ability to work in areas of uncertainty and navigate ambiguous situations, adaptable and inclusive, with strong self-awareness and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams. Up to date with industry trends, emerging risks, and the UK regulatory landscape. Adaptability and the ability to work effectively across diverse teams.
* Other desirable skills and experience: Professional experience, skills and knowledge in the following areas is desirable but not essential; finance transformation, controls automation, programme assurance, IT control including analysing core systems (e.g., SAP and Oracle) to identify control weaknesses

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Significant managerial and professional experience in risk, process and controls services in a consulting, industry or public sector setting.
* Chartered Accountant (CA), CPA (US), ACCA (UK) or MBA with 5-10 years of experience with a large global corporate Process, Risk and Control and/or similar experience
* Experience on the following Process and Control / SOX areas:

+ Governance, controls and regulation
+ Governance, Risk & Compliance
+ Process and Control
+ Process reviews
+ Standard Operating Procedures
+ Enterprise Risk Management
+ Revenue Assurance
+ SOX
+ Internal Control over Financial Reporting (ICFR)
+ Design and Implementation testing
+ Process walkthroughs and testing effectiveness of controls

* Strong problem solving and analytical skills
* Strong sales, presentation and client management skills
* Strong training and mentoring skills
* Ability to manage a team and to establish credibility as a trusted advisor with clients
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to present complex information in a concise and clear manner
* Strong executive presence and ability to interface with all levels of management (EY and clients)
* Strong project management and organizational experience
* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 50% to 80% of the time

**What we look for:**
We are interested to hear from entrepreneurial people who feed on the energy of a thriving global team. We seek a high level of drive, commitment to achieving solutions, and ability to work under pressure. We need people worthy of trust, who demonstrate enthusiasm, passion to grow fast and are highly motivated to support this purpose.
  
  
We invite applications from all cultures, backgrounds and experiences and are proud of our culture where people from all walks of life can grow and thrive. If you want to know more about our people and our culture, search #EyCulture on LinkedIn.
  
  
**What we offer:**
EY is committed to being an inclusive employer and we are happy to consider flexible working arrangements. We strive to achieve the right balance for our people, enabling us to deliver excellent client service whilst allowing you to build your career without sacrificing your personal priorities. While our client-facing professionals can be required to travel regularly, and at times be based at client sites, our flexible working arrangements can help you to achieve a lifestyle balance.
  
  
We offer a competitive remuneration package. Our comprehensive Total Rewards package includes support for flexible working and career development, and with FlexEY you can select benefits that suit your needs, covering holidays, health and well-being, insurance, savings and a wide range of discounts, offers and promotions. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next, including having the opportunity to gain an EY Tech MBA which is an accredited MBA program offered to all EY professionals globally
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Export Sales Manager
description:
Company Description Jyoti CNC Automation Ltd., founded in 1989 with a vision to become a Temple of Technology, has grown into one of the largest multinational CNC machine tool manufacturers. The company evolved from producing gear boxes to designing precision all-geared head lathe machines and then advanced CNC solutions. As the first CNC machine manufacturer in Gujarat, Jyoti has consistently pioneered new technologies and product innovations. Its extensive product portfolio includes CNC Turning Centers, Turn Mill Centers, Vertical and Horizontal Machining Centers, Vertical Line Machines, and advanced 3-axis and 5-axis machining centers. Jyoti offers a technology-driven environment with strong emphasis on innovation, engineering excellence, and global market expansion. 
 Job Description: 
 Position: Assistant Manager/Area Manager – Export Sales Territories: Middle East Countries & Southeast Asia Industry: Machine Tools / CNC Machinery / Industrial Manufacturing Experience: 6+ Years Department: International Sales / Export Sales Qualification: Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related technical discipline; MBA in International Business or Marketing will be an added advantage. 
 1. Job Purpose 
 To drive export sales growth and expand the company's market presence across the UAE, Africa, and Southeast Asia by developing new markets, strengthening distributor networks, managing key accounts, and achieving regional sales targets for CNC machines and machine tools. 
 2. Key Responsibilities 
 A. International Sales & Business Development Develop and execute export sales strategies to achieve business growth across the assigned territories. Identify new business opportunities, potential customers, distributors, dealers, and channel partners in international markets. Promote and sell CNC machines, machine tools, and related industrial solutions to customers across various manufacturing sectors. Generate new business leads through market research, customer visits, exhibitions, and industry networking. Develop and maintain strong relationships with existing customers and strategic accounts. 
 B. Distributor & Channel Management Appoint, develop, and manage distributors, dealers, and sales representatives across assigned regions. Establish and strengthen distribution networks to improve market penetration and customer reach. Monitor distributor performance, sales targets, market coverage, and customer satisfaction. Conduct regular business reviews and provide product training and sales support to channel partners. 
 C. Market Development & Competition Analysis Conduct market research to identify emerging business opportunities, customer requirements, and industry trends. Analyse competitor activities, product positioning, pricing strategies, and market share. Develop region-specific sales plans to increase market presence and achieve revenue targets. Identify potential applications and customer segments across automotive, aerospace, general engineering, die and mould, and other manufacturing industries. 
 D. Customer Relationship & Key Account Management Build and maintain long-term relationships with key customers, distributors, and industrial clients. Understand customer technical requirements and coordinate with application engineering and technical teams to propose suitable machine solutions. Lead commercial negotiations, prepare quotations, and follow up on sales enquiries and orders. Ensure timely resolution of customer queries and coordinate with service and application teams to maintain customer satisfaction. 
 E. Export Operations & Commercial Coordination Coordinate with internal teams for export documentation, order processing, shipment planning, and delivery schedules. Work closely with logistics, finance, production, and supply chain teams to ensure smooth execution of export orders. Handle commercial terms, payment conditions, letters of credit, and other export-related requirements in coordination with the relevant departments. Ensure compliance with applicable export regulations, customs requirements, and international trade procedures. 
 F. Sales Planning & Performance Management Prepare annual and quarterly sales plans, budgets, forecasts, and territory-wise business development strategies. Achieve assigned sales targets, order bookings, revenue goals, and market development objectives. Maintain sales pipelines, prepare periodic MIS reports, and provide updates on business performance and market opportunities. Monitor order execution and coordinate with relevant teams to support timely customer deliveries and payments/ 
 G. International Travel Undertake international travel across the Middle East Countries, and Southeast Asia for customer meetings, distributor development, market visits, exhibitions, and business negotiations. Represent the company at international trade fairs, industrial exhibitions, and customer events. 
 3. Required Skills & Competencies Strong experience in international sales and export business development. Good understanding of CNC machines, machine tools, and industrial manufacturing applications. Proven capabilities in distributor development, channel management, and international market expansion. Strong negotiation, presentation, communication, and relationship management skills. Knowledge of export documentation, international logistics, Incoterms, and export payment mechanisms. Ability to independently manage international territories and achieve sales targets. Strong analytical, commercial, and strategic planning capabilities. Willingness to travel internationally as per business requirements. 
 4. Educational & Experience Requirements Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related technical field. Minimum 7+ years of experience in export sales, preferably within the machine tool, CNC machinery, or industrial equipment industry. Experience handling international markets, particularly the Middle East GCC, and Southeast Asia, will be preferred. Experience managing distributors, international customers, and export sales operations is essential. Candidates with a proven track record of achieving export sales targets and developing new markets will be preferred. 
 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Achievement of annual export sales and order booking targets. Growth in export revenue and profitability across assigned territories. Number of new customers and distributors developed. Expansion of market coverage and customer base. Conversion rate of enquiries into orders. Distributor productivity and sales performance. Customer satisfaction and repeat business. Sales forecast accuracy and timely collection of outstanding payments. 
 6. Desired Candidate Profile The ideal candidate should be a commercially driven sales professional with strong technical knowledge of machine tools and CNC machinery, proven international business development experience, and the ability to independently manage export markets. The candidate should demonstrate a successful track record in developing distributor networks, acquiring new customers, negotiating international deals, and driving sustainable business growth across the UAE, Africa, and Southeast Asia.

title: I.T. Systems Administrator
description:
Job Description 
 The I.T. Systems Administrator is responsible for the support, administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business-critical enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure within a complex manufacturing environment. This position requires an experienced, highly self-motivated IT professional who can work independently while collaborating effectively within a global IT organization. The successful candidate will support a diverse portfolio of ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and legacy business systems while ensuring their stability, performance, security, and long-term supportability. Working as part of the Enterprise Applications team, this role collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Network, Development, Data, Project, and Service Desk teams, as well as external software vendors and service providers. The ideal candidate is a strong technical generalist with expertise across enterprise applications, Microsoft SQL Server technologies, and supporting infrastructure platforms. The ability to independently learn unfamiliar systems and assume operational ownership of business-critical applications is essential.
 This position is fully onsite and reports remotely within a global IT organization. 
 Key Responsibilities Administer, support, monitor, and troubleshoot business-critical enterprise applications, including ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and other operational systems. Develop technical expertise and operational ownership of assigned applications and services. Proactively identify technical debt, supportability risks, and opportunities for improvement across enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure. Contribute to projects and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing technical debt, improving system stability, and modernizing legacy technologies. Troubleshoot issues across application, database, operating system, infrastructure, authentication, and integration layers. Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including clustered installations, Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) platforms, and related technologies such as SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS. Support Azure-hosted business applications, databases, and analytical solutions. Participate in application and infrastructure deployment projects and ensure operational readiness prior to go-live. Review technical documentation and ensure supported systems remain properly documented and maintainable. Work within established ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management. Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and business-critical incidents. Collect and analyze diagnostic information using tools such as PerfMon, Windows Event Viewer, SQL Server tools, Dynatrace, Spotlight, and application logs. Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation. Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues. Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems.

 Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.

 IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, SQL Server, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications Citrix certifications

Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments. Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server environments. Experience supporting ERP and business-critical enterprise applications. Experience supporting ERP solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics AX. Experience supporting Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) environments and Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS. Experience troubleshooting SQL Server performance issues and supporting clustered SQL Server environments. Experience administering Microsoft Active Directory and supporting Microsoft Hyper-V environments. Experience working within ITIL-based support processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to independently learn and support unfamiliar business systems and technologies. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Experience working with globally distributed teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to create technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, warehouse management, and other business-critical enterprise applications. Experience with Teamcenter, NX, CAD/PDM/PLM platforms, WMS, OFS, TDM, or comparable business systems is considered an asset. Experience with Azure, Citrix, Linux, Docker, or related infrastructure technologies. Experience with Dynatrace monitoring solutions. Experience troubleshooting Kerberos authentication issues. Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation. 
 Key Competencies 
 Self-motivated and highly independent. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Continuous learning mindset.

 The ideal candidate is an experienced IT professional who combines strong enterprise application support, Microsoft SQL Server administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting skills. They are comfortable working in an environment consisting of both legacy and modern systems, can independently acquire expertise in unfamiliar technologies, and take ownership of ensuring the long-term stability, performance, and supportability of business-critical applications.

Tata Communications Limited (hereinafter referred as Tata Communications) is the new name of VSNL, which as of January 28, 2008. Prior to this Tata Communications has a history of more than 135 years in handling the international telecommunications needs of the country. Tata Communications (as VSNL) was incorporated on March 19, 1986 under the Indian Companies Act, 1956 to take over the activities of the erstwhile Overseas Communication Services (OCS). In February 2002, the Government of India, as per their disinvestments plan, sold 25% of their holding in the company to the strategic partner. Consequently, the company was taken over under the administrative control of TATA. It is under the management of TATAs – India’s best known industrial house – that Tata Communications is now charting its future course. Prior to this, The Eastern Telegraph Co. (ETC) of 1872 and the Indian Radio Telegraph Co. (IRT) of 1927 merged to form the Indian Radio and Cable Communications Co. (IRCC) in 1932. The Government of India took over the IRCC, giving birth to the Overseas Communications Service (OCS), a Government Department. About Tata group The TATA group founded by Jamsetji Tata in 1868, the Tata group is a global enterprise, headquartered in India, comprising 30 companies across ten verticals. The group operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with a mission ‘To improve the quality of life of the communities we serve globally, through long-term stakeholder value creation based on Leadership with Trust’. Tata Sons is the principal investment holding company and promoter of Tata companies.
