title: IT Control Tester
description:
We are looking for Associates / Senior Associates with hands-on experience in IT Control Testing, IT Audit, Technology Risk Management or Technology Controls Assurance . 
 The candidate will be responsible for executing IT control testing activities across various technology and cybersecurity domains. The role involves performing control walkthroughs, Design Effectiveness (ToD) and Operating Effectiveness (ToE) testing, evidence validation, workpaper preparation, identifying control gaps and maintaining audit-ready documentation. 
 The ideal candidate should have practical experience in independently executing IT control testing activities and a strong understanding of IT risks, controls, testing methodologies and audit documentation. 
 Key Responsibilities Conduct IT control walkthroughs with business and technology stakeholders. Understand IT risks, control objectives, control descriptions and control activities. Perform Design Effectiveness (ToD) testing to assess whether controls are appropriately designed to mitigate identified risks. Perform Operating Effectiveness (ToE) testing to validate whether controls are operating consistently and effectively. Execute testing based on defined methodologies, testing procedures and sampling requirements. Review and validate evidence provided by control owners. Assess evidence for relevance, completeness, accuracy, sufficiency and traceability. Identify control deficiencies, exceptions and gaps during testing. Prepare and maintain audit-ready testing workpapers. Document testing procedures, evidence reviewed, test results and conclusions. Prepare and update IT process narratives and control documentation. Discuss testing observations with stakeholders and support remediation tracking. Maintain control testing trackers, status reports and testing timelines. Incorporate quality assurance and review feedback into testing documentation. 
 Technology Risk & Control Areas 
 Candidates should have hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: 
 IT General Controls (ITGC): User Access Management, Privileged Access Management, Change Management and IT Operations. Identity & Access Management: User provisioning, de-provisioning, access reviews and privileged access controls. Change Management: Change approvals, testing, implementation and segregation of duties. IT Operations: Backup and recovery, batch monitoring, incident management and job scheduling. Infrastructure Controls: Server, operating system and infrastructure security controls. Database Controls: Database access, privileged accounts and database security. Application Controls: Application access, configuration and automated controls. Cybersecurity Controls: Information security policies, vulnerability management and security monitoring. Network & Endpoint Security: Network access, firewall controls and endpoint protection. Cloud & Data Security: Cloud access management, data protection and security controls. 
 Required Skills & Qualifications 2-5 years of experience in IT Control Testing, IT Audit, Technology Risk or IT Controls Assurance. Hands-on experience in Design Effectiveness (ToD) and Operating Effectiveness (ToE) testing. Strong understanding of IT General Controls (ITGC) and technology risk concepts. Experience conducting control walkthroughs and executing testing procedures. Knowledge of control testing methodologies and sampling techniques. Ability to review, validate and assess control evidence. Experience preparing audit workpapers and documenting testing conclusions. Ability to identify control gaps, exceptions and deficiencies. Strong analytical, documentation and stakeholder management skills. Good written and verbal communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Exposure to frameworks such as COBIT, NIST, ISO 27001 and related IT control frameworks. Experience in Banking, Financial Services or other regulated industries. Exposure to multiple technology risk domains, including ITGC, Infrastructure, Application and Cybersecurity controls. Experience working with internal audit, external audit or risk assurance teams. 
 What We Are Looking For We are looking for execution-oriented IT Control Testing professionals who can independently manage the testing lifecycle: 
 Control Walkthrough Risk & Control Understanding ToD Testing ToE Testing Evidence Validation Workpaper Documentation Exception Identification Review & Closure Candidates whose experience is limited to IT operations, system administration or general IT support without hands-on control testing experience may not be suitable. 
 Work Location & Shift Requirements Strictly Work From Office. Candidates must be comfortable working from the designated office location on all working days. Shift: 5:30 PM 2:30 AM IST. Monday to Friday working schedule. Flexibility to support business requirements, if needed.

title: Electronics & Embedded Hardware R&D Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Electronics & Embedded Hardware Engineer capable of designing, developing, and building complete electronic products from scratch. 
 The ideal candidate should be able to take a product idea and independently convert it into a fully functional hardware prototype, including electronic circuit design, microcontroller programming, custom PCB development, sensor integration, communication modules, and physical product assembly. 
 We need someone who is not limited to programming Arduino or ESP32 development boards but can also design custom electronic hardware and develop production-ready prototypes. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Hardware Design & Prototyping 
 * Develop complete electronic hardware prototypes from initial concepts. * Work with Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266, STM32, Raspberry Pi, and other microcontrollers. * Design custom electronic circuits and hardware architectures. * Select appropriate chips, sensors, microcontrollers, and electronic components. * Build working prototypes using breadboards, development kits, and custom PCBs. * Design compact, low-power, and battery-operated electronic devices. 
 2. PCB & Circuit Design 
 * Design electronic schematics and multilayer PCBs. * Work with KiCad, Altium Designer, EasyEDA, or similar tools. * Design custom boards integrating microcontrollers, RF modules, sensors, and power circuits. * Prepare Gerber files, BOMs, and PCB manufacturing documentation. * Handle component soldering, SMD assembly, debugging, and board testing. * Work with PCB manufacturers to produce and validate working boards. 
 3. Embedded Firmware Development 
 * Develop firmware using Embedded C/C++, Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, and PlatformIO. * Work with FreeRTOS and embedded operating environments. * Implement I2C, SPI, UART, USB, GPIO, PWM, ADC, and other hardware interfaces. * Develop OTA firmware updates, device diagnostics, and remote configuration. * Optimize firmware for stability, power efficiency, and performance. 
 4. Wireless Communication & IoT 
 * Integrate Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, BLE, LoRa, RFID, NFC, GPS, and communication modules. * Develop long-range and short-range wireless communication prototypes. * Implement MQTT, HTTP, WebSocket, and IoT device-to-cloud connectivity. * Develop communication between electronic devices and Android/iOS applications. * Work with antennas, RF modules, and wireless communication protocols. 
 5. Chip & Custom Hardware Development 
 * Select and integrate semiconductor chips, microcontrollers, and communication ICs. * Develop custom chip-based circuit designs without relying exclusively on ready-made development boards. * Understand microcontroller architecture, power management ICs, and peripheral circuits. * Work with FPGA, Verilog/VHDL, or digital logic design where applicable. * Optimize hardware designs for miniaturization, cost, and manufacturing. 
 6. End-to-End Product Development 
 * Convert product requirements into practical electronic hardware solutions. * Create functional proof-of-concept devices. * Build physical product prototypes with suitable enclosures. * Integrate batteries, charging circuits, USB-C, and power management. * Perform circuit debugging using multimeters, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. * Conduct hardware reliability, battery, thermal, and functional testing. * Prepare prototypes for pilot manufacturing and mass production. 
 Example Projects 
 The engineer may work on products such as: 
 * ESP32-based RFID and biometric attendance systems. * Portable LoRa communication and emergency messaging devices. * Bluetooth/Wi-Fi smart electronic accessories. * IoT tracking, monitoring, and automation devices. * Custom microcontroller-based electronic products. * Battery-powered portable smart devices. * Mobile-connected electronic hardware accessories. 
 Required Skills 
 * Strong understanding of electronics, digital circuits, and embedded systems. * Hands-on experience with Arduino, ESP32, and STM32. * Practical experience in schematic design and PCB layout. * Embedded C/C++ programming. * Sensor, RFID, wireless module, and peripheral integration. * Ability to solder, assemble, test, and troubleshoot hardware. * Understanding of voltage regulation, battery management, and power optimization. * Ability to build an entire working prototype independently. * Experience preparing BOMs, production files, and technical documentation. 
 Preferred Skills 
 * FPGA development and Verilog/VHDL. * RF/antenna design and LoRa communication. * RTOS and embedded Linux. * 3D printing and enclosure prototyping. * Mobile application and cloud API integration. * Experience converting prototypes into manufacturing-ready products. * Knowledge of electronic component sourcing and PCB assembly vendors. 
 Educational Qualification 
 B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field. 
 Candidates with strong practical hardware development experience and a demonstrated portfolio are encouraged to apply regardless of formal qualifications. 
 What We Expect 
 We are specifically looking for a practical hardware developer who can: 
 1. Understand a product idea and create the hardware design. 2. Choose the required electronic components and chips. 3. Design the circuit and PCB. 4. Write and flash embedded firmware. 5. Assemble and debug the electronic hardware. 6. Build a fully functional physical prototype. 7. Improve and prepare the design for manufacturing. 
 Candidates must demonstrate previous working hardware projects. Experience limited to Arduino tutorials or simulation-only projects will not be sufficient. 
 How to Apply 
 Please share your updated resume along with examples of hardware projects, PCB designs, embedded firmware, or working prototypes you have developed. GitHub repositories, project photographs, videos, and technical portfolios are highly preferred.Role & responsibilities

ADDITIONAL STRENGTHS PCB design, CAD/3D printing, ROS, Raspberry Pi, classroom pilots, vendor coordination and product launches. AI integration is a bonus only when supported by the essential physical hardware experience. WHY THIS ROLE Own new robotics and STEM products, see your prototypes become practical learning tools, and help shape the product roadmap through market research and real customer feedback. title: I.T. Systems Administrator
description:
Job Description 
 The I.T. Systems Administrator is responsible for the support, administration, maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of business-critical enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure within a complex manufacturing environment. This position requires an experienced, highly self-motivated IT professional who can work independently while collaborating effectively within a global IT organization. The successful candidate will support a diverse portfolio of ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and legacy business systems while ensuring their stability, performance, security, and long-term supportability. Working as part of the Enterprise Applications team, this role collaborates closely with Infrastructure, Network, Development, Data, Project, and Service Desk teams, as well as external software vendors and service providers. The ideal candidate is a strong technical generalist with expertise across enterprise applications, Microsoft SQL Server technologies, and supporting infrastructure platforms. The ability to independently learn unfamiliar systems and assume operational ownership of business-critical applications is essential.
 This position is fully onsite and reports remotely within a global IT organization. 
 Key Responsibilities Administer, support, monitor, and troubleshoot business-critical enterprise applications, including ERP, warehouse management, engineering, manufacturing, analytics, and other operational systems. Develop technical expertise and operational ownership of assigned applications and services. Proactively identify technical debt, supportability risks, and opportunities for improvement across enterprise applications and supporting infrastructure. Contribute to projects and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing technical debt, improving system stability, and modernizing legacy technologies. Troubleshoot issues across application, database, operating system, infrastructure, authentication, and integration layers. Administer and support Microsoft SQL Server environments, including clustered installations, Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) platforms, and related technologies such as SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS. Collaborate with Development, Data, BI, and DBA teams to identify and resolve database and application performance issues. Administer and support Microsoft Windows Server environments. Support Active Directory administration, authentication services, and Kerberos-related troubleshooting. Support and maintain virtualized environments primarily based on Microsoft Hyper-V. Support Azure-hosted business applications, databases, and analytical solutions. Participate in application and infrastructure deployment projects and ensure operational readiness prior to go-live. Review technical documentation and ensure supported systems remain properly documented and maintainable. Work within established ITIL processes for Incident, Problem, Change, and Service Request Management. Perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring and business-critical incidents. Collect and analyze diagnostic information using tools such as PerfMon, Windows Event Viewer, SQL Server tools, Dynatrace, Spotlight, and application logs. Create and maintain technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation. Collaborate with software vendors, service providers, business users, project teams, and global IT teams to resolve complex technical issues. Participate in regular remote meetings and communications using Microsoft Teams, email, and ticket management systems. 
 Education 
 Computer Science degree, Information Technology degree, or equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience. 
 The following certifications are considered an asset: 
 IT Infrastructure Library (ITIL) Microsoft certifications related to Windows Server, SQL Server, Azure, Infrastructure Administration, or Enterprise Applications Citrix certifications 
 Experience & Qualifications 
 5+ years of experience implementing, supporting, and managing enterprise applications and systems technologies in a complex, global environment. Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft Windows Server environments. Strong hands-on experience administering Microsoft SQL Server environments. Experience supporting ERP and business-critical enterprise applications. Experience supporting ERP solutions such as Microsoft Dynamics AX. Experience supporting Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) environments and Microsoft SQL Server technologies including SSIS, SSAS, and SSRS. Experience troubleshooting SQL Server performance issues and supporting clustered SQL Server environments. Experience administering Microsoft Active Directory and supporting Microsoft Hyper-V environments. Experience working within ITIL-based support processes. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills. Ability to independently learn and support unfamiliar business systems and technologies. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Experience working with globally distributed teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to create technical documentation, operational procedures, incident reports, and Root Cause Analysis documentation. 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience supporting manufacturing, engineering, warehouse management, and other business-critical enterprise applications. Experience with Teamcenter, NX, CAD/PDM/PLM platforms, WMS, OFS, TDM, or comparable business systems is considered an asset. Experience with Azure, Citrix, Linux, Docker, or related infrastructure technologies. Experience with Dynatrace monitoring solutions. Experience troubleshooting Kerberos authentication issues. Experience with PowerShell scripting and automation. 
 Key Competencies 
 Self-motivated and highly independent. Strong sense of ownership and accountability. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Strong organizational and documentation skills. Continuous learning mindset. 
 Success Profile 
 The ideal candidate is an experienced IT professional who combines strong enterprise application support, Microsoft SQL Server administration, and infrastructure troubleshooting skills. They are comfortable working in an environment consisting of both legacy and modern systems, can independently acquire expertise in unfamiliar technologies, and take ownership of ensuring the long-term stability, performance, and supportability of business-critical applications.

description:
Database Administrator II / Senior (Snowflake / Cloud / On-Prem) 
 Position Summary: We are looking for a highly motivated, hands-on Principal Database Administrator to own the performance, availability, security, and cost efficiency of our enterprise data platform and databases across Snowflake, Azure, and on-premises SQL Server. This is a senior technical role responsible for administering our Snowflake account end to end, tuning complex workloads, enforcing least-privilege access in a regulated environment, and establishing the automation, security, documentation, and operational standards a growing data organization depends on. 
 Key Responsibilities: Own end-to-end Snowflake administration: account, warehouse, database, schema, and role architecture. Design and maintain a scalable RBAC model with least-privilege enforcement and clean role inheritance. Manage database and platform access requests, ensuring appropriate approvals, security controls, and timely provisioning. Manage warehouse sizing, auto-suspend/resume, and multi-cluster configuration for workload isolation. Monitor and optimize Snowflake credit consumption; implement resource monitors, cost center reporting, and proactive spend alerting. Tune query and pipeline performance using Query Profile, clustering keys, micro-partition pruning, materialized views, and Search Optimization. Administer Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, storage integrations, Secure Data Sharing, and cross-region replication. Implement column-level security, dynamic data masking, row access policies, and data classification tagging for sensitive data. Support administration, access, security, and integration patterns across Databricks and other cloud data platforms. Partner closely with Security to identify, remediate, and prevent database and data-platform security findings. Administer Azure SQL Database and Managed Instance, including geo-replication, auto-failover groups, and backup/restore strategy. Administer on-premises SQL Server: patching, upgrades, Always On Availability Groups, replication, and SQL Agent/SSIS jobs. Own and regularly test backup and recovery procedures against defined RTO/RPO targets across all environments. Enforce database security and auditing controls sufficient to satisfy internal audit and regulatory examination. Automate routine administration using Python, PowerShell, and/or Terraform to eliminate manual toil. Manage database objects and permissions through source-controlled, peer-reviewed CI/CD deployment. Support secure authentication and credential management, including key-pair authentication and related configuration changes. Build monitoring, alerting, and observability for availability, performance, capacity, and cost. Participate in on-call rotation; lead incident response and root cause analysis for database-related outages. Maintain runbooks, architecture documentation, and operational procedures so the team is not dependent on any single person. Serve as the escalation point for complex database issues and mentor engineers on tuning and best practices. Support onboarding and integration of new data and AI technologies, ensuring appropriate security, access, and operational controls are in place. Partner with data engineering, architects, analytics, application development, security, accounting, and business teams on architecture and operational decisions. 
 Core Competencies and Educational Qualifications: Bachelor's or Masters degree in CS, Engineering, or related technical field. 3 to 6 years of database administration experience, including 2+ years administering Snowflake in production. Demonstrated expertise in Snowflake performance tuning and credit/cost optimization at enterprise scale. Experience working across multiple cloud technologies and data platforms, with the ability to quickly learn and adopt new technologies. Deep, hands-on SQL Server administration experience across on-premises and Azure (SQL Database and/or Managed Instance). Expert-level SQL, including complex query authoring, execution plan analysis, and optimization. Proven experience designing and implementing RBAC and data security controls. Experience managing database/data-platform access and partnering with security teams to remediate security findings. Hands-on high availability and disaster recovery experience with tested, documented recovery procedures. Proficiency in scripting and automation using Python, PowerShell, or equivalent. Familiarity with CI/CD workflow, source-controlled database change management, and deployment processes. Strong incident response skills and comfort operating under production pressure. Write clean, well-documented code and procedures that can be easily maintained and extended by the team. Provide support for critical production systems as needed. Strong problem-solving skills , Exceptional attention to detail and strong ownership of operational accuracy and quality. Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders. Demonstrated ability to build trusted partnerships across technical and business teams. 
 Preferred Qualifications: SnowPro Advanced: Administrator or SnowPro Advanced: Architect certification. Microsoft Certified: Azure Database Administrator Associate. Familiarity in Mortgage Space or another regulated financial services environment. Infrastructure-as-code experience (Terraform) for database and warehouse provisioning. Familiarity with Airflow, or comparable transformation and orchestration tooling. Experience supporting analytics and machine learning workloads, not only transactional systems. Prior experience leading a database platform migration or major version upgrade. Experience with Databricks or other modern cloud data platforms. Experience supporting AI/ML platforms, tools, or integrations. Experience with cloud security, authentication, key management, and access governance. Experience supporting US-based stakeholders across multiple business and technology functions

description:

The role provides an opportunity to develop deeper expertise in ServiceNow development, ITSM, APIs, automation, CMDB, production engineering, and Site Reliability Engineering practices. Develop and support integrations between ServiceNow and enterprise platforms using REST APIs, web services, events, and related integration technologies . Work with structured data formats such as JSON and XML. Develop automation that reduces manual effort and improves engineering and operational efficiency. Help develop reusable integration patterns and services. Develop and maintain integrations that populate, update, or consume CMDB and operational data. Troubleshoot integration, data, and production issues, escalating or collaborating with experienced engineers as appropriate. Look for opportunities to replace repetitive manual processes with effective automation. Apply sound software engineering practices across application design, development, automated testing, code review, deployment, and production support. Develop maintainable, testable, and well-documented software. Use source control, automated testing, and CI/CD as part of the engineering lifecycle. Participate actively in design discussions and code reviews. Apply feedback from senior engineers and incorporate established technical standards and reusable patterns into development work. Develop an understanding of enterprise application architecture, reliability, security, and maintainability. Participate in Agile planning, development, testing, deployment, and retrospective activities. Remain current on relevant technologies and continuously develop technical capabilities. Take increasing technical ownership and operate with greater independence as experience grows. Develop, test, deploy, and support enterprise solutions on the ServiceNow platform . Build and enhance ServiceNow applications, workflows, integrations, automation, APIs, and platform capabilities. Develop capabilities supporting Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and CMDB . Assist in developing and enhancing CMDB functionality, configuration relationships, integrations, and data capabilities that support Incident, Problem, and Change processes. Develop features based on process, operational, and technology requirements. Help ensure configuration data can be effectively used for incident investigation, problem analysis, change planning, impact assessment, reporting, and operational decision-making. Create solutions that address process gaps and reduce manual effort. Write clear, maintainable, testable, and well-documented software. Troubleshoot defects and production issues, working with experienced engineers on more complex problems. Participate in design and code reviews and incorporate feedback into solutions. Take increasing ownership of applications, features, integrations, and technical components as experience develops. Follow established ServiceNow architecture, engineering standards, and the Amex development roadmap. Develop and apply working knowledge of ITIL and ITSM practices , with particular emphasis on Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, and Configuration Management. Develop an understanding of how Incident, Problem, Change, and CMDB capabilities work together to support effective technology operations. Translate defined process and operational requirements into ServiceNow solutions with guidance from experienced engineers. Develop workflows, automation, business rules, integrations, and supporting capabilities across these ITSM areas. Work with process owners, SRE, Application Support, Operations Engineering, and application teams to improve service-management capabilities. Help develop solutions that connect incidents, underlying problems, planned changes, affected services, applications, infrastructure, and associated configuration items. Identify process or technology gaps and work with experienced engineers to develop sustainable solutions. Contribute to improving the quality, consistency, and usability of operational and CMDB data supporting ITSM processes.

title: Manager - Finance
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with 2+ years of relevant experience to manage the company's finance and accounting operations. The role involves overseeing financial reporting, taxation, statutory compliance, audits, budgeting, cash flow management and financial analysis. The candidate should have a strong understanding of accounting standards and regulatory requirements, along with the ability to ensure accurate financial records, timely compliance and efficient financial operations. 
 Main Duties & Responsibilities 
 1. Finance & Accounts In charge of the Finance and Accounts department of the company's. Approval of all payments and receipts for entry into the system. Release of payments to various suppliers. Coordinate all activities and guide staff in day to day finance operations. Ensure books of accounts accurately represent the company's financial affairs and are maintained in accordance with applicable accounting standards and policies. 
 2. Audit & Financial Reporting Discuss and resolve audit points with internal auditors. Coordinate with statutory auditors for the finalisation of audits and accounts. Finalise annual accounts and obtain Board approval. Coordinate annual audits with external auditors, including statutory, internal, concurrent and systems audits. Prepare financial reports and MIS for internal reporting, the Board of Directors and auditors. Provide accurate and timely financial information to support management decision making. 
 3. Taxation & Statutory Compliance Sign and oversee statutory returns, including Income Tax, TDS and other applicable tax returns, as authorised. Oversee routine statutory compliances such as GST, PF, PT, TDS and TCS, wherever applicable. Handle filing of Income Tax returns and Income Tax assessments, including appeals. Ensure tax liabilities are correctly calculated, returns are filed and payments are made on time. Ensure timely payment of statutory obligations such as PF and ESI. 
 4. Budgeting & Financial Planning Responsible for the annual budgeting process and monthly budget reviews. Implement business plans and other financial programmes. Handle financial planning, budgeting and MIS reporting. Analyse variance reports and prepare MIS reports. Conduct cost analysis for purchases. Manage cash flow, fund flow and working capital. 
 5. Banking & Treasury Operations Handle loans and day to day correspondence with banks. Coordinate and communicate with consortium banks. Deal with financial institutions, banks and financial syndicators. Monitor treasury operations and provide regular updates to senior management. Manage day to day banking operations, including bank reconciliation statements (BRS), accounting of collections, payment authorisations and internal fund transfers. 
 6. Billing & Collections Oversee regular invoicing and collection operations from clients. Ensure the invoicing process is followed at every stage, from business handover to raising invoices. Coordinate with the Accounts Receivable team to ensure timely collections. Identify and resolve exceptions in the invoicing and collections process in coordination with senior management and business teams. 
 7. Payables & Internal Controls Manage timely payroll processing, including updates arising from changes in statutory requirements. Ensure timely and accurate payments to suppliers and vendors. Ensure proper internal controls across Finance and HR processes, including vendor payments and offer releases to candidates. 
 8. Accounting Software Hands on experience in Tally and Zoho Books. Knowledge of SAP and other accounting or ERP systems. 
 Required Qualifications Chartered Accountant (CA) with 2+ years of relevant post-qualification experience in Finance and Accounts. Strong knowledge of accounting principles, GST, TDS, Income Tax and other statutory compliances. Hands on experience in financial reporting, budgeting, MIS, auditing, cash flow management and accounts payable and receivable. Proficiency in Tally, Zoho Books and MS Excel. Knowledge of SAP or other ERP systems is an added advantage. Good analytical, communication and coordination skills, with strong attention to detail.

Key Skills: Zoho,Cash flow,Tally ERP,Gst,Statutory compliance,Audit compliance,Analysis,Accounting standards

Support & Operations Handle L1/L2 incidents and service requests within agreed SLAs, following ITSM, SDLC, Agile, and Workday deployment methodology. Troubleshoot configuration and transactional issues, perform root-cause analysis, and drive them through to resolution. Support peak-cycle activities such as admissions cycles, registration, and end-of-term processing. Mentoring & Coordination Mentor and guide junior consultants and analysts on configuration standards, troubleshooting approaches, and delivery best practices. Coordinate across module teams, integration, reporting, and technical resources to ensure dependencies are identified early and resolved. Coordinate with client functional owners, run working sessions and demos, and communicate status, risks, and decisions clearly to both business and project leadership. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Hands-on experience configuring and supporting Workday Student in an implementation or AMS environment. Working knowledge of the end-to-end student timeline from recruiting through graduation, and the configuration that underpins it. Demonstrated experience with Workday business process framework, security, and reporting. Experience with requirements documentation, configuration workbooks, and structured testing. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain system behaviour to non-technical stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications Workday certification in one or more Student modules (Student Core/Essentials, Records, Recruiting & Admissions, Curriculum Management, Student Financials, Financial Aid) or Advanced Reporting. Prior experience with legacy SIS platforms such as PeopleSoft Campus Solutions, Banner, or Oracle Student Cloud. Experience with Customer Central, Campus Engagement Framework, Academic Requirements/APR, or Student Eligibility Rules. Exposure to third-party integrations (e.g., CRM/application platforms) and region-specific regulatory reporting requirements. Experience supporting multi-campus or multi-institution deployments.  Job Description: Technical Project Manager Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) & AI 
 Role Overview InfoBeans is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager with a strong engineering background, AI/ML expertise, and proven leadership capabilities to manage and lead a 40+ member engineering team supporting BFSI. 
 The ideal candidate will combine technical depth, project and delivery management, client engagement, and a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) mindset. Beyond managing delivery against defined requirements, the candidate will work closely with client stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities for innovation, and rapidly translate ideas into working technical solutions using AI, automation, and modern engineering practices. 
 The role requires hands-on familiarity with Python, Django, Databticks, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), and agentic AI development. The candidate should be capable of engaging with business and technology stakeholders, guiding engineering teams through solution discovery and prototyping, and converting successful POCs into scalable, production-ready solutions. 
 Key Responsibilities 1. Technical Project & Delivery Management Lead and manage a 50+ member engineering team, ensuring predictable delivery, quality, productivity, and client satisfaction. Own end-to-end delivery governance, including planning, estimation, resource allocation, risk management, dependencies, budgets, and delivery metrics. Establish effective engineering processes, delivery standards, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement practices. Work closely with engineering leads, architects, business analysts, and client stakeholders to resolve technical and delivery challenges. Build a strong ownership culture focused on outcomes, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning. 2. Forward Deployed Engineering & Client Partnership Engage directly with client business and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and emerging requirements. Proactively identify opportunities where AI, automation, data engineering, and modern software engineering can deliver measurable business value. Facilitate discovery workshops, technical discussions, and solution-design sessions to translate business problems into actionable engineering solutions. Rapidly develop prototypes and POCs to validate ideas, demonstrate feasibility, and accelerate client decision-making. Bridge the gap between business needs and engineering execution, helping transform exploratory opportunities into funded projects and higher-value engineering engagements. Build trusted client relationships by demonstrating technical credibility, business understanding, and a solution-oriented approach. 3. AI/ML, Agentic AI & Modern Engineering Drive the identification, design, and development of AI/ML-based POCs addressing real-world business and technology challenges. Demonstrate practical knowledge of Python and Django, including the ability to review code, guide implementation, and troubleshoot technical issues. Lead or guide the development of AI-powered applications, LLM-based solutions, AI agents, and agentic workflows. Apply Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-assisted engineering practices to improve development speed, consistency, quality, and maintainability. Encourage the use of coding assistants, AI agents, automated testing, and modern developer productivity tools across engineering teams. Evaluate POCs for technical feasibility, security, scalability, performance, and readiness for production deployment. Establish reusable patterns, reference architectures, and engineering practices that support repeatable AI-led solution delivery. 4. Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence Provide technical direction to engineering teams and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, coding standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices. Work with architects and senior engineers on solution design, technical decision-making, integration, and non-functional requirements. Promote hands-on problem-solving and maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge assumptions, review proposed solutions, and guide teams effectively. Drive collaboration across application engineering, data engineering, QA automation, DevOps, and AI/ML teams. Ensure that AI-enabled solutions meet applicable financial-services security, privacy, governance, and compliance requirements. 5. Stakeholder Management & Business Growth Communicate effectively with senior client stakeholders, internal leadership, and cross-functional teams. Present technical proposals, POC demonstrations, solution roadmaps, delivery updates, and business-value outcomes. title: Store Executive and Dispatch
description:
To manage the complete inward and outward movement of materials, hardware and finished products related to modular kitchens, wardrobes, vanities and customized furniture. The Store & Dispatch Executive will be responsible for checking, counting, recording, storing and dispatching materials project-wise while maintaining accurate inventory records in Excel and the company's physical dispatch registers. 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities A. Material Receiving & Inward Management Receive hardware, accessories, raw materials and other supplies from vendors. Physically check and count the quantity of materials received against the Purchase Order (PO), invoice and delivery challan. Verify material specifications, sizes, brands, models and quality. Identify shortages, excess quantities, damaged materials or incorrect supplies and immediately report them to the Purchase/Accounts Department. Prepare and maintain proper Material Inward Records. Ensure proper tagging, identification and storage of materials. B. Project-Wise Material Management Maintain separate inventory records for every project, client and site. Track hardware and accessories required for modular kitchens, wardrobes and vanities. Maintain records of material allocated, issued, consumed, returned and pending. Ensure that materials are issued only against approved project requirements. Coordinate with the Production and Project Teams for material requirements. Track material availability to avoid unnecessary purchases and project delays. C. Dispatch & Outward Management Check and count all materials before dispatch as per the approved project-wise requirement. Verify hardware, accessories, panels, shutters, carcasses and other items against the dispatch list. Prepare dispatch challans, material issue slips and outward registers. Ensure that the correct quantity and specifications are dispatched to the correct project site or client. Coordinate with transporters, drivers, site supervisors and project managers. Maintain dispatch acknowledgement and proof of delivery from the receiving site. Record any shortage, rejection, damage or return of dispatched materials. D. Inventory & Excel Record Management Maintain daily stock records in Excel. Update inward, outward, balance stock and project-wise material consumption. Maintain a separate hardware and accessories stock register. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly stock reports. Track minimum stock levels and highlight materials requiring replenishment. Maintain accurate records of opening stock, purchases, project issues, returns and closing stock. Reconcile physical stock with Excel records and report any mismatch immediately. E. Material Optimization & Control Ensure optimum utilization of hardware and accessories. Avoid excess material issuance and unnecessary wastage. Track leftover materials from completed projects and ensure they are returned to the store. Maintain proper records of reusable, damaged and scrap materials. Ensure that materials are not misplaced, duplicated or issued without authorization. Suggest improvements in material storage, handling and inventory management. 3. Mandatory Registers & Excel Reports The employee must maintain the following records: Sr. No. Register / Report Purpose 1 Material Inward Register Daily material received 2 Material Outward Register Daily material dispatched 3 Project-Wise Stock Register Material allocated to each project 4 Hardware Stock Register Hinges, channels, handles, baskets, etc. 5 Material Return Register Leftover and returned material 6 Shortage & Damage Register Missing or damaged materials 7 Physical Stock Verification Actual vs. Excel stock 8 Dispatch Tracking Register Vehicle, challan and delivery status 4. Daily Reporting Format The Store & Dispatch Executive must submit a daily report to the Store/Production Head. Particulars Details to be Recorded Date Date of transaction Project / Client Project or client name Material Name Hardware / Accessories / Panels Opening Stock Available quantity Received Quantity Material received Issued Quantity Material issued Dispatched Quantity Material dispatched Returned Quantity Material returned Closing Stock Remaining quantity Remarks Shortage / Damage / Pending 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 100% physical verification of materials received and dispatched. Accurate project-wise inventory and hardware records. Zero unauthorized material dispatches. Timely updating of Excel sheets and dispatch registers. Minimum material shortage and wastage. Proper tracking of leftover and returned materials. Regular physical stock reconciliation. Timely dispatch as per project requirements. No mismatch between physical stock and recorded stock without reporting and explanation. 6. Required Skills & Qualifications Graduate / 12th Pass with relevant store experience. 24 years of experience in stores, inventory or dispatch operations. Good knowledge of MS Excel, including formulas, filters and stock sheets. Understanding of modular kitchen, wardrobe and furniture hardware. Knowledge of hinges, channels, handles, baskets, profiles, screws, fittings and accessories. Good counting, verification and documentation skills. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to maintain discipline and accuracy in inventory records. 7. Reporting Structure Reports To: Store Manager / Production Manager / Operations Head. Coordinates With: Purchase Department Production Department Project Managers Site Supervisors Accounts Department Transporters and Dispatch Team 8. Important Instructions No material should be received or dispatched without proper entry in the respective register. Every material issue must mention the project name and authorized person's approval. All hardware must be counted before receiving and dispatching. Excel records must be updated on the same day. Any stock mismatch must be immediately brought to the management's attention. Project-wise leftover material must be returned to the store after project completion. Proper documentation must be maintained for every inward and outward transaction.

The role involves developing BTS and BSC software modules, implementing GSM protocol stacks, working on Layer 1, Layer 2 and Layer 3 protocols, and enhancing network performance. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in GSM architecture, telecom protocol development, C/C++ programming, Linux-based development, and GSM signalling procedures. Key Responsibilities 1. BTS Software Development Design, develop, and maintain GSM BTS software modules. Implement Layer 1 physical layer processing and radio resource management functionalities. Develop and optimise channel coding, interleaving, ciphering, and burst processing algorithms. Work on BTS Operations & Maintenance (O&M), alarm management, and configuration management. Support multi-sector and multi-TRX configurations. 2. BSC Software Development Develop BSC control plane, call processing, and radio resource management functionalities. Implement Radio Resource Management (RR), Mobility Management (MM), and Call Control (CC) procedures. Develop and optimise intra-BTS, inter-BTS, and inter-BSC handover algorithms. Implement power control, timing advance, and load balancing mechanisms. Work on Abis, A-interface, and Gb interface functionalities. 3. GSM Protocol Stack Development Develop and maintain GSM signalling and communication protocols. Work on protocols including LAPDm, RSL, OML, BSSMAP, DTAP, SCCP, MTP3, and SIGTRAN. Analyse protocol traces, signalling logs, and call flows. Ensure compliance with relevant 3GPP GSM specifications. 4. GSM Feature Development Develop and enhance GSM features such as call setup and release, handover, SMS, GPRS/EDGE, frequency hopping, power control, timing advance, and cell reselection. Implement neighbour cell management and synchronisation functionalities. 5. System Integration & Validation Integrate BTS, BSC, EMS, and Core Network elements. Perform feature validation, system integration, and interoperability testing. Support customer acceptance testing and field deployments. Analyse field logs and troubleshoot customer-reported issues. 6. Performance Optimisation & Debugging Optimise call processing capacity, latency, CPU, memory, and transport utilisation. Develop troubleshooting utilities and performance monitoring tools. Perform debugging, root cause analysis, and system-level optimisation. title: Electronics & Embedded Hardware R&D Engineer
description:
We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Electronics & Embedded Hardware Engineer capable of designing, developing, and building complete electronic products from scratch. 
 The ideal candidate should be able to take a product idea and independently convert it into a fully functional hardware prototype, including electronic circuit design, microcontroller programming, custom PCB development, sensor integration, communication modules, and physical product assembly. 
 We need someone who is not limited to programming Arduino or ESP32 development boards but can also design custom electronic hardware and develop production-ready prototypes. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. Hardware Design & Prototyping 
 * Develop complete electronic hardware prototypes from initial concepts. * Work with Arduino, ESP32, ESP8266, STM32, Raspberry Pi, and other microcontrollers. * Design custom electronic circuits and hardware architectures. * Select appropriate chips, sensors, microcontrollers, and electronic components. * Build working prototypes using breadboards, development kits, and custom PCBs. * Design compact, low-power, and battery-operated electronic devices. 
 2. PCB & Circuit Design 
 * Design electronic schematics and multilayer PCBs. * Work with KiCad, Altium Designer, EasyEDA, or similar tools. * Design custom boards integrating microcontrollers, RF modules, sensors, and power circuits. * Prepare Gerber files, BOMs, and PCB manufacturing documentation. * Handle component soldering, SMD assembly, debugging, and board testing. * Work with PCB manufacturers to produce and validate working boards. 
 3. Embedded Firmware Development 
 * Develop firmware using Embedded C/C++, Arduino IDE, ESP-IDF, and PlatformIO. * Work with FreeRTOS and embedded operating environments. * Implement I2C, SPI, UART, USB, GPIO, PWM, ADC, and other hardware interfaces. * Develop OTA firmware updates, device diagnostics, and remote configuration. * Optimize firmware for stability, power efficiency, and performance. 
 4. Wireless Communication & IoT 
 * Integrate Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, BLE, LoRa, RFID, NFC, GPS, and communication modules. * Develop long-range and short-range wireless communication prototypes. * Implement MQTT, HTTP, WebSocket, and IoT device-to-cloud connectivity. * Develop communication between electronic devices and Android/iOS applications. * Work with antennas, RF modules, and wireless communication protocols. 
 5. Chip & Custom Hardware Development 
 * Select and integrate semiconductor chips, microcontrollers, and communication ICs. * Develop custom chip-based circuit designs without relying exclusively on ready-made development boards. * Understand microcontroller architecture, power management ICs, and peripheral circuits. * Work with FPGA, Verilog/VHDL, or digital logic design where applicable. * Optimize hardware designs for miniaturization, cost, and manufacturing. 
 6. End-to-End Product Development 
 * Convert product requirements into practical electronic hardware solutions. * Create functional proof-of-concept devices. * Build physical product prototypes with suitable enclosures. * Integrate batteries, charging circuits, USB-C, and power management. * Perform circuit debugging using multimeters, oscilloscopes, and logic analyzers. * Conduct hardware reliability, battery, thermal, and functional testing. * Prepare prototypes for pilot manufacturing and mass production. 
 Example Projects 
 The engineer may work on products such as: 
 * ESP32-based RFID and biometric attendance systems. * Portable LoRa communication and emergency messaging devices. * Bluetooth/Wi-Fi smart electronic accessories. * IoT tracking, monitoring, and automation devices. * Custom microcontroller-based electronic products. * Battery-powered portable smart devices. * Mobile-connected electronic hardware accessories. 
 Required Skills 
 * Strong understanding of electronics, digital circuits, and embedded systems. * Hands-on experience with Arduino, ESP32, and STM32. * Practical experience in schematic design and PCB layout. * Embedded C/C++ programming. * Sensor, RFID, wireless module, and peripheral integration. * Ability to solder, assemble, test, and troubleshoot hardware. * Understanding of voltage regulation, battery management, and power optimization. * Ability to build an entire working prototype independently. * Experience preparing BOMs, production files, and technical documentation. 
 Preferred Skills 
 * FPGA development and Verilog/VHDL. * RF/antenna design and LoRa communication. * RTOS and embedded Linux. * 3D printing and enclosure prototyping. * Mobile application and cloud API integration. * Experience converting prototypes into manufacturing-ready products. * Knowledge of electronic component sourcing and PCB assembly vendors. 
 Educational Qualification 
 B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Electronics, Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, or a related field. 
 Candidates with strong practical hardware development experience and a demonstrated portfolio are encouraged to apply regardless of formal qualifications. 
 What We Expect 
 We are specifically looking for a practical hardware developer who can: 
 1. Understand a product idea and create the hardware design. 2. Choose the required electronic components and chips. 3. Design the circuit and PCB. 4. Write and flash embedded firmware. 5. Assemble and debug the electronic hardware. 6. Build a fully functional physical prototype. 7. Improve and prepare the design for manufacturing. 
 Candidates must demonstrate previous working hardware projects. Experience limited to Arduino tutorials or simulation-only projects will not be sufficient. 
 How to Apply 
 Please share your updated resume along with examples of hardware projects, PCB designs, embedded firmware, or working prototypes you have developed. GitHub repositories, project photographs, videos, and technical portfolios are highly preferred.Role & responsibilities

Key Skills: IOT Application Development,Embedded systems,C++,Application,Kicad,Embedded Hardware,ESP,RD

 About the role 
Zenergize is a well-funded, fast-growing deep-tech company founded by IIT/IIM alumni, designing and manufacturing indigenous EV DC fast chargers and solar inverters to power India's energy transition. With a 50+ member team, we're already at a 50 crore annualized revenue run rate and targeting 100 crore by the end of this financial year. Experience with a ticketing or CRM tool is a plus. Clear communication in Hindi and English along with regional language, with the patience to guide non-technical customers by phone. title: Sales Data Steward & Salesforce Administration Associate
description:
Huron is redefining what a global consulting organization can be. Advancing new ideas every day to build even stronger clients, individuals and communities. We re helping our clients find new ways to drive growth, enhance business performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. And, we re developing strategies and implementing solutions that enable the transformative change they need to own their future. 

 As a member of the Huron corporate team, you ll help to evolve our business model to stay ahead of market forces, industry trends and client needs. Our accounting, finance, human resources, IT, legal, marketing and facilities management professionals work collaboratively to support Huron s collective strategies and enable real transformation to produce sustainable business results. 

 Join our team and create your future. Position Summary
The Growth Enablement Team (GET) is a robust sales support team with the goals of improving sales experiences, efficiency, and win rates. GET provides support across several key pillars: sales education programming; sales technology, reporting, and analytics; sales prospecting; sales opportunity support (RFPs, orals); and sales asset content and visual design. This remote team consists of US-, Canada- and India-based team members that support all industries and capabilities within Huron.
Huron is seeking an Associate to execute CRM data management and Salesforce administration in support of sales data quality across our internal CRM and analytics ecosystem, with a primary focus on Salesforce, our enterprise data lakehouse, and BI tools. Working within the Data, Analytics & AI pillar and partnering closely with the data governance function, this role keeps opportunity, account, contact, lead, case, and pipeline data clean, consistent, and reporting-ready. The role is hands-on: investigating data quality issues, executing mass updates and remediation safely, and helping bring consistency to standardized reporting. This is an execution and analysis role operating inside a heavily customized, multi-system integrated ecosystem. It does not own system design: changes to validation rules, automation, code, security model, or integrations remain with IT Salesforce Product Support, and all configuration changes follow the standard design review and approval path before implementation.
The position consolidates routine CRM data execution that currently passes between GET Data & Analytics, GET Salesforce Ops/Business Support, and IT Salesforce Product Support, giving that work a dedicated owner. The ideal candidate is a certified Salesforce Administrator with 2-4 years of relevant experience who works on more complex issues following defined parameters and methodologies, requires limited oversight to complete assignments, is genuinely curious about applying AI and automation to manual data work, and is eager to develop data engineering and Databricks capability over time. Responsibilities The Associate executes and maintains sales data quality within Salesforce and downstream systems, turning governance standards into clean, trustworthy data in the system. They partner cross-functionally with Growth Enablement, IT Salesforce Product Support, Analytics, and the Data Governance function to investigate and resolve data issues, execute large-scale corrections, and support trusted sales data that enables effective decision-making. Supports the quality, integrity, and ongoing management of sales and CRM data across Salesforce and related systems. Performs data quality analysis, bulk data remediation, and approved Salesforce data administration activities; investigates and resolves data issues; and applies established governance standards to maintain accurate, consistent, and reporting-ready data. Partners with Growth Enablement, IT, Analytics, and Data Governance teams to support trusted sales data and improve data management processes, including opportunities for automation and AI-enabled efficiencies Key responsibilities include: Mass Data Operations & Remediation: Execute bulk updates, corrections, and remediation across Salesforce objects (Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Activities, Cases) safely and accurately when data issues arise, applying validation, backup, and rollback discipline to protect data integrity. Routine operations run with limited oversight; changes above an agreed risk threshold are reviewed before execution. Data Quality Investigation & Root-Cause Analysis: Investigate data quality problems (completeness, conformity, validity, duplicates, hierarchy integrity, stage aging, activity hygiene), trace where issues originate, identify patterns, and recommend upstream fixes rather than repeated manual cleanup. Salesforce Data-Scoped Configuration & Execution: Execute approved, data-scoped configuration that directly supports data quality, working to IT Salesforce Product Support technical standards and testing in sandbox before production. Representative work includes: field-usage analysis and deactivation of unused or deprecated fields; duplicate and matching rule tuning and record merges; configuration of CRM data quality tooling (e.g., RingLead normalization, segmentation, and enrichment mappings); picklist value maintenance and restricted-picklist hygiene; account hierarchy, ownership, and record-type corrections; and report type, list view, and dashboard inventory cleanup. This role does not design or independently modify validation rules, flows, triggers, Apex, the security model, or anything affecting integrations or managed/shared components; it analyzes, recommends, and executes those changes only after IT design review and approval. AI & Automation of Manual Data Work: Identify recurring manual data tasks that could be automated or AI-assisted, maintain and prioritize a working backlog of those opportunities, prototype approaches using approved tools, and report results with evidence such as effort saved, error rate, and records affected. Reporting Consistency & Governance Support: Help bring order to standardized reporting by maintaining an inventory of reports and dashboards and identifying redundant, conflicting, or ungoverned assets that undermine trust in the numbers; support consistent report and field standards. Data Quality Execution in Partnership with Governance: Operationalize the standards, DQ rules, and stewardship model defined by the Data Governance function - applying policy as executed, maintained data quality in Salesforce and downstream systems. Master & Reference Data Maintenance: Support client/account and contact mastering, de-duplication and matching, survivorship, and account hierarchy maintenance in line with governance-defined rules, including enrichment and normalization rules in CRM data quality tooling. Monitoring & Issue Triage: Assist in profiling and monitoring data quality, running issue triage, and reporting on DQ metrics and remediation progress to the engineering and governance leads. Data Engineering & Pipeline Support (developing): Over time, contribute to data pipeline, integration, and Databricks work alongside the engineering team, building toward a broader data engineering skill set. Documentation & Standards: Produce and maintain clear documentation of data operations, remediation procedures, and standards; contribute to playbooks and quick-reference guides for consistent execution. Position Requirements The role requires hands-on Salesforce administration and CRM data management experience, with demonstrated ability to execute data operations and investigate data quality issues in enterprise environments. The ideal candidate is a certified Salesforce Administrator who works effectively within defined methods with limited oversight and collaborates across functions and time zones. Key Qualifications Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics, or related field. Salesforce Administrator certification (required): current, active certification with demonstrated hands-on administration experience. 2-4 years of relevant experience in CRM data management, Salesforce administration, data quality, or data operations, with the ability to work on more complex issues following defined parameters and methodologies and to complete assignments with limited oversight. Demonstrated experience executing mass data updates and bulk operations in Salesforce (e.g., Data Loader, data import/export tools), with careful validation and rollback practices. Data investigation and troubleshooting skills: able to analyze data to identify gaps, diagnose root causes, and recommend or execute resolutions. Solid understanding of the Salesforce data model, records, fields, matching/duplicate rules, reporting structures, and sharing/visibility basics, with the ability to read and interpret existing validation rules, automation, and integration touchpoints well enough to diagnose where a data issue originates and escalate appropriately. Hands-on experience with duplicate management and data quality tooling (e.g., RingLead, LeanData, DemandTools), including normalization, segmentation, matching/merge criteria, and enrichment rules. Demonstrated curiosity about AI: uses AI tools in day-to-day work and can describe something they have automated or simplified as a result. Proficiency with data manipulation (e.g., SQL or spreadsheet-based transformation) and familiarity with data quality concepts (completeness, conformity, deduplication, hierarchy integrity). Strong communication and organizational skills; able to convey data issues, status, and risks clearly, translate technical terms for non-technical audiences, and work effectively with US- and Canada-based analytics leads across time zones. Ability to work to another team s technical standards and receptive to coaching and review from outside the direct reporting line. Work standards and accountability: sets high standards for accuracy and completeness, takes ownership of assignments, and escalates issues appropriately. Preferred Skills Databricks experience (strongly desired): exposure to the data lakehouse and a willingness to develop data engineering capability; training will be provided. - Exposure to data pipeline / data engineering concepts and CRM-to-warehouse/BI integration patterns. Familiarity with BI/analytics platforms, especially Salesforce CRM Analytics (CRMA / Analytics Studio) and Microsoft Power BI. Experience with sales data lifecycles (lead to opportunity to booking), pipeline management, and RevOps metrics. Familiarity with data governance or stewardship practices, DQ scorecards, and business glossary concepts. Exposure to marketing automation data (Pardot), third-party data enrichment providers (e.g., ZoomInfo), and ERP (Workday) integrations affecting sales data. Relevant Salesforce certifications beyond Administrator (e.g., Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder) a plus. Experience with Agile delivery and tools (e.g., Azure DevOps) and creating enablement materials such as playbooks and quick-reference guides. Associate Competencies This role is expected to demonstrate Hurons Associate competencies. At this level, the individual works on more complex issues following defined parameters and methodologies, receives general instructions, and requires limited oversight to complete assignments. Expectations are organized under the four core competencies below. Teamwork & Organizational Commitment Lives Hurons Values: Leads with Hurons values - Integrity, Collaboration, Impact, Intellectual Curiosity, Inclusion, Humility, and Excellence - in day-to-day interactions across the analytics, engineering, and IT teams. Client Service Focus Communication: Conveys data issues, status, and risks clearly and concisely; adjusts to the listener and translates technical terms for those without a technical background; listens actively and confirms understanding. Adaptability: Maintains effectiveness through change; approaches new tools and processes with a positive mindset and adjusts approaches rather than persisting with ineffective methods. Critical Thinking: Identifies data problems and opportunities, gathers and interprets information from multiple sources to detect trends and cause-effect relationships, generates and evaluates alternatives against clear criteria, and commits to action with appropriate urgency. Client Focus: Treats internal stakeholders (analytics leads, sales ops, governance, IT Salesforce Product Support) as clients - understands their needs, identifies service issues, and drives practices that improve data trust and satisfaction. Planning & Organizing: Prioritizes activities, breaks assignments into tasks, establishes timelines and milestones for recurring data quality cycles, and leverages available resources and tools to complete work efficiently. Work Standards: Sets high standards for data accuracy and quality, ensures no aspect of remediation is neglected, and takes responsibility for outcomes. Initiating Action: Responds promptly when data issues surface, implements improvements without waiting to be prompted, and takes action beyond the minimum required to resolve recurring problems at the source. Developing Self & Others Continuous Learning: Actively identifies learning needs, seeks out learning opportunities (including Databricks, data engineering, and AI tooling), applies new knowledge on the job, and takes on challenging or unfamiliar assignments to grow. Building Self Insight: Proactively seeks feedback and uses it constructively; assesses own impact and development needs; modifies approach based on feedback and self-assessment. Technical Knowledge Technical & Professional Knowledge/Skills: Understands and can explain relevant technical terminology and developments; knows how and when to apply Salesforce administration and CRM data management skills; performs complex tasks in the area of expertise to solve difficult data problems and accomplish challenging goals. title: Inside Sales Executive - Courier Aggregation & B2B Sales
description:
Job Overview 
 We are looking for a result-oriented Inside Sales Executive with prior experience in the courier aggregation, logistics or e-commerce shipping industry. The candidate will be responsible for managing marketing-generated leads and the company's in-house lead database, engaging with potential customers, understanding their shipping requirements, presenting Shipra's courier aggregation platform and converting qualified prospects into paying customers. The role involves managing the complete inside-sales cycle, from initial customer engagement and product demonstrations to courier rate discussions, commercial negotiations, follow-ups and customer onboarding. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of courier aggregation business models, courier pricing structures, shipping operations and B2B customer acquisition. Roles & Responsibilities 

 1. Lead Management & Business Development 
 Manage and convert marketing-generated leads, website enquiries and companyprovided databases. Identify and engage potential D2C brands, e-commerce sellers, online retailers and marketplace sellers. Conduct outbound calls, email communication and follow-ups to generate business opportunities. Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through consistent prospect engagement. Identify customer requirements and evaluate business potential based on shipment volumes. 2. Customer Requirement Analysis 
 Understand the customer's business model, product category and sales channels. Identify monthly shipment volumes, average shipment weight and current courier partners. Understand existing courier rates, COD requirements, RTO percentage and delivery challenges. Evaluate customer requirements and identify opportunities where Shipra's solutions can add value. Engage with business owners, founders and key decision-makers. 3. Product Demonstration & Solution Selling 
 Conduct online product demonstrations of Shipra's courier aggregation panel. Explain platform features, courier integrations, shipment booking, courier allocation, tracking and operational benefits. Present relevant shipping solutions based on customer requirements. Demonstrate the cost-saving and operational benefits of switching to or adopting Shipra. Handle customer queries, objections and commercial concerns. 4. Courier Rate Negotiation & Commercial Discussion 
 Analyse existing courier pricing and customer shipping requirements. Prepare and discuss courier rate comparisons based on weight slabs, forward shipping, RTO, COD and additional charges. Coordinate internally to obtain competitive courier pricing. Negotiate commercial terms within approved pricing and margin guidelines. Drive customers towards commercial agreement and business closure. 5. Sales Conversion & Customer Onboarding 
 Convert qualified leads into active Shipra customers. Manage the complete sales follow-up cycle until closure. Coordinate with Operations, Finance and Customer Support teams for smooth customer onboarding. Ensure customers complete the required onboarding formalities and initiate their first shipments. Maintain relationships with newly onboarded customers to encourage business activation. 6. CRM & Sales Reporting 
 Maintain accurate lead details, call records, meeting updates and sales pipeline in CRM. Track daily, weekly and monthly sales performance. Prepare regular reports on leads, demos, negotiations, closures and revenue generated. Achieve assigned monthly revenue and customer acquisition targets. Mandatory Skills & Experience 
 Prior experience in Courier Aggregation, Logistics, Courier Services or Ecommerce Shipping industry is mandatory. 1-3 years of experience in Inside Sales, B2B Sales, Business Development or Telesales. Strong understanding of courier aggregation business models and logistics operations. Knowledge of courier pricing, weight slabs, COD, RTO and shipping charges. Experience in handling B2B customers and managing sales pipelines. Ability to conduct product demonstrations and commercial discussions. Strong negotiation, objection-handling and customer-conversion skills. Good verbal and written communication skills. Working knowledge of MS Excel, Google Sheets and CRM tools. Educational Qualification 
 Graduate in any discipline. Candidates with relevant courier aggregation or logistics industry experience will be preferred. Compensation & Benefits 
 Performance-based sales incentives. Opportunity to work in a growing e-commerce logistics technology business. Career growth opportunities in Sales and Business Development.

Key Skills: Logistics,Business development,B2B,Negotiation,Telesales,E-commerce,RTO,Sales

description:
