 Sales & Business Development Job Overview 
 We are looking for an experienced and performance-driven Outreach Sales Executive Team Lead to lead a small outbound sales team and drive B2B customer acquisition for Shipra. The candidate will be responsible for managing a team of 34 sales executives, handling outbound sales operations, converting marketing-generated and in-house database leads, acquiring new merchants and achieving monthly business targets. The role requires strong industry knowledge of courier aggregation and e-commerce logistics, excellent sales negotiation capabilities, advanced Excel skills and the ability to manage sales MIS, dashboards and team performance. The ideal candidate should be capable of managing the complete outreach sales process, from lead generation and qualification to product demonstrations, courier rate negotiations, customer acquisition and first-shipment activation. Key Roles & Responsibilities 

 1. Team Management & Sales Leadership 
 Lead, manage and mentor a team of 34 Outreach Sales Inside Sales Executives. Allocate daily calling targets, lead databases and individual sales responsibilities. Monitor team performance, productivity, follow-ups and conversion ratios. Conduct daily team huddles and periodic performance reviews. Train team members on courier aggregation products, sales pitches, objection handling and negotiation techniques. Ensure the team consistently achieves assigned monthly revenue and customer acquisition targets. 2. Outbound Sales & Business Development 
 Drive outbound sales activities targeting D2C brands, e-commerce sellers, online retailers, marketplace sellers and high-volume shippers. Manage marketing-generated leads, website enquiries and Shipra's in-house customer database. Identify new business opportunities through structured outreach, cold calling, email and follow-up activities. Build relationships with founders, business owners, e-commerce heads and logistics decision-makers. Develop an effective sales outreach strategy to improve lead engagement and conversion. Personally handle high-value prospects and strategic business opportunities. 3. Lead Qualification & Customer Acquisition Ensure proper qualification of prospects based on monthly shipment volume, business potential and logistics requirements. Understand existing courier partners, current shipping rates, weight slabs, COD/RTO requirements and operational challenges. Identify customers who can benefit from Shipra's courier aggregation and shipping automation solutions. Maintain a healthy sales pipeline with clear lead stages and follow-up schedules. Drive qualified prospects towards product demonstrations and commercial discussions. 4. Product Demonstration & Commercial Negotiation 
 Conduct or coordinate product demonstrations of Shipra's courier aggregation panel. Present courier aggregation, automated courier allocation, rate comparison, tracking and logistics automation capabilities. Understand existing courier rate cards and prepare competitive commercial proposals. Lead courier rate discussions and negotiate commercial terms within approved pricing and margin guidelines. Handle customer objections related to pricing, courier performance, technology and serviceability. Drive prospects towards commercial closure and customer onboarding. 5. Sales Closure & Revenue Growth 
 Own team-level customer acquisition and revenue targets. Ensure newly acquired customers complete onboarding and initiate their first shipments. Monitor customer activation, shipment volumes and initial business performance. Identify opportunities to increase shipment volumes from newly onboarded customers. Coordinate with Operations, Finance and Customer Support teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding. Prepare monthly business forecasts and sales performance updates for management. 6. MIS, Advanced Excel & Sales Dashboard Management 
 Strong hands-on knowledge of Advanced Excel, MIS reporting and dashboard creation is mandatory for this position. The candidate will be responsible for developing, maintaining and analysing sales performance reports for both individual team members and the overall sales function. MIS Responsibilities: Maintain daily, weekly and monthly sales MIS. Prepare team-wise and individual sales performance dashboards. Track lead allocation, calling productivity, qualified leads, demos, negotiations and conversions. Monitor marketing-source-wise lead quality and conversion ratios. Track customer acquisition, active customers, first-shipment activation and revenue generated. Monitor sales pipeline ageing, pending follow-ups and lost opportunities. Identify performance gaps and share actionable insights with management. Maintain accurate CRM data and ensure timely reporting. Mandatory Advanced Excel Skills: VLOOKUP XLOOKUP INDEX + MATCH SUMIF SUMIFS COUNTIF COUNTIFS IF IFS IFERROR SUMPRODUCT Pivot Tables and Pivot Charts Conditional Formatting Data Validation Text and Date Functions Dynamic Sales Dashboards Data Cleaning and Data Consolidation Dashboard Development Requirements: The candidate should be capable of creating and maintaining: Daily Sales Performance Dashboard. Team Member-wise Productivity Dashboard. Lead Source-wise Conversion Dashboard. Sales Funnel & Pipeline Dashboard. Demo Scheduling & Conversion Dashboard. Courier Rate Negotiation Pipeline. Customer Acquisition & Activation Dashboard. Monthly Revenue & Target Achievement Dashboard. Mandatory Experience & Candidate Profile 
 Minimum 3-4 years of relevant professional experience in Sales Business Development. Prior experience in Courier Aggregation, Logistics, Courier Services or Ecommerce Shipping industry is mandatory. At least 1-2 years of experience in managing or mentoring a small sales team will be preferred; demonstrated ability to handle 3-4 team members is essential. Strong hands-on experience in Advanced Excel, MIS reporting and dashboard management is mandatory. Proven experience in B2B sales, outbound sales and merchant acquisition. Strong understanding of courier aggregation business models, shipping operations and courier pricing. Experience in conducting product demonstrations, rate negotiations and closing business deals. Ability to analyse sales performance and drive data-based decisions. Strong communication, leadership, negotiation and problem-solving skills. Working knowledge of CRM and sales reporting tools. Educational Qualification

title: JOb Opening For Executive/Sr. Executive- L&D_Noida
description:
About Our Organization 
TRICOLITE stands as one of the top three manufacturers of custom-built Low & Medium Voltage switchboards in India. Renowned for our premium quality and reliability, we are dedicated to delivering the safest and most dependable power distribution and management solutions, all while maintaining a strong focus on customer-centric service.
Since our inception in 1959, we have been committed to excellence, establishing ourselves as a benchmark for quality and precision. Every product we manufacture adheres to relevant global standards, ensuring top-tier performance and safety. Our industry leadership is driven by the adoption of advanced technologies, the use of the finest raw materials, and adherence to global manufacturing practices.
 JOB DESCRIPTION (JD) 
 Position: Learning & Development Executive / Senior Executive 
 Department: Human Resources 
 Location: Corporate Office, Noida
 Reporting To: Manager- HR
 Experience: 4-7 Years 
 Travel Requirement: Willingness to travel to all plant locations (Manesar, Jhajjar & Badli) as per business requirements.
 1. Role Objective 
To drive and manage the end-to-end Learning & Development function across the organisation, ensuring employees at Corporate Office and all plant locations have access to structured learning opportunities that enhance their technical capabilities, functional competencies, behavioural skills and overall performance.
The role will be responsible for identifying training needs, designing and implementing the Annual Training Calendar, coordinating training interventions, evaluating training effectiveness and maintaining comprehensive training records and MIS.
 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities 
 A. Training Need Identification (TNI/TNA) 
 Conduct organisation-wide Training Need Identification (TNI) in coordination with HODs, Functional Heads and Plant Heads. Identify technical, functional, behavioural and managerial training requirements across all departments and locations. Analyse skill gaps through performance reviews, competency assessments, employee feedback and business requirements. Prepare an annual Training Need Analysis (TNA) and develop a structured training roadmap. B. Training Calendar & Planning 
 Develop, publish and implement the Annual Training Calendar for Corporate Office and all plant locations. Plan monthly and quarterly training interventions based on identified needs and organisational priorities. Ensure timely coordination with departments and trainers for the execution of planned programmes. Regularly review and update the training calendar based on emerging business requirements. C. Training Execution & Coordination 
 Independently manage end-to-end execution of training programmes across all locations. Coordinate internal trainers, external consultants, subject matter experts and training agencies. Facilitate technical, behavioural, functional, leadership and soft skills training. Organise induction and orientation training modules in coordination with the HR team. Conduct regular plant visits to understand shop-floor training requirements and ensure effective implementation. Ensure maximum employee participation and completion of planned training programmes. D. Training Effectiveness & Evaluation 
 Measure training effectiveness through pre- and post-training assessments, feedback forms and knowledge evaluations. Track the application of learning at the workplace in coordination with reporting managers. Evaluate training impact and identify opportunities for improvement. Prepare training effectiveness reports and recommend corrective actions wherever required. E. Training MIS & Documentation 
 Maintain comprehensive training records, attendance, feedback, assessment scores and training history. Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual Training MIS. Track planned versus actual training hours, employee coverage and training completion. Maintain employee-wise training records and department-wise training dashboards. Ensure proper documentation of all training-related activities for audit and review purposes. F. Capability Development & Learning Initiatives 
 Develop structured learning interventions for employees at different levels and grades. Identify and implement competency development initiatives for executives, managers and leadership teams. Promote a continuous learning culture across the organisation. Explore digital learning platforms, e-learning modules and other innovative learning methodologies. Support the development of internal trainers and knowledge-sharing initiatives. G. Training Budget & Vendor Management 
 Assist in preparing and monitoring the annual training budget. Identify and evaluate external training partners, consultants and agencies. Manage training vendor coordination, commercials, schedules and feedback. Ensure optimum utilisation of the allocated training budget. 3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 
 Completion of Annual Training Need Identification across all departments and locations. Timely preparation and implementation of the Annual Training Calendar. Achievement of planned training programmes against the approved calendar. Employee training coverage and training hours per employee. Training effectiveness and post-training improvement. Timely submission and accuracy of Training MIS. Training budget utilisation and cost optimisation. Regular plant visits and implementation of location-specific training initiatives. 4. Educational Qualification & Experience 
 MBA / PGDM in Human Resources, Learning & Development or equivalent qualification. 37 years of relevant experience in Training & Development / Learning & Development. Experience in a manufacturing or engineering organisation will be preferred. Hands-on experience in managing end-to-end TNI, training calendars, training execution and effectiveness assessment. 5. Required Skills & Competencies 
 Strong knowledge of Training Need Identification (TNI) and Training Need Analysis (TNA). Excellent planning, coordination and execution skills. Good communication, presentation and facilitation abilities. Strong analytical skills and proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint. Ability to interact effectively with employees, HODs, Plant Heads and senior management. Strong documentation, reporting and MIS management skills. Self-driven, proactive and result-oriented approach. Willingness and flexibility to travel to all plant locations. 6. Key Role Expectation 
The incumbent will be responsible for independently driving the complete Learning & Development function across the organisation, with a strong focus on identifying capability gaps, building employee competencies and establishing a structured, measurable and sustainable learning culture across Corporate Office and all plant locations.

Key Skills: Skill gap analysis,Training,Training need analysis,Gap,Competency mapping,Training analysis,Analysis,Development

This involves conducting safety audits, risk assessments, and accident investigations to identify hazards and implement corrective measures. 
- Conduct in-depth safety audits at various operational sites, focusing on fitters and service technicians, to identify potential hazards and ensure compliance with international safety standards and company-specific guidelines.

title: Planning Engineer / Scheduler
description:
Job Description - Planning Engineer / Scheduler Project Planning, Scheduling & Controls (Primavera P6 / MS Project) Location Ahmedabad, India Work Hours 12:00 PM 10:00 PM IST Work Days Monday – Friday Experience Required Minimum 3 years in construction project planning and scheduling, with expert-level Primavera P6 skills and working experience in MS Project. Prior outsourcing experience with US-based clients preferred. Education B.E. in Civil Engineering or Post-Graduate (PG) degree in Construction Project Management. Certification in Primavera P6 / project management is an added advantage About the Role We are looking for an experienced Planning Engineer / Scheduler to join our project controls team. The ideal candidate will be an expert in Primavera P6, comfortable working in MS Project, and able to develop, update and analyse CPM schedules for construction and infrastructure projects, delivering accurate, specification-compliant schedule submissions for US-based clients. Roles & Responsibilities Read and interpret contract documents, drawings, and specification sections (including scheduling specifications) to understand scope, milestones, and contractual requirements. Develop detailed baseline CPM schedules in Primavera P6, including WBS, activity coding, logic ties, calendars, constraints, and milestones. Prepare and maintain schedules in MS Project where required by the client, and convert/exchange schedules between MS Project and P6 (XER/XML). Resource-load and cost-load schedules, and support earned value / progress measurement as required. Perform periodic (monthly/weekly) schedule updates: record actual progress, update remaining durations, and re-forecast completion dates. Prepare schedule narratives explaining progress, critical path, float consumption, variances, and logic or duration changes. Run critical path and float analysis, identify delays and risks, and recommend recovery or mitigation measures. Prepare look-ahead schedules (2-week/3-week/6-week), progress reports, S-curves, and dashboards. Support Time Impact Analysis (TIA) and fragnets for change orders, delays, and claims. Run schedule quality checks (open ends, out-of-sequence progress, excessive constraints/lags, negative float) per client criteria. Coordinate with project managers, engineers, and client teams to gather progress data and resolve schedule issues. Maintain schedule documentation, revision history, and submission records.
 Required Skills Expert-level knowledge of Oracle Primavera P6 (EPPM/Professional): Working experience in Microsoft Project for schedule development and updating. Strong understanding of CPM scheduling principles, critical path, float, and delay analysis concepts. Good written English for schedule narratives, reports, and client correspondence. Qualifications B.E. in Civil Engineering or Post-Graduate (PG) degree in Construction Project Management. At least 3 years of relevant planning and scheduling experience on construction/infrastructure projects. Expert in Primavera P6 and experienced in MS Project. Experience working with US-based clients in an outsourcing setup is preferred.

title: Home Loan Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities Home Loan Executive Roles & Responsibilities Industry: Real Estate Company Job Description (JD) Position: Home Loan Executive
Department: Sales / CRM / Finance
Industry: Real Estate & Construction 1. Job Purpose To manage and coordinate the complete home loan process for customers purchasing residential properties, ensuring smooth loan approvals, documentation, bank coordination, and timely disbursement. 2. Roles & Responsibilities A. Home Loan Processing & Coordination Assist customers with home loan applications for property purchases. Coordinate with banks, financial institutions, and NBFCs. Understand customer loan requirements and suggest suitable banking options. Collect and verify customer KYC and financial documents. Follow up with banks for loan application processing and approval. Ensure timely loan sanction and disbursement. B. Bank & Financial Institution Coordination Develop and maintain relationships with bank loan officers and banking representatives. Coordinate with multiple banks for competitive loan offers and interest rates. Negotiate and resolve loan-related queries with banking partners. Arrange property valuation and legal/technical verification with banks. Maintain regular communication with bank representatives. C. Customer Relationship Management Guide customers regarding home loan eligibility and documentation. Explain loan procedures, interest rates, EMI, tenure, and other charges. Provide regular updates to customers regarding loan status. Resolve customer queries and loan-related issues. Ensure a smooth and positive customer experience. D. Documentation & Legal Coordination Collect and maintain customer documents, including:
 PAN Card and Aadhaar Card Salary Slips and Bank Statements Income Tax Returns (ITR) Form 16 / Salary Certificate Business and Income Proof (for self-employed customers) Property Documents and Agreement Copies Coordinate with the Legal Department for property-related documents. Ensure all loan files are complete and submitted on time. Maintain proper records of sanctioned and disbursed loans. E. Loan Disbursement & Payment Follow-up Coordinate with banks for loan disbursement. Follow up on pending loan approvals and disbursements. Coordinate with the Accounts Department regarding customer payments. Track loan disbursement against property payment schedules. Ensure timely payment coordination between banks and the company. F. MIS & Reporting Maintain daily home loan application records. Prepare reports on applied, approved, rejected, and disbursed loans. Track pending documentation and bank-wise loan status. Submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports to management. Maintain a database of customers, banks, and loan transactions. 3. Required Skills & Competencies Good knowledge of home loan processes and banking procedures. Strong communication and negotiation skills. Good customer handling and relationship management. Knowledge of banking documentation and loan eligibility. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and email communication. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to handle multiple customer loan files independently. Problem-solving and decision-making abilities. 4. Educational Qualification & Experience Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Banking, or Business Administration. 2–5 years of experience in home loan processing, banking, NBFC, or real estate. Experience dealing with major banks and financial institutions will be preferred. Knowledge of the Ahmedabad real estate and banking market will be an added advantage. 5. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidate should be capable of independently handling the complete home loan department. Should have strong connections with banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions. Should be capable of getting maximum customer loan files approved. Must have excellent customer service and follow-up capabilities. Should take ownership of the entire home loan process, from application to final disbursement. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance Area Measurement Loan Approvals Number of loans sanctioned Loan Disbursement Total loan amount disbursed Processing Time Timely processing of applications Customer Satisfaction Customer feedback and service quality Bank Coordination Effective bank relationships Pending Cases Reduction in pending loan files Documentation Accuracy and completeness of files 7. Main Objective To independently manage the complete Home Loan Department of the real estate company, build strong relationships with banks and financial institutions, maximize customer loan approvals, and ensure timely loan disbursement for smooth property transactions. My recommendation: If you are hiring someone to manage the entire home loan department, you should consider the designation Home Loan Manager / Home Loan Department Head rather than Home Loan Executive. This will attract candidates who can independently manage the team, banking relationships, customer files, approvals, and disbursement processes. Is this conversation helpful so far?

Team Spirit We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together. Innovation We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create. Excellence We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger. 
 About the Role 
 The Human Resources Generalist is a critical role responsible for managing the payroll process and ensuring compliance with local legislation, while providing administrative support to the HR department. You will use AI tools and co-worker agents to speed up policy research and reporting, focusing your expertise on the payroll administration and policy development that optimize employee experience and keep Talent administration well managed. Youll develop local Talent policies, recommend and assist in implementing personnel policies and procedures to further hiring, retention, and development goals, maintaining local knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and employment law. 
 What Youll Do 
 Payroll & Policy Development Manage the end-to-end payroll process, including processing of salaries, taxes, and benefits Develop local Talent policies, recommend, and assist in the implementation of personnel policies and procedures to further hiring, retention, and development goals, ensuring ongoing compliance with local legislation with oversight from the Talent EU leader Maintain local knowledge of trends, best practices, regulatory changes, and employment law, applying this knowledge to communicate changes in policy, practice, and resources to leaders and employees Other duties as assigned Compliance & Reporting Review and modify policies and practices to maintain compliance, overseeing local administration and implementation of new and existing policies, including communication and acknowledgment of all local employees Prepare reports and analyze payroll data for management review, using AI tools to speed up policy research and reporting Maintain accurate employee records and HR data, including personal and employment information, benefits, and compensation Work within government and supplier portals, including immigration, taxes, pension, insurance, and social security Administrative Support & Employee Engagement Provide administrative support within the Talent department, including drafting contracts, correspondence, scheduling meetings, and maintaining files Assist with onboarding and offboarding procedures, maintaining and updating employee handbooks and other HR policies and procedures with oversight from the Talent EU leader Provide guidance and support to employees on HR-related matters, assisting in organizing employee engagement activities such as staff events, diversity celebrations, ERG activities, and staff lunches 
 What Youll Bring 
 Required Skills: 4+ years of experience in payroll and HR administration, with a Masters or Bachelors degree in HR, Accounting, or a related field Comfort using AI tools to speed up policy research and reporting Strong knowledge of local legislation and regulations related to payroll and employment Experience with HR systems and payroll software such as ADP, Attentia, or UKG Excellent organizational and time-management skills Strong attention to detail and accuracy Preferred Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills Ability to work independently and as part of a global team Proficiency in English and local language(s)

title: Human Resource Operations Manager
description:
People Operations & Employee Lifecycle Management Manage and oversee end-to-end employee lifecycle processes including onboarding, confirmation, transfers, promotions, role changes, and separation. Ensure timely issuance of employee letters, communication documents, certificates, and statutory records as per defined timelines. Drive seamless employee movement transactions while maintaining data accuracy and compliance. Manage and track employee exit processes, full & final clearance workflows, NOC management, and required documentation. 
 Background Verification & Post-Hire Compliance Manage end-to-end Background Verification (BGV) processes in coordination with external vendors and internal stakeholders. Conduct post-hire documentation checks and validation to ensure compliance with organizational requirements. Follow up with employees for document deficiencies and closures within defined timelines. Monitor BGV exceptions, adverse findings, and risk cases while ensuring appropriate escalation and closure. 
 Employee Data Management & Data Governance Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of employee master data across HR systems. Perform periodic data validation exercises and maintain data hygiene standards. Manage HR master databases and organizational structure updates. Conduct regular audits of employee records and transactions to identify and resolve discrepancies. 
 HR Shared Services, Policies & Process Governance Prepare, review, and maintain HR policies, SOPs, process notes, operating guidelines, and governance documents. Standardize HR operational processes to ensure consistency and compliance across the organization. Establish process controls and drive adherence to internal policies and audit requirements. Support internal and external audits by providing required data, documentation, and process evidence. 
 MIS, Reporting & Analytics Develop and maintain HR operational dashboards and MIS reports covering headcount, onboarding, exits, pending documentation, BGV status, employee movements, and service-level metrics. Generate periodic reports for HR leadership and management review. Monitor operational KPIs, identify trends, and provide recommendations for process improvements. Ensure timely and accurate reporting of HR operational metrics. 
 Risk & Control Management Support Risk Control Self Assessment (RCSA) activities for HR Operations processes. Identify operational risks, control gaps, and process vulnerabilities. Implement process controls and corrective actions to strengthen governance and compliance. Maintain documentation for process controls, audit observations, and risk mitigation plans. 
 Continuous Improvement & Service Excellence Drive process simplification, automation, and operational excellence initiatives within HR Operations. Partner with HR, IT, Compliance, and Business teams to improve service delivery and employee experience. Identify opportunities to reduce turnaround times, improve accuracy, and enhance operational efficiency. Contribute to HR digitization and automation initiatives where appropriate. 
 Key Competencies HR Operations & Shared Services Management Employee Lifecycle Management Background Verification & Post-Hire Compliance Management HR Data Management & Data Governance Data Validation & Data Hygiene HR Policies, SOPs & Process Documentation MIS Reporting & Dashboarding Risk Control Self Assessment (RCSA) Audit & Compliance Management Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement Stakeholder & Vendor Management HRMS / HRIS Administration Attention to Detail & Operational Controls 
 Good to Have Exposure to HRMS platforms such as SAP & Workline will be an added advantage. Experience in HR process automation and workflow management. Understanding of labor law documentation and compliance requirements. Knowledge of internal audit frameworks, risk assessments, and control testing. Advanced proficiency in Excel, Power BI, and HR analytics tools. 
 Mandatory Skills - Human Resource Operations Manager, Process Management, Risk Control and Self Assessment, Background Verification

title: Marketing Head - Trade & Channel - Reporting To CEO
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Head Marketing Industry: Building Materials & Building Construction Solutions
 Function: Marketing
 Designation: Head – Marketing
 Reporting To: CEO / Business Head
 Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh
 Experience: 22–27 years (indicative)
 Preferred Age: 45–50 years
 Education: MBA in Marketing from a reputed institution
 CTC: Up to 90 LPA (stretchable for the right candidate) 1. Role Overview We are looking for an accomplished and strategic marketing leader to head the Marketing function of a leading Building Materials & Building Construction Solutions business. The incumbent will be responsible for developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to strengthen brand positioning, drive consumer demand, enhance channel effectiveness and accelerate business growth. The role requires a well-rounded marketing professional with strong expertise across Channel Marketing, Trade Marketing, Consumer Marketing, Digital Marketing and integrated ATL/BTL activities. The candidate should have the ability to connect marketing initiatives with business objectives, work closely with Sales leadership and build strong consumer preference through effective brand communication, dealer engagement and demand-generation initiatives. 2. Key Responsibilities 2. Key Responsibilities A. Channel & Trade Marketing Develop and implement comprehensive channel and trade marketing strategies aligned with overall business and sales objectives. Strengthen engagement and relationships with dealers, distributors, retailers and other channel partners to enhance brand preference and business growth. Design and execute dealer loyalty programmes, trade promotions, incentive schemes, reward programmes and channel activation initiatives. Drive effective retail marketing initiatives, including showroom branding, product displays, merchandising, point-of-sale communication and in-store branding. Develop region-specific and market-specific trade marketing plans in coordination with regional Sales teams. Plan and execute dealer meets, channel partner conferences, exhibitions, trade fairs and other engagement activities. Ensure effective utilisation of trade marketing budgets and measure the impact of channel initiatives on sales performance. Work closely with Sales leadership to improve dealer productivity, channel effectiveness, market penetration and overall business performance. B. Consumer Marketing Develop and implement consumer-centric marketing strategies to strengthen brand preference, influence purchase decisions and generate product demand. Build a deep understanding of consumer behaviour, buying patterns, purchase motivations, preferences and evolving market trends. Identify key consumer segments and develop targeted marketing initiatives to address their specific needs and expectations. Plan and execute consumer engagement programmes, brand activations, promotional campaigns, roadshows and experiential marketing initiatives. Drive consumer enquiries, qualified leads, product awareness and conversion through integrated marketing programmes. Develop initiatives to influence consumers at various stages of their purchase journey, from awareness and consideration to final purchase. Work closely with Sales and channel teams to improve consumer engagement, showroom visits and purchase conversion. Continuously evaluate consumer campaign effectiveness through market feedback, research and performance analytics. C. Digital & Performance Marketing Develop and lead the overall digital marketing strategy to strengthen online brand presence, consumer engagement and business growth. Plan and execute digital campaigns across Google, Meta, YouTube, social media and other relevant digital platforms. Drive Search Engine Optimisation (SEO), Search Engine Marketing (SEM), content marketing, social media marketing and performance-led advertising campaigns. Develop digital lead-generation strategies to attract relevant consumers and improve the quality and conversion of enquiries. Leverage CRM platforms, marketing automation, customer databases and retargeting tools to enhance consumer engagement and campaign effectiveness. Drive effective content strategies, including videos, digital creatives, product communication, influencer engagement and other relevant digital formats. Establish robust systems to monitor website traffic, digital engagement, lead quality, campaign performance, cost per lead and marketing ROI. Analyse campaign data and consumer behaviour to continuously optimise digital marketing investments and improve overall effectiveness. Explore emerging digital technologies, platforms and marketing tools to strengthen the organisation's digital capabilities. D. Brand Strategy & ATL/BTL Marketing Develop and execute the overall brand strategy, positioning and communication framework to strengthen brand identity and market differentiation. Drive long-term brand-building initiatives to enhance brand awareness, consideration, preference and consumer trust. Conceptualise and lead integrated marketing campaigns across television, print, outdoor, radio, digital and other relevant media. Plan and execute Above-the-Line (ATL) and Below-the-Line (BTL) activities to enhance brand visibility, consumer engagement and market presence. Develop impactful brand campaigns, advertising strategies, creative communication and promotional programmes in alignment with business objectives. Ensure consistency of brand messaging, visual identity and communication across all consumer, retail and channel touchpoints. Work closely with advertising agencies, creative agencies, media partners and external consultants to develop and execute effective campaigns. Monitor brand performance, campaign reach, consumer response and competitive positioning to continuously strengthen brand equity. Drive innovative brand-building initiatives to establish a differentiated and strong market position. E. Product Marketing & New Product Launches Work closely with Product Development, R&D and Sales teams to understand product capabilities, consumer expectations and emerging market opportunities. Develop product positioning, value propositions and marketing communication strategies for existing and new product categories. Lead go-to-market strategies for new product launches, including market preparation, launch campaigns, channel communication and consumer awareness initiatives. Develop effective product catalogues, brochures, digital content, product presentations and other marketing collaterals. Drive marketing initiatives to support premiumisation, product differentiation and expansion into new market segments. Identify emerging consumer preferences and market trends to support product innovation and portfolio development. Ensure effective communication of product features, benefits, quality, applications and competitive advantages. Monitor market response and product performance after launch and recommend suitable corrective marketing initiatives. F. Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights Lead market research, consumer studies and competitive intelligence initiatives to understand industry dynamics and changing market requirements. Continuously monitor competitor strategies, brand positioning, pricing, product launches, promotional activities and marketing campaigns. Identify emerging market trends, new consumer segments, changing preferences and potential business opportunities. Develop insights into customer expectations, buying behaviour, channel dynamics and factors influencing purchase decisions. Undertake brand tracking, consumer feedback studies and market perception surveys to assess brand health and effectiveness. Analyse market information and translate findings into actionable marketing strategies and business recommendations. Work closely with Sales teams to gather market feedback, understand regional requirements and identify opportunities for improving market penetration. Provide strategic inputs to senior management on market developments, competitive positioning and potential growth areas. G. Marketing Budget & ROI Develop, manage and monitor the annual marketing budget in alignment with the organisation's business priorities and growth objectives. Ensure optimum allocation of marketing investments across channel, trade, consumer, digital, brand-building and ATL/BTL activities. Establish clear performance measurement parameters to evaluate the effectiveness and return on marketing investments. Monitor campaign-wise expenditure, cost effectiveness, lead generation, brand impact and overall marketing contribution to business growth. Drive financial discipline and ensure optimal utilisation of marketing budgets without compromising campaign effectiveness. Evaluate and manage advertising agencies, media partners, creative agencies and other external marketing associates. Negotiate commercial terms with external partners and ensure quality, efficiency and value for money. Present periodic marketing performance reports, budget utilisation and ROI analysis to the CEO / Business Head. H. Team Leadership & Cross-functional Collaboration Provide strategic direction and leadership to the overall Marketing function, building a high-performing and professionally competent team. Lead, mentor and develop marketing professionals across channel, trade, consumer, digital, brand and product marketing. Define clear roles, responsibilities, objectives and key performance indicators for the marketing team. Build a performance-driven culture with strong accountability, innovation, collaboration and execution excellence. Identify capability gaps and develop training and development initiatives to strengthen the team's functional and leadership capabilities. Work closely with Sales, Product Development, R&D, Finance and other business functions to ensure alignment between marketing strategies and business priorities. Establish effective coordination between central marketing and regional Sales teams to ensure consistent and timely execution of marketing initiatives. Present periodic marketing reviews, campaign performance, market insights and strategic recommendations to the CEO / Business Head. Drive continuous improvement in marketing processes, systems, capabilities and overall organisational effectiveness. 3. Key Performance Indicators Brand awareness, positioning and consumer preference. Effectiveness of channel and trade marketing initiatives. Growth in consumer enquiries and demand generation. Digital marketing effectiveness and lead generation. Dealer engagement and retail brand visibility. Successful execution of brand campaigns and new product launches. Marketing ROI and budget optimisation. Overall contribution of marketing initiatives to business growth. 4. Candidate Profile & Experience 22–27 years of overall experience in Marketing, preferably with substantial leadership exposure. Strong experience in Channel Marketing, Trade Marketing and Consumer Marketing. Demonstrated expertise in Digital Marketing, Brand Management and ATL/BTL activities. Experience in large-scale, distribution-led and consumer-facing businesses. Exposure to dealer/distributor networks, retail marketing and consumer demand generation. Experience in managing substantial marketing budgets, advertising agencies and cross-functional teams. Strong commercial orientation and ability to link marketing investments with business results. MBA in Marketing from a reputed institution. Preferred age group: 45–50 years. 5. Preferred Industry Background Candidates from established B2C, consumer-facing and distribution-led industries will be considered. Relevant industries may include: Consumer Durables and Home Appliances. Paints and Construction Chemicals. Electricals and Lighting. Plywood, Laminates and Decorative Surfaces. Furniture and Home Improvement. Lifestyle and Retail Consumer Brands. Other large-scale consumer and distribution-driven industries. Industry Exclusions: Candidates currently working in or primarily experienced in Tiles, Bathware, Sanitaryware and Cement businesses may not be considered. 6. Key Competencies Strategic marketing leadership and business acumen. Strong channel and trade marketing orientation. Consumer understanding and brand-building capabilities. Digital and performance marketing expertise. ATL/BTL campaign planning and execution. Commercial orientation and analytical skills. Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management.

 CRPS follows a hybrid work model for both Chennai and Hyderabad locations. Team members typically collaborate in-office 3 days per week, with schedules determined by team needs, client demands, and training requirements.

Whether its working alongside your peers to solve a client challenge, or volunteering together at the local food bank, there are so many ways to find your why at the firm.

Thats why we offer a comprehensive Total Rewards package that includes generous PTO, a flexible work environment, extended parental leave, extensive learning and development opportunities, dedicated time off for professional examinations during non-peak seasons, as well as medical insurance, term insurance, and employee-friendly policies. 
 YOUR TEAM.

title: Senior CAS Accountant  U.S. CPA Firm
description:
Senior CAS Accountant U.S. CPA Firm | QuickBooks Online 100% Remote | Work From Home India | Full-Time, Year-Round Position Company: Montgomery CPA, LLC
 Location: Anywhere in India (Remote)
 Experience Required: Minimum 3 years of recent U.S. accounting experience using QuickBooks Online
 Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent, Year-Round (Not Seasonal)
 Department: Client Accounting Services (CAS)
 Work Schedule: Split shift – India Standard Time About Montgomery CPA Montgomery CPA, LLC is an established U.S. Certified Public Accounting firm headquartered in Albuquerque, New Mexico, with more than 30 years of experience serving individuals and businesses. Our firm has successfully worked with accounting professionals in India for approximately 20 years. Our India-based team is an integral part of our operations, working directly with U.S. accounting professionals, management, and clients. We are seeking an experienced Senior CAS Accountant to join our growing Client Accounting Services (CAS) department. Our CAS department provides ongoing accounting, bookkeeping, financial reporting, and compliance services to U.S. business clients. This is a permanent, full-time, year-round position—not a seasonal or temporary accounting job. Our clients require accounting services throughout the year, and we are seeking a professional interested in building a long-term career with our firm. This is not an entry-level position. Applicants must already have substantial, recent, hands-on experience using QuickBooks Online to provide accounting services for U.S. businesses through a U.S. CPA firm or U.S. accounting services firm. Mandatory Minimum Qualifications ALL of the following requirements must be met to qualify for consideration: Minimum 3 years of recent, hands-on experience using QuickBooks Online (QBO) to provide accounting and bookkeeping services to U.S. business clients through a U.S. CPA firm or U.S. accounting services firm. Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com), Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) with an accounting or finance specialization, or equivalent recognized bachelor's degree in accounting, commerce, or finance. Three-year and four-year recognized Indian bachelor's degrees are acceptable. Demonstrated experience independently maintaining U.S. business accounting records in QuickBooks Online. Hands-on experience performing monthly bookkeeping, bank and credit card reconciliations, and month-end closing procedures. Experience preparing and issuing accurate, timely financial statements, including balance sheets and profit and loss statements. Working knowledge of U.S. accounting principles and accrual-basis and cash-basis accounting. Strong written and verbal English communication skills. Ability to work the required split-shift schedule, including three evening hours in India to collaborate directly with our U.S. team. IMPORTANT: Candidates without at least three years of recent QuickBooks Online experience providing accounting services to U.S. businesses through a U.S. CPA or accounting services firm should not apply. Experience limited to Indian accounting, GST, Tally, or general bookkeeping without substantial U.S. QuickBooks Online experience does not satisfy our minimum requirements. Preferred Professional Qualifications Candidates possessing the following qualifications will receive preferential consideration: QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor Certification – Highly preferred. Indian Chartered Accountant (CA) – Preferred. U.S. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) – Highly preferred. Master of Commerce (M.Com) or other relevant advanced accounting qualification. Experience working directly with U.S. CPA firms and U.S. small-business clients. Experience preparing and filing U.S. state sales tax and gross receipts tax returns. Familiarity with New Mexico Gross Receipts Tax (GRT). Experience with QuickBooks Online Payroll and payroll accounting. Experience with Intuit's accounting software ecosystem and professional practice management platforms. Experience using Karbon or similar accounting practice management software. Experience communicating directly with U.S. clients and resolving accounting questions independently. Professional credentials and certifications are advantageous but do not replace the mandatory experience and education requirements. Key Responsibilities The successful candidate will manage ongoing accounting assignments for multiple U.S. business clients, including: Monthly Bookkeeping and Accounting Maintain accurate, complete, and current accounting records in QuickBooks Online. Record, review, and properly classify financial transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and other balance sheet accounts. Review and reconcile accounts receivable and accounts payable. Identify and correct accounting discrepancies, duplicate transactions, and misclassifications. Record journal entries, adjusting entries, and recurring transactions. Monthly Closing and Financial Reporting Complete monthly bookkeeping and closing procedures accurately and on schedule. Reconcile balance sheet accounts and review general ledger activity. Prepare and issue monthly financial statements, including balance sheets and profit and loss statements. Prepare management reports and other financial information requested by clients. Investigate unusual account balances, significant variances, and other accounting issues. Ensure that assigned clients' monthly accounting work is completed within established deadlines. Sales Tax and Gross Receipts Tax Compliance Prepare and file applicable U.S. state and local sales tax returns. Prepare and file New Mexico Gross Receipts Tax (GRT) returns. Reconcile taxable sales and related tax liabilities to accounting records. Monitor applicable filing deadlines and ensure timely completion of assigned compliance work. Identify discrepancies requiring review by the CAS Manager. Client Service and Team Collaboration Manage recurring accounting assignments for multiple U.S. business clients. Communicate with clients to obtain missing information and resolve accounting questions. Work closely with the CAS Manager and other accounting professionals. Participate in daily Zoom collaboration sessions with the firm's U.S. and India teams. Maintain accurate workpapers, documentation, and task status updates. Meet established deadlines and maintain the firm's standards for accuracy, confidentiality, and client service. Work Schedule – Important This position requires a split work schedule totaling approximately eight hours per day. Three hours during the evening in India: Approximately 9:00 PM to midnight IST, subject to U.S. daylight saving time adjustments. During these hours, employees participate in a live, firmwide Zoom collaboration session with our U.S. team. We work together on client accounting projects, discuss technical questions, coordinate assignments, review financial reporting matters, and interact with clients. Five additional hours during regular daytime hours in India: Employees have flexibility in scheduling these hours, subject to work assignments, deadlines, and team coordination. Applicants must be comfortable with this split-shift arrangement. Work-From-Home Requirements This is a permanent, 100% remote position. Candidates must provide and maintain: A dedicated, separate, enclosed home office free from distractions and background noise. Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity suitable for continuous video conferencing and remote work. A modern, current-generation personal computer capable of running professional accounting applications. Dual monitors. A functioning webcam, microphone, and speakers or headset. A professional, quiet environment for Zoom meetings and occasional client interactions. Compensation and Benefits We offer: Very competitive salary , based on experience, qualifications, professional credentials, and demonstrated technical capabilities. 30 paid days off annually , inclusive of vacation, personal days, sick days, and designated holidays. Permanent, full-time, year-round employment. This is not a seasonal or temporary accounting position. Permanent work-from-home employment. Opportunity to work directly with an established U.S. CPA firm. Exposure to a wide variety of U.S. businesses, industries, and accounting challenges. Collaborative working relationships with experienced U.S. and India-based professionals. Long-term career growth opportunities as our firm continues to expand. Confidentiality of Your Application Your application will be treated confidentially. We understand that many highly qualified candidates are currently employed and wish to explore new career opportunities discreetly. Montgomery CPA respects your existing employment relationships and your professional privacy. We will not contact your current employer for references, employment verification, or any other recruiting-related purpose without first obtaining your express approval. You may apply with confidence knowing that your interest in joining our firm will be handled professionally and discreetly. How to Apply Please apply through Naukri.com with your current resume. To be considered, your application must clearly identify: Your years of hands-on QuickBooks Online experience providing accounting services to U.S. businesses. The U.S. CPA or accounting services firms you have worked with. Your experience performing monthly closing procedures, bank reconciliations, and financial statement preparation. Your educational qualifications, including B.Com, BBA, M.Com, or other relevant degrees. Any professional credentials, including Indian CA, U.S. CPA, or QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor Certification. Your experience preparing and filing U.S. sales tax or gross receipts tax returns. Confirmation that you can work the required evening Zoom collaboration hours. Applications that do not meet the mandatory minimum qualifications will not be considered. Montgomery CPA, LLC

title: Store Executive and Dispatch
description:
To manage the complete inward and outward movement of materials, hardware and finished products related to modular kitchens, wardrobes, vanities and customized furniture. The Store & Dispatch Executive will be responsible for checking, counting, recording, storing and dispatching materials project-wise while maintaining accurate inventory records in Excel and the company's physical dispatch registers. 2. Key Roles & Responsibilities A. Material Receiving & Inward Management Receive hardware, accessories, raw materials and other supplies from vendors. Physically check and count the quantity of materials received against the Purchase Order (PO), invoice and delivery challan. Verify material specifications, sizes, brands, models and quality. Identify shortages, excess quantities, damaged materials or incorrect supplies and immediately report them to the Purchase/Accounts Department. Prepare and maintain proper Material Inward Records. Ensure proper tagging, identification and storage of materials. B. Project-Wise Material Management Maintain separate inventory records for every project, client and site. Track hardware and accessories required for modular kitchens, wardrobes and vanities. Maintain records of material allocated, issued, consumed, returned and pending. Ensure that materials are issued only against approved project requirements. Coordinate with the Production and Project Teams for material requirements. Track material availability to avoid unnecessary purchases and project delays. C. Dispatch & Outward Management Check and count all materials before dispatch as per the approved project-wise requirement. Verify hardware, accessories, panels, shutters, carcasses and other items against the dispatch list. Prepare dispatch challans, material issue slips and outward registers. Ensure that the correct quantity and specifications are dispatched to the correct project site or client. Coordinate with transporters, drivers, site supervisors and project managers. Maintain dispatch acknowledgement and proof of delivery from the receiving site. Record any shortage, rejection, damage or return of dispatched materials. D. Inventory & Excel Record Management Maintain daily stock records in Excel. Update inward, outward, balance stock and project-wise material consumption. Maintain a separate hardware and accessories stock register. Prepare daily, weekly and monthly stock reports. Track minimum stock levels and highlight materials requiring replenishment. Maintain accurate records of opening stock, purchases, project issues, returns and closing stock. Reconcile physical stock with Excel records and report any mismatch immediately. E. Material Optimization & Control Ensure optimum utilization of hardware and accessories. Avoid excess material issuance and unnecessary wastage. Track leftover materials from completed projects and ensure they are returned to the store. Maintain proper records of reusable, damaged and scrap materials. Ensure that materials are not misplaced, duplicated or issued without authorization. Suggest improvements in material storage, handling and inventory management. 3. Mandatory Registers & Excel Reports The employee must maintain the following records: Sr. No. Register / Report Purpose 1 Material Inward Register Daily material received 2 Material Outward Register Daily material dispatched 3 Project-Wise Stock Register Material allocated to each project 4 Hardware Stock Register Hinges, channels, handles, baskets, etc. 5 Material Return Register Leftover and returned material 6 Shortage & Damage Register Missing or damaged materials 7 Physical Stock Verification Actual vs. Excel stock 8 Dispatch Tracking Register Vehicle, challan and delivery status 4. Daily Reporting Format The Store & Dispatch Executive must submit a daily report to the Store/Production Head. Particulars Details to be Recorded Date Date of transaction Project / Client Project or client name Material Name Hardware / Accessories / Panels Opening Stock Available quantity Received Quantity Material received Issued Quantity Material issued Dispatched Quantity Material dispatched Returned Quantity Material returned Closing Stock Remaining quantity Remarks Shortage / Damage / Pending 5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) 100% physical verification of materials received and dispatched. Accurate project-wise inventory and hardware records. Zero unauthorized material dispatches. Timely updating of Excel sheets and dispatch registers. Minimum material shortage and wastage. Proper tracking of leftover and returned materials. Regular physical stock reconciliation. Timely dispatch as per project requirements. No mismatch between physical stock and recorded stock without reporting and explanation. 6. Required Skills & Qualifications Graduate / 12th Pass with relevant store experience. 24 years of experience in stores, inventory or dispatch operations. Good knowledge of MS Excel, including formulas, filters and stock sheets. Understanding of modular kitchen, wardrobe and furniture hardware. Knowledge of hinges, channels, handles, baskets, profiles, screws, fittings and accessories. Good counting, verification and documentation skills. Strong coordination and communication skills. Ability to maintain discipline and accuracy in inventory records. 7. Reporting Structure Reports To: Store Manager / Production Manager / Operations Head. Coordinates With: Purchase Department Production Department Project Managers Site Supervisors Accounts Department Transporters and Dispatch Team 8. Important Instructions No material should be received or dispatched without proper entry in the respective register. Every material issue must mention the project name and authorized person's approval. All hardware must be counted before receiving and dispatching. Excel records must be updated on the same day. Any stock mismatch must be immediately brought to the management's attention. Project-wise leftover material must be returned to the store after project completion. Proper documentation must be maintained for every inward and outward transaction.

title: Home Loan Executive
description:
Role & responsibilities Home Loan Executive Roles & Responsibilities Industry: Real Estate Company Job Description (JD) Position: Home Loan Executive
Department: Sales / CRM / Finance
Industry: Real Estate & Construction 1. Job Purpose To manage and coordinate the complete home loan process for customers purchasing residential properties, ensuring smooth loan approvals, documentation, bank coordination, and timely disbursement. 2. Roles & Responsibilities A. Home Loan Processing & Coordination Assist customers with home loan applications for property purchases. Coordinate with banks, financial institutions, and NBFCs. Understand customer loan requirements and suggest suitable banking options. Collect and verify customer KYC and financial documents. Follow up with banks for loan application processing and approval. Ensure timely loan sanction and disbursement. B. Bank & Financial Institution Coordination Develop and maintain relationships with bank loan officers and banking representatives. Coordinate with multiple banks for competitive loan offers and interest rates. Negotiate and resolve loan-related queries with banking partners. Arrange property valuation and legal/technical verification with banks. Maintain regular communication with bank representatives. C. Customer Relationship Management Guide customers regarding home loan eligibility and documentation. Explain loan procedures, interest rates, EMI, tenure, and other charges. Provide regular updates to customers regarding loan status. Resolve customer queries and loan-related issues. Ensure a smooth and positive customer experience. D. Documentation & Legal Coordination Collect and maintain customer documents, including:
 PAN Card and Aadhaar Card Salary Slips and Bank Statements Income Tax Returns (ITR) Form 16 / Salary Certificate Business and Income Proof (for self-employed customers) Property Documents and Agreement Copies Coordinate with the Legal Department for property-related documents. Ensure all loan files are complete and submitted on time. Maintain proper records of sanctioned and disbursed loans. E. Loan Disbursement & Payment Follow-up Coordinate with banks for loan disbursement. Follow up on pending loan approvals and disbursements. Coordinate with the Accounts Department regarding customer payments. Track loan disbursement against property payment schedules. Ensure timely payment coordination between banks and the company. F. MIS & Reporting Maintain daily home loan application records. Prepare reports on applied, approved, rejected, and disbursed loans. Track pending documentation and bank-wise loan status. Submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports to management. Maintain a database of customers, banks, and loan transactions. 3. Required Skills & Competencies Good knowledge of home loan processes and banking procedures. Strong communication and negotiation skills. Good customer handling and relationship management. Knowledge of banking documentation and loan eligibility. Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and email communication. Strong follow-up and coordination skills. Ability to handle multiple customer loan files independently. Problem-solving and decision-making abilities. 4. Educational Qualification & Experience Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Banking, or Business Administration. 2–5 years of experience in home loan processing, banking, NBFC, or real estate. Experience dealing with major banks and financial institutions will be preferred. Knowledge of the Ahmedabad real estate and banking market will be an added advantage. 5. Preferred Candidate Profile Candidate should be capable of independently handling the complete home loan department. Should have strong connections with banks, NBFCs, and financial institutions. Should be capable of getting maximum customer loan files approved. Must have excellent customer service and follow-up capabilities. Should take ownership of the entire home loan process, from application to final disbursement. 6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Performance Area Measurement Loan Approvals Number of loans sanctioned Loan Disbursement Total loan amount disbursed Processing Time Timely processing of applications Customer Satisfaction Customer feedback and service quality Bank Coordination Effective bank relationships Pending Cases Reduction in pending loan files Documentation Accuracy and completeness of files 7. Main Objective To independently manage the complete Home Loan Department of the real estate company, build strong relationships with banks and financial institutions, maximize customer loan approvals, and ensure timely loan disbursement for smooth property transactions. My recommendation: If you are hiring someone to manage the entire home loan department, you should consider the designation Home Loan Manager / Home Loan Department Head rather than Home Loan Executive. This will attract candidates who can independently manage the team, banking relationships, customer files, approvals, and disbursement processes. Is this conversation helpful so far?

description:

The role is accountable for translating client requirements into executable delivery plans, ensuring launch readiness, milestone achievement, SLA compliance, portfolio health, and proactive risk management across assigned accounts and projects. The role requires strong operational leadership, client-facing communication, analytical decision-making, and the ability to drive accountability across Onshore and Offshore stakeholders while managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Manager - BFSI (Lending & speciality finance)
description:
About us: 1Lattice is a 360-degree business decision support partner with a tech-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice is an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation to Execution to Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping clients solving a wide variety of organizational and business challenges through actionable research-led insights. Location: Mumbai About the role: As an Senior Manager (SM), you will have four key responsibilities: (1) Driving account growth and supporting business development activities, (2) Client management, (3) Ensuring project delivery, and (4) Team management. The foremost responsibility of this role is to drive account growth, client retention, and project profitability. You will be expected to seamlessly own and nurture existing client accounts for repeat and continued business, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, and ensure sustained client engagement. In addition, you will support the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, and other pre-sales initiatives. Apart from ensuring account continuity and growth, you will also be responsible for the profitability of your projects by effectively managing direct and indirect costs. You will further contribute towards the development and enhancement of product offerings and capabilities within 1Lattice. This role will be expected to develop close connections and relationships with senior level executives across the BFSI (Lending & Specialty Finance) space. This will require building and developing a wide network in the industry and leading interactions with them, playing a significant role in influencing their thinking, identifying potential project leads / opportunities / proposals and driving them to closure. This will also involve ensuring high quality project delivery through your teams to ensure high client satisfaction and repeat business. This position will lead and drive delivery teams of 10+ members in the BFSI (Lending & Specialty Finance) department for 1Lattice, including senior members who will be responsible for project delivery, and mid-junior levels for execution. This will involve supervising and guiding the research process and generating insights that help clients make critical business decisions across key sub-verticals within BFSI - Lending & Specialty Finance. You will also play a very important leadership role internally - to grow and engage your team and align them to the 1Lattcie culture. As such, your teams success will also enhance your own personal results. You will support and promote the 1Lattice culture by motivating your team members, train them and help them develop their skills, showcase their talents, make them feel part of the 1Lattice family, and overall helping them grow professionally. As such, you will be responsible for both their growth as well as overall happiness. Roles and responsibilities: Ensuring sustained growth and profitability of existing accounts through effective account farming, client retention, and identification of expansion opportunities within key accounts. Driving business continuity with existing clients, ensuring repeat business and long-term engagement from key accounts. Supporting the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, client discussions, and other pre-sales initiatives. Driving sectoral marketing, industry visibility, representing the 1Lattice brand, and supporting lead generation and conversion initiatives. End-to-end ownership of project scoping and delivery by leading high-impact teams and ensuring overall client satisfaction and engagement. Driving thought leadership in projects and coming up with compelling approaches, frameworks, and solutions to client problems. Managing team growth and satisfaction - be responsible for their success as well as build a strong team culture. Play an active role in recruitment and build project delivery teams in your vertical. Competencies and skills: Deep understanding of the BFSI domain, including lending & specialty finance-linked segments. Proven experience in business research / consulting / data services, with a minimum of 8+ years of experience leading and managing teams in the BFSI, Lending, or Specialty Finance industry. Strong and credible industry relationships with the ability to manage senior stakeholder conversations, drive account growth within existing clients, understand client needs, and develop trusted relationships. Ability to create impactful proposals for specific projects with a tailored approach and support business development initiatives for maximum conversions. Demonstrated ability to execute and project manage large-scale projects from beginning to completion, with a strong orientation to planning work, defining scope and approach for assignments, and driving work through teams with high efficiency. Strong team management skills: building a strong team culture, driving high impact and efficiency, and ensuring team growth and happiness. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, deriving insights from data and conversations. Excellent communication skills, both written (slide / text output) and verbal (client presentations).

title: Finance Operations Controller  (Onsite, Qatar Doha)
description:
FINANCE & Operations Controller Family Office  |  Multi-Entity  |  Global Investments 
 Role Type Full-Time | Hands-On Execution 
 Location Doha, Qatar 
 Reporting To Principal / Family Office 
 Experience 5+ Years Finance Operations Multi-Entity / Investment Portfolios 
 Role Overview We are seeking a Finance & Operations Executive to support a global family office with multi-jurisdictional entities and a diverse investment portfolio spanning private markets, public markets, structured products, and FX. This is a hands-on execution role, not a supervisory or advisory position. The successful candidate will be responsible for the day-to-day financial operations of the office and must be capable of understanding the underlying transactions, not just processing them. 
 Payments & Cash Mgmt Multi-Entity Accounting Structured Products India Coordination 

 Key Responsibilities 
 1) Payments & Cash Management Execute all payments across family office entities, SPVs, global operating entities, and personal accounts as required Maintain payment schedules, funding timelines, and cash flow visibility Coordinate with banks on transfers, FX-related flows, confirmations, and issue resolution 
 2 ) Accounting & Bookkeeping 
 Maintain books across all entities in multiple currencies and jurisdictions Perform bank and custodian reconciliations, expense classification, and accruals Ensure accounting reflects the true economic substance of each transaction not just its invoice form 
 3) Financial Product-Aware Booking (Core Requirement) 
 The role requires a working understanding of financial instruments to ensure correct classification, booking, and lifecycle tracking. Coverage includes: 
 Investment Instruments Equity and preferred equity Fund capital commitments and drawdowns Convertible instruments (notes, SAFEs) Distributions vs. return of capital vs. income correct classification required 
 Structured Products Fixed Coupon Notes (FCNs), Step-down Notes, Bonus/Booster Notes Understanding of coupon mechanics, barrier events, and early redemption triggers Product lifecycle tracking from issuance through maturity or early exit 
 FX & Derivatives FX spot, forwards, options Structured FX products including TARF (Target Redemption Forward) and TARN Working knowledge of cashflow vs. notional exposure and realised vs. unrealised outcomes 
 Expectation: Ability to interpret term sheets and bank statements, correctly classify transactions, and flag unclear or inconsistent treatment. 
 4 ) India Coordination & Compliance Awareness Coordinate with Indian accountants, tax advisors, and service providers Track filing requirements, documentation needs, and compliance deadlines Maintain organised records for all India-related investments and entities 
 Note: This is not an advisory role but candidates must have practical familiarity with India's administrative and regulatory environment. 
 5 ) Accounts Payable & Internal Controls Maintain invoice and payment tracking systems Ensure all payments are properly approved, fully documented, and audit-ready Support implementation and ongoing operation of internal controls and approval workflows 
 6 • Multi-Entity Operational Support Liaise with external accountants, auditors, and corporate service providers Support audit processes and prepare compliance documentation across jurisdictions 
 Candidate Profile Core Requirements 
 5+ years of accounting or finance operations experience Demonstrated experience managing books across multiple entities and currencies High attention to detail errors in this role have real financial consequences Strong process discipline and follow-through 
 Financial Product Knowledge   Essential Candidates must demonstrate functional familiarity with: Structured notes: FCNs, step-down structures, bonus/booster structures FX products: spot, forwards, options, TARF/TARN Ability to track product cashflows and lifecycle events, and apply appropriate accounting treatment This will be assessed. Candidates without demonstrable product knowledge will not progress. 
 India Experience  Essential Experience managing or liaising on India-based investments, entities, or advisors Familiarity with India's filing processes, documentation requirements, and regulatory environment This is a meaningful differentiator in the selection process 
 Personal Attributes Highly organised with a structured approach to documentation Strong ownership mindset comfortable taking end-to-end accountability Able to manage both institutional and personal financial matters with equal rigour Comfortable operating in a lean, high-responsibility environment with limited hand-holding 
 What This Role Is — and Isn't This is not a pure accounting or bookkeeping role. It is a controller-level execution role that requires: Strong operational discipline and process ownership Awareness of financial instruments and their accounting implications Ability to work across jurisdictions and complex investment structures without extensive guidance 
 Selection Process Shortlisted candidates will complete a case-based assessment covering: India filing and compliance scenario FCN product booking and lifecycle tracking exercise FX transaction classification and reconciliation task Candidates who pass the assessment will be invited for a structured interview with the principal. Applications without a strong finance operations background and demonstrable product knowledge will not be considered.

Key Skills: Finance Operation,Finance,Payables,FX Derivatives,Notes,Structured products,FX,Management
