title: CFO - IPO Process & Charted Accountants - Reputed Manufacturing
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Chief Financial Officer (CFO) Industry: Manufacturing
 Location: Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
 Compensation: Up to 30 LPA Fixed + 6 LPA Variable
 Total CTC: Up to 36 LPA About the Opportunity 
 We are looking for an accomplished and strategically driven Chief Financial Officer (CFO) for a reputed manufacturing company based in Coimbatore. 
 The CFO will play a pivotal leadership role in strengthening the company's financial framework, driving financial strategy, leading fundraising initiatives and spearheading the organisation's IPO readiness and execution journey . 
 The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in capital markets, IPO processes, fundraising, due diligence, corporate governance, financial planning and regulatory compliance, particularly SEBI regulations. 
 This is an exciting opportunity for a finance leader who can partner with the management team to drive sustainable business growth, enhance corporate value and prepare the organisation for the public markets. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 1. IPO Readiness & Capital Markets Primary Focus 
 Lead the organisation's overall IPO readiness strategy and execution. Coordinate with merchant bankers, investment bankers, legal advisors, auditors and other IPO intermediaries. Drive preparation of IPO documentation, financial disclosures and regulatory submissions. Ensure compliance with SEBI regulations, applicable listing requirements and stock exchange guidelines. Strengthen financial reporting systems, internal controls and governance frameworks in preparation for listing. Oversee financial due diligence, business valuation and IPO-related financial assessments. Support DRHP/RHP preparation and coordination with relevant stakeholders. 
 2. Fundraising & Private Equity 
 Develop and execute fundraising strategies to support business expansion. Manage relationships with private equity investors, institutional investors, banks and financial institutions. Lead debt and equity fundraising initiatives. Evaluate investment proposals, capital structure and funding alternatives. Coordinate investor presentations, financial models and investment documentation. 
 3. Financial Planning & Strategic Management 
 Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and long-term financial planning. Develop financial strategies aligned with business objectives. Monitor profitability, margins, cash flows and financial performance. Provide strategic financial insights to the Board and senior management. Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and improved financial efficiency. 
 4. Due Diligence & Corporate Governance 
 Lead financial, statutory and operational due diligence activities. Establish robust internal audit and financial control mechanisms. Ensure compliance with Companies Act, SEBI regulations, taxation and other applicable statutory requirements. Strengthen corporate governance practices, financial transparency and risk management. Coordinate with statutory auditors, internal auditors and legal advisors. 
 5. Working Capital & Treasury Management 
 Optimise working capital, receivables, payables and inventory management. Manage cash flow, liquidity, banking relationships and treasury operations. Develop strategies to improve cash conversion cycles. Monitor borrowing costs and financing arrangements. 
 6. Leadership & Business Partnership 
 Lead the finance and accounts function. Partner with business heads and the management team on strategic decisions. Build a high-performance finance team. Drive financial discipline, accountability and process improvements across the organisation. 
 Educational Qualifications Candidates with any of the following qualifications are encouraged to apply: 
 Chartered Accountant (CA) ICWA / CMA CA Inter MBA in Finance 
 Desired Experience & Competencies 
 Strong experience in corporate finance and financial leadership. Demonstrated exposure to IPO readiness, IPO execution or capital market transactions. Good understanding of SEBI regulations and corporate governance requirements. Experience in fundraising, private equity transactions and financial due diligence. Strong expertise in financial planning, budgeting and working capital management. Exposure to manufacturing operations and financial management will be an advantage. Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation and strategic decision-making skills. 
 Compensation & Benefits 
 Fixed CTC: Up to 30 Lakhs per annum. Variable CTC: Up to 6 Lakhs per annum. Total Compensation: Up to 36 Lakhs per annum. 
 Compensation will be based on the candidate's experience, qualifications and suitability for the role.

title: GRC Senior Analyst
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a GRC Senior Analyst with 2-3 years of experience to support our information security governance, risk management, compliance, regulatory, and audit activities. The role will involve working closely with IT, Engineering, DevOps, Product, Risk, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and external auditors to ensure security and regulatory controls are implemented, monitored, documented, and maintained. The candidate will support compliance requirements related to PCI DSS, PCI 3DS, PCI Secure Software Standard (PCI S3), ISO 27001, SOC 2, RBI regulations, and DPDP requirements. 
 Key Responsibilities Support compliance activities related to: PCI DSS PCI 3DS PCI Secure Software Standard (PCI S3) ISO 27001 SOC 2 RBI regulatory and cybersecurity requirements DPDP Act and related privacy requirements Coordinate internal audits, external audits, regulatory assessments, and certification activities. Maintain required audit evidence, compliance documentation, and assessment records. Maintain ISMS policies, procedures, standards, control documents, risk registers, and compliance trackers. Perform periodic control checks and compliance reviews. Identify gaps and follow up with responsible teams for timely remediation. Support information security risk assessments and track risk-treatment actions. Perform and coordinate third-party/vendor security assessments. Coordinate VAPT activities, track security findings, follow up on remediation, and maintain closure evidence. Support PCI-related activities such as scope validation, evidence collection, control implementation tracking, and auditor coordination. Support PCI 3DS and PCI Secure Software Standard compliance activities, where applicable. Track and support applicable RBI regulations, cybersecurity directions, data-localization requirements, payment-security controls, and regulatory observations. Support DPDP compliance activities, including security and privacy-control documentation where applicable. Assist with security exception management, risk acceptance, and compensating-control documentation. Maintain compliance calendars and ensure periodic assessments, reviews, renewals, and evidence submissions are completed on time. Prepare management reports, compliance dashboards, audit-status updates, and remediation trackers. Work with technical teams to understand security findings and ensure required evidence is available for audits. Support awareness and internal coordination for security and compliance requirements. Maintain documentation required for internal and external stakeholder reviews. Track security and compliance observations until formal closure. 
 Required Skills 2-3 years of experience in Information Security, GRC, IT Audit, Cybersecurity, Risk, or Compliance. Working knowledge of PCI DSS, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and RBI cybersecurity and regulatory requirements. Understanding of PCI 3DS and PCI Secure Software Standard / PCI S3 will be an advantage. Understanding of risk assessment, control testing, audit evidence, compliance documentation, and remediation tracking. Experience coordinating internal and external audits. Ability to maintain policies, procedures, risk registers, control trackers, and audit evidence. Understanding of information-security governance and risk-management concepts. Knowledge of vendor/third-party risk management. Basic understanding of VAPT and vulnerability remediation processes. Strong documentation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills. 
 Good to Have Experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking, or Financial Services. Exposure to payment-security and RBI regulatory requirements. Familiarity with PCI DSS certification and assessment processes. Exposure to PCI 3DS assessments and PCI Secure Software Standard requirements. Basic understanding of AWS/cloud security, IAM, network security, and application security. Exposure to GRC tools such as ServiceNow GRC, Archer, MetricStream, or equivalent platforms. Understanding of DPDP, privacy, data-protection, and data-localization requirements. Experience supporting regulatory audits, client audits, and certification assessments. 
 Preferred Certifications ISO 27001 Lead Auditor ISO 27001 Lead Implementer CISA CISM CompTIA Security+ PCI-related certifications or training Equivalent Information Security / GRC certification 
 Candidate Profile Strong in documentation and compliance coordination Comfortable working with auditors, technical teams, management, and external stakeholders Able to manage multiple audit and compliance activities simultaneously Detail-oriented and capable of maintaining accurate evidence and records Proactive in tracking and closing compliance gaps Interested in building strong information-security governance and regulatory compliance within a Fintech / Payments environment.

description:
OPERATIONS MANAGER E-COMMERCE FULFILMENT B2C Cross-Border E-commerce | Drop-Ship / Order-Based Sourcing | Order-to-Dispatch Operations Location: Hyderabad, India (On-site)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Operations Fulfilment Centre
Experience: 3 to 6 Years (B2C / E-commerce Operations)
Shifts: Rotational, including peak and festive seasons 
 ABOUT US We are a fast-growing cross-border e-commerce marketplace that brings Indian products to customers around the world. We follow an asset-light, drop-ship model without maintaining large inventory. When a customer places an order, our Hyderabad fulfilment team sources the required products from local retailers, brand stores, and online sellers. Each order is checked, packed for international transit, and handed over to our shipping partners within a committed 36-hour turnaround time. Speed, accuracy, and customer experience are our key priorities. 
 ABOUT THE ROLE As an Operations Manager, you will be responsible for managing the complete order-to-dispatch process, including order release, on-demand procurement, quality checks, packing, and handover for international shipping. You will lead the operations team, manage manpower and shifts, monitor performance, and ensure that all orders are processed accurately within the committed timelines. This role is suitable for candidates with experience in B2C e-commerce, D2C, quick commerce, dark stores, marketplaces, or cross-border e-commerce operations. 
 KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS Ensure at least 99% of orders are sourced, quality-checked, packed, and handed over within the 36-hour SLA. Maintain 100% order accuracy, ensuring the correct product, variant, and condition. Maintain zero wrong orders shipped. Ensure 100% procurement of assigned products within 24 hours. Keep excess or incorrect procurement below 3%. Monitor product unavailability and order cancellation rates. Minimise product damage or leakage during international transit through proper packing. Monitor and reduce customer complaints caused by fulfilment delays or errors. 
 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Order-to-Dispatch Management
Manage daily order processing, procurement, segregation, quality checks, packing, and courier handover to ensure all orders meet the 36-hour SLA. On-Demand Product Sourcing
Ensure products are sourced from local retail stores, brand outlets, and online sellers within 24 hours. Track pending and unavailable products and ensure timely closure. Out-of-Stock Management
Identify alternative sellers when products are unavailable. Coordinate with Customer Support regarding substitutions, delays, partial shipments, and cancellations. Order Accuracy
Maintain accurate product, SKU, variant, and order matching. Control excess and incorrect procurement to below 3%. Quality Checks and International Packing
Ensure proper quality checks before dispatch. Establish packing standards for fragile, liquid, and food products. Optimise packaging size and volumetric weight to control shipping costs. Shipping and Courier Coordination
Coordinate with logistics teams and courier partners for shipping labels, manifests, and required shipment documentation. Ensure restricted and prohibited products are identified before dispatch. Team and Manpower Management
Plan manpower requirements and shift schedules for procurement, quality-checking, and packing teams. Ensure adequate staffing during sales periods and festive seasons. Performance Management
Monitor employee performance through weekly and monthly reviews. Provide feedback and coaching, and coordinate with HR for Performance Improvement Plans (PIP), wherever required. MIS and Operational Dashboards
Prepare and monitor daily reports covering order fulfilment, SLA, product availability, procurement, and quality performance. Identify operational issues and take corrective action. Cross-Functional Coordination
Work closely with Customer Support, Category, Catalogue, Logistics, HR, IT, and Finance teams to ensure smooth operational activities. 
 SUPPORTING RESPONSIBILITIES Support the onboarding and development of local and online sellers and vendors. Assist in improving vendor pricing, procurement speed, and product availability. Contribute to improvements in order management systems, ERP, and procurement tools. Support cost-per-order reduction and process improvement initiatives. Participate in performance appraisals for direct and indirect team members. 
 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS Graduate degree in any discipline. Business, Supply Chain, or Operations qualifications are preferred. 3 to 6 years of experience in B2C e-commerce operations, order fulfilment, dispatch, last-mile delivery, hub operations, dark stores, or marketplace seller operations. Experience handling high order volumes with multiple SKUs and small quantities per order. Please apply only if your salary expectations align with the budget of 6 to 7.5 LPA.

title: Senior Manager- International Logistics operations
description:
Job Overview We are seeking a seasoned, high-caliber logistics leader for the role of Senior Manager – Cross-Border Operations. Based out of our Gurgaon headquarters, you will lead end-to-end international logistics operations for Delhivery, overseeing cross-border import and export shipments across key global trade lanes. This is a strategic and execution-intensive role. You will spearhead the expansion of our international freight network by launching new country corridors and deferred air economy products, while driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. This position owns P&L, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency for both air and ocean freight verticals. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End International Logistics Operations Lead end-to-end international logistics operations, managing and optimizing cross-border import and export shipments across global trade lanes. Supervise daily workflows for inbound and outbound cargo, ensuring smooth execution across origin handling, international linehaul, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery. Implement robust monitoring systems to track shipments, proactively resolve operational exceptions, and ensure high on-time delivery rates. 2. Network Expansion & Product Development Spearhead the physical and operational expansion of Delhivery's international freight network by identifying and launching new country corridors. Design, launch, and scale deferred air economy products to offer competitive, cost-effective cross-border shipping options to e-commerce, SME, and enterprise clients. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational readiness criteria for all newly launched corridors and lanes. 3. Strategic Partnerships & Carrier Management Identify, negotiate with, and onboard key global partners, including freight forwarders, customs house agents (CHAs), customs brokers, and commercial airlines/ocean carriers. Build and maintain strong strategic alliances to secure capacity commitments, preferential rate structures, and reliable transit times during peak and non-peak seasons. Manage partner performance SLAs, conducting regular reviews to ensure compliance with Delhivery's high operational standards. 4. P&L & SLA Compliance Management Take complete financial ownership of the Air and Ocean freight verticals, managing P&L, cost optimization, and overall unit economics (e.g., cost-per-kilogram and route margins). Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Transit Turnaround Time (TAT), On-Time Delivery (OTD), Customs Clearance timelines, and first-contact dispute resolution. Control and minimize operational exceptions such as terminal storage costs, demurrage, detention fees, and flight offloads. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Tech Enablement Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Sales, Business Development, Technology, and Legal/Compliance to support business growth and process standardization. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable, automated, and technology-driven processes for tracking, billing, and customs documentation. Ensure 100% adherence to international trade laws, customs regulations, aviation security standards, and safety compliances. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience & Education Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or Post-Graduate degree is highly preferred. Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, or cross-border e-commerce shipping. Leadership: Minimum of 3+ years in a senior supervisory or managerial role directly overseeing air/ocean freight operations, partner management, or international linehaul. Core Competencies Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of air/ocean freight operations, global trade lanes, Incoterms 2020, customs clearance regulations, and HAWB/MAWB rules (aligned with our Global Air Freight Operations). Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing P&L, negotiating complex commercial contracts, and optimizing unit economics. Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets for tracking operations, data analysis, and building performance dashboards. Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Exceptional negotiation and relationship-building skills to manage high-level partnerships across multiple geographies. Problem-Solving: Strong critical-thinking and crisis-management abilities to handle transit disruptions, customs bottlenecks, and capacity constraints in a high-pressure environment.

title: Technical Support Manager - D365 CE or FNO
description:
Job Summary When it comes to IT solution providers, there's really only one: Zones - First Choice for IT. Zones is a Global Solution Provider of end-to-end IT solutions with an unmatched supply chain. Positioned to be the IT partner you need, Zones, a Minority Business Enterprise (MBE) in business for over 35 years, specializes in Digital Workplace, Cloud & Data Center, Networking, Security, and Managed/Professional/Staffing services. Operating in more than 120 countries, leveraging a robust portfolio, and utilizing the highest certification levels from key partners, including Microsoft, Apple, Cisco, Lenovo, Adobe, and more, Zones has mastered the science of building digital infrastructures that change the way business does business ensuring whatever they need, they can Consider IT Done. Position Overview: We are seeking a committed and hands-on Technical Support Manager to lead our Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE or FNO) support function. The successful candidate will manage a team of more than ten support engineers and maintenance staff, work across multiple rotational shifts to ensure round-the-clock coverage, and serve as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches and production outages. This role combines deep functional expertise in D365 CE and sales processes (Order-to-Cash) with strong people leadership, process governance, and a continuous-improvement mindset. The Technical Support Manager will also oversee 2 to 5 short-term initiatives (1 to 6 months in duration) focused on bug fixes, technical-debt reduction, and incremental enhancements. Responsibilities Support Operations and SLA Management Operate the D365 CE support function and ensure all support tickets are resolved within agreed SLAs. Act as the first point of escalation for SLA breaches, P1/P2 incidents, and production outages. Govern the support playbook; continuously improve processes through automation and root-cause prevention. Perform detailed Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on critical issues and drive permanent fixes. Define, track, and report on key support metrics and KPIs (MTTR, first-response time, ticket aging, CSAT). Team and Project Management Lead and mentor a team of 10+ support engineers and maintenance staff across multiple shifts. Manage 2 to 5 short-term projects (1 to 6 months) covering bug fixes, technical debt, and minor enhancements. Run scrum ceremonies - sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives - and deliver high-quality fixes on schedule. Conduct performance reviews, capacity planning, and skills development for the team. Quality and Knowledge Management Ensure quality checks on knowledge-base articles and ticket-closure documentation. Develop new runbooks and update existing ones based on incident learnings and data-driven decisions. Promote a culture of documentation, peer review, and continuous learning within the team. D365 CE and Sales Process (Must Have) D365 CE: Hands-on experience with Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement (D365 CE) as an end-user, support engineer, or developer. Sales Process: Strong understanding of the sales process - Sales Orders, Pricing, Quotes, Opportunities, and Accounts. O2C / P2P: Proficiency in Order-to-Cash (O2C) and/or Procure-to-Pay (P2P) flows, with depth in one or more of: Sales Order, Pricing, Finance O2C, P2P, Tax. Modules: Good to moderate proficiency across D365 CE modules with the ability to navigate, troubleshoot, and configure as needed. Technical Skills Intermediate to advanced SQL - writing queries, analyzing data, and supporting incident investigation. Strong troubleshooting skills with attention to detail and the ability to apply learnings across issues. Familiarity with monitoring, logging, and ITSM tools (e.g., ServiceNow, Azure Monitor, Application Insights). Leadership and Soft Skills Proven ability to manage and motivate teams across multiple geographies and time zones. Excellent oral and written communication; able to brief executives and engage with business stakeholders. Fast learner with strong problem-solving instincts and a bias for action. Calm under pressure during outages and high-severity incidents.

title: Factory inbound logistics planning
description:
Role Overview 
 What is the purpose of this role- what are they there to achieve? 
The Factory Inbound Logistics Specialist (IBH Leaf) is responsible for the regional execution, coordination, and escalation of inbound and interplant leaf logistics flows into factories, ensuring production sites receive leaf materials reliably and in line with operational requirements. Additionally, the role acts as customs back office supporting preparation, validation and coordination of import customs documentation.
Operating from the IBH delivery hub, the role executes and coordinates daytoday inbound logistics activities across multiple factories, acting as the central execution point for factoryfacing inbound leaf flows within the region. The role ensures inbound leaf movements are visible, progressing as planned, and issues are identified and escalated early to protect factory supply and production continuity.
 Key Responsibilities 
 What are the primary activities that this role will be accountable for? 
 Execute and coordinate regional inbound and interplant leaf logistics flows into factories, covering multiple production sites.
 Control daytoday factoryfacing execution, including delivery sequencing, receiving alignment, and exception handling across sites.
¢ Track inbound leaf movements (milestones, ETAs, delivery status) and proactively identify and manage delays, risks, shortages, or receipt issues impacting factory supply.
¢ Coordinate delivery scheduling and receiving alignment, including ensuring receiving windows or delivery slots are secured and respected, where applicable.
¢ Support rapid resolution of inbound execution issues by executing recovery actions and escalating where thresholds are exceeded.
¢ Maintain accurate execution updates and inputs for regional inbound performance reporting
¢ Ensure import customs documentation is complete, accurate and aligned with inbound execution timelines and compliance requirements.
 What are the core decisions that this role will be accountable for? 
¢ Execution decisions related to factorylevel inbound coordination across the region.
¢ Selection of appropriate execution actions to resolve inbound delivery issues within defined priorities.
¢ Escalation of inbound factory risks or constraints to the Regional Inbound Logistics Lead.

description:
Company name : Wabtec Corporation Industry : Railways Position : Program Manager Location : Hosur Mission Key missions of the position: The Retrofit Program Manager is responsible for developing, leading, and executing retrofit and modernization programs across the installed customer base. Works cross-functionally with Engineering, Product Management, Supply Chain, Sales, Field Service, Warranty, and Customers to ensure successful launch & completion of retrofitment. Coordinate with Regional Service & Warranty leaders to ensure timely completion of retrofit activities. Responsibilities Roles and responsibility are as below : 1. Retrofitment Program Strategy & Development Develop, implement, and manage retrofit programs for the installed base across all product lines. Define program scope, deployment strategy, timelines, milestones, and resource requirements. Prepare business cases and white papers for management approval, including retrofit budgets and implementation plans. Responsible to maintain complete database of the existing Population of all our product lines. 2. Program Execution: Lead end-to-end execution of retrofit programs from concept through deployment. Review FMI Document and work with Safety team for HIRA assessment prior to implementation. Collaborate with Field Service teams to develop deployment plans and ensure successful retrofit execution at customer sites. Develop deployment methodologies, technical documentation, training materials, and service procedures. Work with Engg. /PED/Sourcing team for special tool development/procurement related to retrofitment programs 3. Retrofit Material Order Planning & Execution: Plan initial Float Stock requirements & Load Forecast order in the system for new retrofitment launch Periodically Review & update the forecast order in system based on the actual orders. Receive & Process retrofitment order request from FSEs and ensure demand creation in ERP. Coordinate with SCM and Operations teams to ensure on-time material availability and order fulfilment. Responsible to have full control on customer return material (MCO orders). 4. Customer Engagement: Act as the primary contact for strategic customers regarding retrofit initiatives. Publish Weekly/Monthly Retrofit completion Dashboards to Internal Management & Customers (RDSO & Private Car builders) Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction throughout program execution. 5. Safety, Quality, and Compliance: Ensure all work is performed in accordance with our organizations strict safety, quality, and compliance standards. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure all field deployment activities comply with applicable EHS requirements. Key KPIs: Retrofit HIRA Compliance (%): HIRA completed before deployment (Target 100%) Retrofit Completion Rate %: Commitment - As per Program Plan & Target - >95% Average Leadtime time to supply RR/Retrofit material: Commitment 30 days & Target - 20days Average Leadtime time for MCO closure: Commitment 30 days & Target 20 days Dashboard Reporting Compliance: Commitment – 95% & Target – 100%

 JD: 
 We are looking for a senior SAP ECC Controlling consultant with deep, hands-on product costing and project controlling expertise in a discrete manufacturing environment. The role covers make-to-stock (MTS), make-to-order (MTO) and engineer-to-order (ETO) scenarios using production orders, sales orders and WBS elements as cost objects. The consultant will own configuration, period-end processes and troubleshooting across product costing, results analysis (RA) and revenue recognition, settlement, CO-PA and actual costing. 
 Key Responsibilities Product Costing (MTS / MTO / ETO) Configure and support cost estimates: costing variants, valuation variants, costing sheets/overheads, cost component structures, standard cost release (CK11N/CK40N), sales-order and mixed costing. Run cost object controlling by period, by order and by sales order: WIP/RA, variance keys, target cost versions, variance categories (including scrap) and settlement profiles. Design MTO/ETO flows with sales orders and WBS as cost objects: requirement classes, account assignment categories, and valuated vs. non-valuated sales order/project stock. Project Controlling, Results Analysis & Revenue Recognition Configure results analysis: RA keys and versions, valuation methods (revenue-based and cost-based POC, completed contract, quantity-based), line IDs, cost/revenue assignment and posting rules, aligned to IFRS 15 / ASC 606. Configure settlement of WBS elements and sales orders to P&L, CO-PA and assets under construction: settlement profiles, allocation, source and PA transfer structures. Troubleshoot project financials: WIP and RA postings, POC revenue, COGS, reserves for unrealized costs, billing/revenue mismatches, settlement errors and FICO reconciliation. Overhead Management, Master Data & Period-End Close Maintain and govern CO master data: cost centers, cost elements, activity types, statistical key figures, internal orders, profit centers and hierarchies. Run and optimize CO period-end cycles: assessments, distributions, overhead calculation, actual activity price calculation, WIP/RA, variance calculation and order/project settlement. Profitability Analysis & Actual Costing Support CO-PA (costing-based and account-based): characteristics, value fields, valuation, derivation and variance flow from production and projects. Support Material Ledger and actual costing (CKMLCP): multilevel price determination, inventory and COGS revaluation, and analysis with CKM3N. Delivery & Stakeholder Management Lead requirement workshops, fit-gap analysis, functional specifications, testing (unit, integration, UAT), cut-over and hypercare. Work across FI, MM, SD, PP and PS teams; advise finance users and plant controllers; mentor junior consultants. 
 Required Skills & Experience 8+ years of hands-on SAP ECC 6.0 CO configuration and support, with at least 3 full-cycle implementations in discrete manufacturing. Proven configuration experience in product costing, cost object controlling, RA/revenue recognition for projects, and settlement. Solid understanding of cost accounting, inventory valuation, WIP and revenue recognition principles. Strong root-cause skills using CO reports and tables (COEP, COSP/COSS, COSB, CKMLHD/CKMLCR, ANLA, BSEG). Clear communicator, able to explain cost flows and postings to finance and operations stakeholders. 
 Preferred Qualifications SAP certification in Management Accounting / Controlling (ECC or S/4HANA). Exposure to SAP S/4HANA Finance (Universal Journal, event-based revenue recognition) or ECC-to-S/4 migration. Industry background in industrial machinery, aerospace and defense, automotive or high-tech ETO. CA / CMA / CPA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent.

title: Supply Chain Manager
description:
Location: Bangalore - Indraprastha, India Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. Present in India since 1953, Thales is headquartered in Noida and has other operational offices and sites spread across Delhi, Gurugram, Bengaluru and Mumbai, among others. Over 2200 employees are working with Thales and its joint ventures in India. Since the beginning, Thales has been playing an essential role in India s growth story by sharing its technologies and expertise in Defence, Aerospace and Cyber & Digital sectors. Thales has two engineering competence centres in India - one in Noida focused on Cyber & Digital business, while the one in Bengaluru focuses on hardware, software and systems engineering capabilities for both the civil and defence sectors, serving global needs. The Group has also established an MRO (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul) facility in Gurugram to provide comprehensive avionics maintenance and repair services to Indian airlines and support the growth of the local aviation industry. Greenfield Site Launch & Industrialization Lead the end-to-end Supply Chain workstream for the new plant start-up and industrialization. Build Supply Chain processes, systems, governance and organization from a greenfield environment. Develop the Supply Chain launch roadmap aligned with plant commissioning and production ramp-up milestones. Define and implement planning policies, inventory strategies, warehouse processes and logistics flows. Support New Product Introduction (NPI), industrial transfers and production readiness reviews. Recruit, train and develop the Supply Chain team required for production launch and growth. Establish operational KPIs, reporting cadence and governance mechanisms prior to SOP (Start of Production). Drive launch readiness reviews and manage supply chain-related risks during ramp-up. 
 1. Demand Planning & S&OP Translate customer demand, sales forecasts and program requirements into an integrated Supply Chain and Production Plan. Lead the monthly S&OP process in coordination with Sales, Program Management, Operations, Finance and Engineering. Identify demand-supply gaps, capacity constraints, material risks and recovery actions. Maintain a rolling 12-18 month supply and capacity outlook. Establish clear priorities based on customer requirements, program milestones and business objectives Design and implement the sites S&OP / IBP process, governance and decision-making framework. Establish demand, supply, inventory and capacity review cycles and escalation processes. Lead executive S&OP reviews during plant launch and production ramp-up phases. 
 2. Production Planning & Control Own the Master Production Schedule (MPS) and ensure alignment with available capacity, manpower, materials and customer demand. Optimize production loading across manufacturing lines and work centers. Ensure timely release and closure of Manufacturing Orders / Work Orders. Monitor plan adherence and drive corrective actions for deviations. Establish appropriate production lead times, safety stocks and planning parameters. Work closely with Production and Engineering to resolve bottlenecks and improve throughput. Manage demand, capacity and inventory trade-off decisions during ramp-up phases. 
 3. Material Planning & MRP Existing responsibilities plus: Own the MRP process and ensure availability of materials in line with the production plan. Monitor material shortages, long-lead items, critical components and supplier constraints. Establish and maintain accurate ERP planning parameters including: Lead times Lot sizes Safety stocks Reorder levels MOQ Supplier lead times Planning horizons Develop material risk dashboards and provide early-warning alerts. Drive shortage recovery plans with Procurement, Suppliers and Operations Define and deploy MRP planning policies, parameters and system governance from plant start-up through serial production. Validate material planning assumptions, safety stock strategies and inventory buffers required for launch readiness. 
 4. Procurement & Supplier Management Lead procurement planning in alignment with production and material requirements. Ensure timely release and follow-up of Purchase Orders / Purchase Requisitions. Monitor supplier OTD, quality, lead time and responsiveness. Establish supplier recovery plans for critical shortages and delayed deliveries. Identify and mitigate single-source and long-lead supplier risks. Work with Strategic Sourcing and Quality to develop alternate sources wherever required. Support supplier capacity assessments and supplier development initiatives. Validate supplier capacity against projected production growth requirements. Develop business continuity strategies for critical commodities and components. Support supplier localization and supply base development initiatives where appropriate. 
 5. Inventory Management Own factory inventory performance covering raw material, WIP and finished goods. Establish inventory targets based on demand, lead time, criticality and customer requirements. Drive reduction of: Excess inventory Obsolete inventory Slow-moving inventory Uncontrolled WIP Ensure inventory accuracy through cycle counting and robust inventory-control processes. Balance inventory investment vs. customer service and production continuity. 
 6. Warehouse & Logistics Existing responsibilities plus: Provide overall direction to stores, warehouse and material handling operations. Ensure timely material receipt, inspection, storage, kitting and issue to production. Establish FIFO/FEFO and appropriate storage controls where applicable. Ensure traceability and preservation of aerospace/defence materials. Optimize internal material movement and point-of-use availability. Coordinate finished-goods dispatches and logistics to achieve customer delivery commitments Design warehouse layout, storage concepts, inventory locations and material flow processes. Define inbound, internal and outbound logistics models for the site. Establish receiving, traceability, inventory-control and materials-management processes prior to launch. 
 Support implementation of traceability systems. Manage customs and import/export activities for materials, components, equipment and finished goods, ensuring compliance with applicable customs regulations and trade requirements. Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders and relevant internal functions to ensure timely customs clearance and minimize supply-chain disruptions. Establish customs documentation, classification, valuation and record-retention processes for import and export transactions. Monitor customs-related risks, duties, taxes, permits and regulatory requirements and drive timely resolution of exceptions. 7. ERP / Digital Supply Chain Existing responsibilities plus: Ensure high data integrity across ERP/MRP systems. Establish robust governance for: BOM Material master Routings Lead times Planning parameters Purchase orders Production orders Inventory records Drive digitalization of supply-chain dashboards and performance monitoring. Improve planning accuracy through data analytics and automation. Lead Supply Chain requirements definition for ERP/MRP implementation and deployment. Define planning master data structures, transaction governance and reporting requirements. Validate BOMs, routings, inventory policies and planning parameters prior to ERP go-live. Lead Supply Chain User Acceptance Testing (UAT), training and stabilization activities. Ensure ERP/MRP readiness and data integrity prior to production launch. 
 8. Risk Management & Business Continuity Establish a Supply Chain Risk Management framework covering critical materials, suppliers, logistics and capacity. Escalate risks early with clear impact, mitigation and recovery actions. Develop launch-specific risk mitigation plans covering suppliers, material availability, capacity constraints, systems readiness and logistics. Manage greenfield supply chain risk registers and drive closure of critical launch risks. 
 9. Continuous Improvement Lead Supply Chain improvement initiatives using Lean, Kaizen, PDCA, VSM and data-driven problem solving. Improve: Planning accuracy Inventory turns Supplier OTD Material availability Production plan adherence Lead time OTIF Supply Chain cost Establish standard work and governance across the Supply Chain organization. 
 10. Product Launch, NPI & Industrial Transfers Support New Product Introduction (NPI), engineering changes and industrial transfer programs. Ensure planning and procurement readiness for prototype, pilot, qualification and serial production phases. Coordinate with Engineering, Quality and Program Management to ensure launch readiness. Support customer audits, FAI/PPAP activities and production qualification requirements where applicable. 
 Candidate Profile Education : Bachelor s degree in engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Industrial Engineering or equivalent. Masters degree / MBA in Supply Chain Management, Operations or Business Administration preferred. Experience 10-15 years of experience in Supply Chain / Operations / Production Planning in a manufacturing environment. Experience in aerospace & defence, electronics, electrical, precision engineering or other high-reliability manufacturing is preferred. Proven experience managing a factory-level supply chain organization. 
 Experience in a greenfield / ramp-up environment would be an advantage Proven experience leading Supply Chain activities in a greenfield manufacturing facility, plant start-up, industrial transfer, major ERP implementation or production ramp-up environment. Demonstrated experience establishing planning, procurement, warehouse and logistics processes from a greenfield or start-up environment. Demonstrated success in achieving production readiness, launch readiness and operational stabilization during plant ramp-up. Technical Competencies Existing competencies plus: S&OP / IBP MPS / MRP Production Planning & Control Material Planning Procurement Inventory Management Warehouse Management Supplier Management Capacity Planning ERP / MRP / PLM systems Advanced Excel / Power BI or equivalent analytics tools Lean Manufacturing / Six Sigma Greenfield Plant Launch & Start-Up Industrialization & Manufacturing Ramp-Up Project Management Program Management Change Management ERP Deployment & Go-Live Master Data Governance Launch Readiness & Operational Readiness Reviews New Product Introduction (NPI) 
 Leadership Competencies Existing competencies plus: Strong analytical and problem-solving capability Ability to manage cross-functional teams Strong stakeholder-management skills Ability to operate in a high growth / high-pressure manufacturing environment Strong execution discipline Data-driven decision making Excellent communication and escalation management Ability to build and develop Supply Chain teams Proven ability to build Supply Chain organizations, processes and governance from the ground up. Experience recruiting, developing and scaling Supply Chain teams during periods of rapid growth. Strong project leadership and cross-functional execution capabilities. Ability to lead through uncertainty, ambiguity and changing business priorities typical of greenfield environments. 
 Strong capability to balance launch objectives with operational performance requirements.

title: Senior Manager- International Logistics operations
description:
Job Overview We are seeking a seasoned, high-caliber logistics leader for the role of Senior Manager – Cross-Border Operations. Based out of our Gurgaon headquarters, you will lead end-to-end international logistics operations for Delhivery, overseeing cross-border import and export shipments across key global trade lanes. This is a strategic and execution-intensive role. You will spearhead the expansion of our international freight network by launching new country corridors and deferred air economy products, while driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. This position owns P&L, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency for both air and ocean freight verticals. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End International Logistics Operations Lead end-to-end international logistics operations, managing and optimizing cross-border import and export shipments across global trade lanes. Supervise daily workflows for inbound and outbound cargo, ensuring smooth execution across origin handling, international linehaul, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery. Implement robust monitoring systems to track shipments, proactively resolve operational exceptions, and ensure high on-time delivery rates. 2. Network Expansion & Product Development Spearhead the physical and operational expansion of Delhivery's international freight network by identifying and launching new country corridors. Design, launch, and scale deferred air economy products to offer competitive, cost-effective cross-border shipping options to e-commerce, SME, and enterprise clients. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational readiness criteria for all newly launched corridors and lanes. 3. Strategic Partnerships & Carrier Management Identify, negotiate with, and onboard key global partners, including freight forwarders, customs house agents (CHAs), customs brokers, and commercial airlines/ocean carriers. Build and maintain strong strategic alliances to secure capacity commitments, preferential rate structures, and reliable transit times during peak and non-peak seasons. Manage partner performance SLAs, conducting regular reviews to ensure compliance with Delhivery's high operational standards. 4. P&L & SLA Compliance Management Take complete financial ownership of the Air and Ocean freight verticals, managing P&L, cost optimization, and overall unit economics (e.g., cost-per-kilogram and route margins). Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Transit Turnaround Time (TAT), On-Time Delivery (OTD), Customs Clearance timelines, and first-contact dispute resolution. Control and minimize operational exceptions such as terminal storage costs, demurrage, detention fees, and flight offloads. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Tech Enablement Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Sales, Business Development, Technology, and Legal/Compliance to support business growth and process standardization. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable, automated, and technology-driven processes for tracking, billing, and customs documentation. Ensure 100% adherence to international trade laws, customs regulations, aviation security standards, and safety compliances. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience & Education Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or Post-Graduate degree is highly preferred. Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, or cross-border e-commerce shipping. Leadership: Minimum of 3+ years in a senior supervisory or managerial role directly overseeing air/ocean freight operations, partner management, or international linehaul. Core Competencies Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of air/ocean freight operations, global trade lanes, Incoterms 2020, customs clearance regulations, and HAWB/MAWB rules (aligned with our Global Air Freight Operations). Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing P&L, negotiating complex commercial contracts, and optimizing unit economics. Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets for tracking operations, data analysis, and building performance dashboards. Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Exceptional negotiation and relationship-building skills to manage high-level partnerships across multiple geographies. Problem-Solving: Strong critical-thinking and crisis-management abilities to handle transit disruptions, customs bottlenecks, and capacity constraints in a high-pressure environment.

title: Purchase Executive
description:
Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Purchase professional for our pharmaceutical manufacturing company. The candidate will be responsible for sourcing pharmaceutical raw materials, packaging materials, and other required items, vendor development and qualification, price negotiation, purchase order management, and ensuring timely procurement while maintaining quality and regulatory requirements. 
 Role & responsibilities 1. Purchase & Procurement Handle end-to-end procurement of pharmaceutical raw materials, packaging materials, and other required items. Prepare and release purchase orders as per approved requirements. Ensure timely availability of materials according to production and inventory requirements. Coordinate with internal departments to understand material specifications and purchase requirements. 2. Vendor Development & Qualification Identify, evaluate, and develop new vendors and suppliers. Coordinate vendor qualification and approval in consultation with QA/QC and other relevant departments. Maintain an approved vendor list and vendor-related documentation. Monitor vendor performance in terms of quality, price, delivery, and service. 3. Technical Documentation & Compliance Basic understand and review DME (Drug Master File/Drug Master Documentation, as applicable), COA (Certificate of Analysis), and MOA (Method of Analysis). Coordinate with QA/QC for technical documents and material specifications. Ensure the availability of required quality documents for pharmacopeial and non-pharmacopeial materials. Follow company procurement procedures and applicable pharmaceutical quality requirements. 4. Vendor Search & Selection Criteria Search for suitable vendors based on: Distance and location Price and commercial terms Lead time and delivery commitments Quality standards and documentation Compare quotations and negotiate prices to achieve cost-effective procurement. Evaluate alternative suppliers to ensure uninterrupted material availability. 5. Coordination & Reporting Coordinate with Production, QA, QC, Stores, Accounts, and other relevant departments. Track purchase orders, pending deliveries, and material shortages. Maintain purchase records, quotations, comparative statements, and vendor databases. Prepare purchase-related MIS reports as require 
 Preferred candidate profile Graduate in a relevant discipline; a science or pharmacy background will be preferred. 34 years of experience in purchase/procurement, preferably in the pharmaceutical industry. Knowledge of pharmaceutical raw materials, packaging materials, and vendor qualification. Understanding of COA, MOA, and pharmacopeial/non-pharmacopeial materials. Good negotiation, communication, vendor-management, and coordination skills. Proficiency in MS Excel and purchase-related documentation

Develop products that address specific customer and farm-level challenges. 
 2. Herbal Extract & Phytogenic Formulation Identify suitable herbs and botanical ingredients based on their nutritional and functional benefits. Develop and optimise herbal extracts and phytogenic formulations for animal nutrition applications. Work on combinations/synergies of multiple botanical extracts to achieve targeted nutritional or physiological benefits. Develop suitable dosage forms and delivery systems for incorporation into feed or drinking-water applications, wherever applicable. Optimise formulations for efficacy, stability, palatability, compatibility and cost-effectiveness. 
 3. R&D Trials & Efficacy Validation Design and execute laboratory, in-vitro and field-level trials for developed products. Coordinate with veterinarians, animal nutritionists, farms, universities and external research organisations for product validation. Evaluate parameters such as growth rate, feed conversion, milk yield, egg production, gut health, immunity and other relevant performance indicators. Analyse trial data and use findings to improve product formulations. Generate technical and scientific evidence supporting product efficacy. 
 4. New Product Development Lead the complete NPD cycle from concept ingredient selection formulation laboratory trials field validation scale-up commercialisation. Conduct market and competitor analysis to identify product gaps and opportunities. Convert customer requirements into differentiated product concepts. Develop product specifications, formulations, application guidelines and technical dossiers. Identify opportunities for customised products for specific animal species or applications. 
 5. Commercialisation & Scale-Up Work closely with Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory, Sales and Business Development teams. Transfer successful laboratory formulations to pilot and commercial manufacturing. Optimise processes for extraction, blending, drying and formulation. Support product costing and commercial feasibility. Provide technical support during customer trials, sampling and product launch. Troubleshoot product and process issues during scale-up and commercial production. 
 6. Technical & Regulatory Support Ensure products comply with applicable animal feed, feed additive and animal nutrition regulations. Develop raw-material and finished-product specifications. Establish quality parameters for botanical extracts and finished formulations. Prepare technical dossiers, product specifications, COAs and supporting scientific documentation. Support regulatory submissions and customer technical requirements. 
 7. Technical Marketing & Customer Support Develop technical literature, product brochures, presentations and application guides. Work with Sales and Marketing to communicate product benefits effectively. Support customer meetings and technical discussions. Present product science and trial results to customers and channel partners. Track emerging trends in phytogenic feed additives, herbal animal nutrition and natural alternatives to conventional feed additives.

title: Supply Chain & Commercial
description:
Job Summary To manage the overall supply chain and commercial activities with a strong focus on cost optimization, vendor evaluation, procurement efficiency and expenditure control. 
 The individual will be responsible for analyzing the company's spending on consumables, identifying cost-saving opportunities, evaluating vendors on commercial and technical parameters, negotiating competitive rates and ensuring procurement decisions deliver the best value to the organization. 
 Role & responsibilities A. Commercial Management & Cost Optimisation Analyse overall expenditure on consumables, raw materials, stores and other indirect procurement categories. Monitor monthly and annual spending patterns and identify areas of unnecessary expenditure. Develop cost-saving strategies through price benchmarking, negotiation and vendor consolidation. Conduct cost-benefit analysis before finalising major procurement decisions. Track price fluctuations and understand their impact on overall manufacturing costs. Establish commercial controls to ensure procurement within approved budgets. Identify opportunities for reducing procurement costs without compromising quality. 
 B. Vendor Evaluation & Development Identify, evaluate and develop vendors based on price, quality, delivery, service and reliability. Conduct comparative analysis of vendor quotations and prepare commercial evaluation statements. Regularly benchmark existing vendor rates against market prices. Develop a structured vendor rating and performance evaluation system. Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods and other commercial conditions. Identify alternate vendors to reduce dependency on existing suppliers. Conduct periodic vendor performance reviews and recommend corrective actions. 
 C. Consumables & Inventory Cost Control Monitor consumption of consumables such as refractories, sand, chemicals, ferroalloys, grinding wheels, cutting tools, welding consumables, lubricants and other foundry-related materials. Analyse consumption against production volumes and establish consumption norms. Identify abnormal consumption, wastage and potential leakages. Compare consumption trends across departments, production lines or plants. Work closely with Production, Maintenance, Quality and Stores teams to optimise material utilisation. Ensure appropriate inventory levels while minimising excess and non-moving stock. Develop MIS reports for consumption, procurement costs and inventory ageing. 
 D. Supply Chain & Procurement Management Ensure timely procurement of materials as per production and operational requirements. Develop procurement plans in coordination with respective departments. Monitor purchase orders, delivery schedules and supplier commitments. Improve procurement processes and ensure adherence to approved procurement policies. Coordinate with Stores for stock reconciliation, reorder levels and material availability. Ensure transparency and compliance in the entire procurement cycle. 
 E. MIS & Commercial Reporting Prepare monthly reports on procurement expenditure and category-wise spending. Develop vendor-wise and material-wise price comparison reports. Track cost savings achieved through negotiations and alternate sourcing. Prepare consumption variance reports against established norms. Monitor budget versus actual procurement expenditure. Present periodic commercial performance reports to management.

Key Skills: Procurement planning,Procurement management,Vendor,Vendor Development,Materials,Supply chain,Management,Commercial management

Location : Carnival Infopark, Phase 2 , Kakkanad, Ernakulam
Job Type : Onsite
Shift Timing : 11 AM - 8 PM About the company 
NewAgeSysIT , a division of NewAgeSys, Inc. established in 1994, based at New Jersey, specializes in mobile app development and consulting, helping clients maximize the reach and effectiveness of their business by leveraging the latest technology. Being a full service mobile and web development firm, NewAgeSMB focuses on servicing clients across North America, UK, Europe, Middle East, Singapore and Australia. We accomplish this by creating a long-term relationship with our clients, from brainstorming the initial idea, strategizing the project plan, building and deploying cost effective solutions with a solid foundation of support and maintenance. Role Overview 
We are looking for an experienced Content Editor to review and refine our business, technical, and marketing content. The role also includes evaluating supporting visuals for relevance and communication effectiveness. Key Responsibilities

Improve content flow, messaging, and tone to better engage the target audience.
Identify unclear, repetitive, or ineffective content and suggest improvements.
Ensure consistency with brand voice and professional communication standards.
Content Types Covered
Website pages, landing pages, and blog articles
Newsletters and client announcement emails
Case studies, white papers, and industry reports
Marketing collateral and other business communications Visual Content Review 
Assess the relevance and effectiveness of images, graphics, illustrations, and videos accompanying the content.
Evaluate how well visuals complement the message and connect with the intended audience.
Recommend improvements to visual presentation, including color schemes, background, tone, or image selection where appropriate.
Suggest alternative visual concepts when existing visuals do not effectively support the content.
Graphic design, image editing, and video production are not required. Required Skills Experience 
Proven experience in professional copy editing, proofreading, or content editing.
Ability to refine content for clarity, engagement, and audience relevance.
Experience with B2B, technology, or professional services content is preferred.
Good editorial judgment and a basic understanding of visual communication. Role Expectations 
The candidate should deliver polished, publication-ready content with clear editorial suggestions and actionable feedback on supporting visuals, within mutually agreed timelines. Our Expectation: We are looking for someone who goes beyond grammar correction and can critically evaluate how effectively both written and visual content communicate the intended message to the audience.

title: Assistant Manager
description:
*Assistant Manager Call Centre Operations* 
 Department: CSD Customer Support Department Reporting To: Senior Manager Experience: 5-9 Years Qualification: Bachelors Degree Mandatory 
 *Job Purpose* 
 The Assistant Manager Call Centre Operations will be responsible for managing overall call centre operations, driving sales and revenue targets, improving team productivity, ensuring service quality, and delivering a strong customer experience across inbound, outbound and chat operations. 
 *Key Responsibilities* 
 *1. Sales & Revenue Management* Drive daily, weekly and monthly sales and revenue targets. 
 Monitor conversion, booking rate, lead utilization and revenue per agent. Analyse performance trends and implement corrective actions. Ensure effective lead management and minimize lead leakage. 
 *2. Team Management* Lead and manage Team Leaders, Quality Analysts, Trainers and Customer Care Executives. Conduct regular performance reviews, coaching and feedback sessions. Manage attendance, rosters, shrinkage, productivity and attrition. Identify training requirements and support performance improvement/PIPs. 
 *3. Call Centre Operations* Manage inbound, outbound and chat operations. Ensure achievement of service levels, productivity and operational targets. Ensure adherence to SOPs, quality standards and compliance requirements. Drive process improvement and operational efficiency. 
 *4. CRM & Dialer Management* Manage CRM and dialer operations, including campaign setup and optimization. Monitor contact rate, connectivity, abandonment and dialer productivity. Ensure accurate lead allocation, disposition and CRM data. Coordinate with IT/technology teams for system issues and enhancements. 
 *5. MIS & Analytics* Review and analyse daily, weekly and monthly MIS reports. Prepare dashboards and management reports using advanced Excel. Track trends, forecasts, variances and team performance. Present actionable insights during management reviews. 
 *6. Customer Experience* Drive customer satisfaction and service quality. Monitor customer complaints and escalations. Improve FCR and reduce customer complaints through corrective actions. Ensure quality customer interactions and process adherence. 
 *7. Cross-Functional Coordination* Coordinate with HR, IT, MIS, QA, Marketing, CRM and Vendor Management teams. Support UAT, automation and process improvement initiatives. Work with external vendors/partners to ensure smooth operations. 
 *Key KPIs* 
 Sales & Revenue: Revenue Achievement, Sales Target, Conversion Rate, Lead-to-Sale Ratio, Booking Rate, Revenue/Agent, AOV. Productivity: Calls Handled, Calls/Agent, Login Hours, Occupancy, Utilization, Adherence, Shrinkage and Attrition. Quality & Customer: Quality Score, Compliance Score, CSAT, NPS, FCR, Complaint Ratio and Escalation %. Telephony: Service Level, ASA, AHT, Talk Time, Hold Time, ACW, Abandonment Rate, Contact Rate and RPC. Outbound: Connect Rate, Lead Utilization, Follow-up Compliance, Callback Achievement, Campaign Effectiveness and TAT. 
 *Technical Skills* Strong knowledge of Call Centre/Contact Centre Operations. Hands-on experience with CRM and Dialer platforms. Advanced MS Excel – Pivot Tables, XLOOKUP, Power Query, Dashboards; VBA/Macros preferred. Strong MIS, data analysis and reporting skills. Good knowledge of Workforce Management. Experience in process automation and continuous improvement. 
 *Preferred Industry Experience* Healthcare, Diagnostics, BPO, BFSI, E-commerce or Insurance Call Centre experience will be preferred.

title: Technical Instructional Designer
description:
The Opportunity We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Content & Training Designer to join our Service Strategy & Enablement team. This role is responsible for creating high-quality training materials, scalable digital learning experiences, and technical documentation that educate and enable our global support teams, partners, and customers. This position plays a critical role in developing content designed for both human and machine consumption-ensuring our knowledge assets are structured, discoverable, and optimized for efficient delivery across platforms. As a key contributor within our Global Support Organization, you will execute against an established content and enablement strategy, translating priorities into clear, effective technical and training assets. The primary focus of this role is designing, developing, and delivering high-quality video-based learning and enablement content that improves support agent readiness, accelerates issue resolution, and enhances the overall customer experience. This role blends hands-on content creation with close cross-functional collaboration, working alongside support teams, product experts, and customer experience partners to ensure content is accurate, relevant, and aligned with customer and business needs. 

 About the Team The Service Strategy & Enablement Technical Training team at Nutanix is a globally distributed team dedicated to ensuring the Support organization is effectively onboarded and continuously enabled on Nutanix products and features. The team is instrumental in empowering support engineers to confidently support customers by delivering high-quality, timely training and enablement content, 

 This role reports to the Senior Manager, Service Strategy & Enablement - Technical Training. Collaboration is strongly encouraged, and while the team works closely together, individuals are trusted with a high degree of autonomy. The team is a highly productive, cohesive group where contributions are valued, ideas are shared openly, and every member is motivated to deliver their best work. If you are looking for a team-oriented environment that values collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement, the Service Strategy & Enablement team at Nutanix may be an excellent fit. 

 Key Responsibilities Content Development & Technical Writing Create clear, accurate, and user-friendly technical documentation, videos, guides, and troubleshooting content. Develop digital training assets, including eLearning modules, instructional videos, job aids, quick reference guides, and knowledge base articles. Translate complex technical concepts into accessible, consumable learning materials for diverse audiences. Instructional Design Design and maintain scalable training curricula for support teams, partners, and internal stakeholders. Collaborate with subject matter experts (SMEs) to create scenario-based learning and real-world practice activities. Measure training effectiveness and continuously iterate content based on data, feedback, and performance insights. AI-Ready Knowledge Engineering Structure content to support ingestion into AI-driven and self-service platforms. Partner with AI and Knowledge Management teams to standardize content formats, metadata, and tagging. Ensure documentation aligns with evolving automation, self-service, and intelligent support strategies. Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment Work closely with Support, Product, Engineering, and Partner Enablement teams to ensure training materials are accurate, current, and aligned with product changes. Gather requirements, align on learning objectives, and manage the full content lifecycle from creation through maintenance. Participate in project planning and contribute to broader enablement initiatives. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in technical writing, instructional design, technical training, or content development within the technology or Support domain (8+ years preferred). Experience with AI tools for helping to create content. Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, actionable, and engaging content for technical audiences. Strong experience designing and delivering digital learning assets, including eLearning modules, instructional videos, job aids, and knowledge base content. Hands-on experience with eLearning and video creation tools (e. g. , Synthesia, Articulate Rise and Storyline 360), including video editing platforms with Generative AI capabilities. Expertise in documentation and collaboration tools such as Confluence, SharePoint, markdown editors, or similar platforms. Familiarity with learning management systems (LMS), learning content management systems (LCMS), and enterprise knowledge bases. Strong storytelling, scriptwriting, and instructional design skills, with an emphasis on simplifying technical material. Demonstrated ability to create accessible, globally scalable content (e. g. , captions, subtitles, localization readiness). Strong organizational, and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and meet deadlines. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills with a track record of effectively collaborating across cross-functional teams. Attention to detail and a consistent focus on delivering high-quality, well-governed content. Ability to influence outcomes through collaboration and demonstrated results. Bachelor s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Certifications in instructional design, video production, or related disciplines are a plus. Preferred Qualifications Experience designing content for support organizations or technical audiences. Working knowledge of customer support tools and analytics platforms (e. g. , Salesforce Service Cloud, Confluence). Ability to structure content for AI ingestion, search optimization, and self-service flows. Understanding of customer support workflows, troubleshooting processes, or SaaS environments. Experience with metadata, tagging standards, and content governance models. UX writing, graphic design, and animation experience is a plus. Professional Photo Retouching: Perform high-quality photo manipulation, background removal, object replacement, colour correction, lighting adjustments, shadow creation, and realistic image compositing. Visual Quality Inspection: Identify missing elements, image distortions, unnatural details, alignment issues, and visual inconsistencies before final delivery. Creative Design: Develop visually appealing social media creatives, promotional graphics, marketing banners, advertisements, and product visuals. AI Prompting Skills: Write and refine effective AI image-generation prompts to achieve accurate and consistent visual outputs. Quality Control: Ensure every design meets client requirements, brand guidelines, and professional quality standards. Work Tracking Reporting: Maintain daily work sheets using Excel or Google Sheets, including assigned tasks, progress, revisions, deadlines, and delivery status. Communication Coordination: Communicate clearly in English, understand project briefs, coordinate with team members, and provide timely work updates. Timely Delivery: Handle multiple projects efficiently while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and deadlines. Required Skills Expertise Graphic Design Photo Editing Advanced Adobe Photoshop skills (mandatory). Strong expertise in photo retouching and image manipulation. Product photo editing and realistic compositing. Background removal, object replacement, and image enhancement. Excellent understanding of lighting, shadows, perspective, proportions, and colour matching. AI Image Editing Generation Hands-on experience with AI image generation and editing tools. Familiarity with tools such as ChatGPT Image Generation, Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, or similar platforms. Strong AI prompting and image refinement skills. Ability to correct AI-generated image errors while preserving original product details. Experience creating photorealistic product and marketing visuals. Attention to Detail Quality Exceptional observation and visual comparison skills. Ability to identify small inaccuracies in edited images. Strong understanding of product accuracy and brand consistency. Ability to deliver polished, realistic, high-resolution images. Communication Work Management Good written and verbal English communication. Ability to understand English design briefs and revision instructions. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for daily work tracking. Strong organisational and time management skills. Ability to work independently and meet deadlines. Experience Qualifications Minimum 3 4 years of professional graphic design experience. Proven experience in advanced Photoshop editing and photo manipulation. Practical experience with AI image editing and generation tools. Previous experience with product photography editing, advertising creatives, or digital marketing design is preferred. A strong portfolio demonstrating photo retouching, product manipulation, AI image editing, and creative design work is mandatory. What We Are Looking For We want a designer who does not just create attractive images but also thinks critically, notices what others miss, and ensures every detail is accurate. The ideal candidate should be able to look at an AI-generated image and immediately identify: What is missing compared to the original product Which product details have been changed incorrectly Are the proportions, perspective, lighting, and shadows realistic Does the final image meet the original brief and quality expectations Accuracy, creativity, attention to detail, and accountability are essential for this role.

title: Content Editor (Copy Editing & Visual Review)
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION Job Title : Content Editor (Copy Editing Visual Review)
Company Name : NewAgeSys IT, (a division of NewAgeSys)
Location : Carnival Infopark, Phase 2 , Kakkanad, Ernakulam
Job Type : Onsite
Shift Timing : 11 AM - 8 PM About the company 
NewAgeSysIT , a division of NewAgeSys, Inc. established in 1994, based at New Jersey, specializes in mobile app development and consulting, helping clients maximize the reach and effectiveness of their business by leveraging the latest technology. Being a full service mobile and web development firm, NewAgeSMB focuses on servicing clients across North America, UK, Europe, Middle East, Singapore and Australia. We accomplish this by creating a long-term relationship with our clients, from brainstorming the initial idea, strategizing the project plan, building and deploying cost effective solutions with a solid foundation of support and maintenance. Role Overview 
We are looking for an experienced Content Editor to review and refine our business, technical, and marketing content. The primary objective is to improve clarity, readability, tone, and messaging while ensuring the content effectively communicates with its intended audience. The role also includes evaluating supporting visuals for relevance and communication effectiveness. Key Responsibilities 
Content Editing Proofreading
Proofread content for grammar, spelling, punctuation, and consistency.
Refine language, sentence structure, and readability while preserving the original meaning.
Improve content flow, messaging, and tone to better engage the target audience.
Identify unclear, repetitive, or ineffective content and suggest improvements.
Ensure consistency with brand voice and professional communication standards.
Content Types Covered
Website pages, landing pages, and blog articles
Newsletters and client announcement emails
Case studies, white papers, and industry reports
Marketing collateral and other business communications Visual Content Review 
Assess the relevance and effectiveness of images, graphics, illustrations, and videos accompanying the content.
Evaluate how well visuals complement the message and connect with the intended audience.
Recommend improvements to visual presentation, including color schemes, background, tone, or image selection where appropriate.
Suggest alternative visual concepts when existing visuals do not effectively support the content.
Graphic design, image editing, and video production are not required. Required Skills Experience 
Proven experience in professional copy editing, proofreading, or content editing.
Ability to refine content for clarity, engagement, and audience relevance.
Experience with B2B, technology, or professional services content is preferred.
Good editorial judgment and a basic understanding of visual communication. Role Expectations 
The candidate should deliver polished, publication-ready content with clear editorial suggestions and actionable feedback on supporting visuals, within mutually agreed timelines. Our Expectation: We are looking for someone who goes beyond grammar correction and can critically evaluate how effectively both written and visual content communicate the intended message to the audience.

Mandatory Technical Skills Aruba ClearPass NAC - Deployment, Configuration & Troubleshooting RADIUS Authentication Active Directory Integration 802.1X and Network Authentication Methods DHCP LAN/WAN Networking Firewalls, Switches, Routers & Wireless Access Points Network Monitoring & Troubleshooting Incident Management & Root Cause Analysis Required Certifications Aruba Certified ClearPass Associate (ACCA) / Aruba Certified ClearPass Professional (ACCP) Aruba Certified Professional - Network Security (ACP-NS) Candidates must meet the certification requirements specified above. *Strong understanding of engineering drawings, technical detailing, and design coordination.

Should have an eye for detail. You must be a good communicator and speak and write fluently in English. Flatirons Offers An exciting job in a global atmosphere working with state-of-the-art technology, talented, dedicated, and experienced colleagues, and world-class, technology-driven customers. Assist in planning and executing employee events, including logistics, refreshments, venue setup, and communication. Contribute to initiatives that promote a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Support employee experience programs and workplace engagement activities. Act as a point of contact for employee-related administrative support and workplace queries. 
 Workplace Operations & Administration Ensure office premises are clean, organized, and presentable at all times. Monitor and maintain reception areas, meeting rooms, pantry, and common spaces to company standards. Maintain visitor registers and ensure accurate recording of visitor entry and exit details. Welcome and assist visitors, guests, and external stakeholders in a professional manner. Coordinate visitor access and meeting arrangements with relevant internal teams.
