Track vendor service requests and ensure timely resolution of workplace-related issues. Coordinate with housekeeping, facility service providers, and vendors to ensure smooth workplace operations. Support day-to-day administrative and operational requirements across departments. Assist in organizing internal meetings, training sessions, and company activities.

Monitor and maintain stock levels of stationery, pantry supplies, office consumables, and workplace essentials. Coordinate procurement and replenishment of supplies to ensure uninterrupted workplace operations. Coordinate with vendors for the procurement and timely delivery of office supplies, pantry consumables, and workplace essentials. Monitor vendor performance and escalate service-related concerns when required. Receive, organize, and maintain inventory records and stock movement.

title: IT&DATA Sr. Product Analyst Finance Accounting
description:
Job Summary Support the Product Owner by acting as the senior functional bridge between Finance business stakeholders and SAP delivery teams for the Finance Accounting and Master Data scope. The role protects and evolves the Themis Finance core model by independently challenging and validating functional designs, configuration decisions, integrations, testing and deployment deliverables. It addresses the current internal capability gap by bringing practical SAP Finance deployment expertise into the Product Team, retaining critical knowledge internally and reducing dependency on external experts. This is an L8 role because it requires experienced judgement, autonomy and the authority to validate complex work with global and cross-process impact. Responsibilities Core responsibilities Translate complex business and process requirements into clear functional expectations, user stories, acceptance criteria and validation guardrails. Protect the Themis Finance core model by assessing proposed changes against global design principles, harmonisation objectives and long-term product sustainability. Lead functional impact assessments across processes, company codes, master data, interfaces and connected SAP modules. Review defects, incidents and enhancement proposals, identify root causes and recommend sustainable solutions rather than local workarounds. Support deployment and integration projects through design review, testing strategy, cutover readiness, knowledge transfer and post-go-live stabilisation. Maintain decision records and functional documentation so critical Themis and Master Data knowledge remains inside the organisation. Stakeholder collaboration responsibilities Act as the missing bridge between Finance business stakeholders and technical or configuration teams, ensuring that business intent and SAP implications are understood on both sides. Facilitate solution discussions, challenge external partners constructively and communicate decisions, impacts, risks and trade-offs clearly. Collaborate with Finance Design Authority, DBS Record to Report and Master Data teams, other Finance Product Teams, Chapter experts, project teams and AMS providers. Coach Product Analysts and contribute to stronger internal SAP Finance capability and consistent validation practices. Technical Requirement Deep knowledge of Themis or another global SAP Finance core model. title: Software Engineer (Data & AIML)
description:
About the Role We are looking for an experienced Data, AI/ML, GenAI Agentic AI Engineer to help design and build this platform from the ground up. This role combines data engineering, software engineering, AI/ML and architecture. You will build reusable platform capabilities rather than one-off solutions and work closely with engineers, data scientists, architects, product teams and supply-chain experts. What You Will Do Design and build scalable data and AI architecture for data-intensive systems. Build trusted data foundations and reusable data products from multiple sources. Build reliable batch, streaming and near-real-time data pipelines based on business needs. Enable data democratization and self-service access to trusted data. Build capabilities for data quality, governance, lineage, metadata, security and observability. Establish common business context and semantics so data can be effectively used by applications, ML models, GenAI and AI agents. Develop and productionise ML solutions for prediction, forecasting, risk, anomaly detection, recommendations and optimisation. Build production-grade GenAI/LLM solutions using approaches such as RAG, embeddings, vector search and tool calling. Build agentic AI solutions that can reason over trusted data, use tools and APIs, provide recommendations and take actions. Design appropriate guardrails, access controls, monitoring and human oversight for AI and agentic solutions. Build reusable APIs, services and workflows that connect data, applications and AI capabilities. Use platforms such as Pipedream or similar workflow tools where they add value. Make architecture and technology decisions considering scalability, reliability, security, performance and cost. Establish strong engineering practices including testing, CI/CD and observability. Contribute to architecture reviews, technical design and code reviews. Mentor engineers and help establish engineering and architecture standards. About You We are looking for someone with strong engineering, data and AI fundamentals who can build production-ready systems. You should have: 4+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI/ML engineering or a related field. Experience designing and building scalable, distributed and data-intensive systems. Experience contributing to or owning architecture and technical design for data or AI platforms. Strong programming skills in Java and Python. Experience with Scala, Kotlin or similar languages is a plus. Strong understanding of data architecture, data modelling, distributed systems and data processing. Experience building data pipelines, data products or data platforms at scale. Experience with technologies such as Kafka, Spark, Databricks, Flink or equivalent. Experience with relational and/or NoSQL databases Good understanding of data quality, governance, metadata, lineage and observability. Hands-on experience taking ML models from development to production, including deployment, monitoring and evaluation. Experience with GenAI/LLMs and building practical, production-ready applications. Understanding of RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling and LLM evaluation. Experience or strong exposure to AI agents and agentic workflows. Understanding of AI security, guardrails, access control and human oversight. Experience with at least one cloud platform such as Azure, AWS or Google Cloud. Strong software engineering practices including automated testing, CI/CD and production operations. Strong communication and problem-solving skills. A platform mindset - focused on building reusable capabilities rather than one-off solutions. Good to Have Experience in logistics, shipping, transportation or supply chain. Experience with real-time and event-driven architectures. Experience with MLOps and model monitoring. Experience with production RAG, AI agents or agent orchestration. Experience with MCP or similar agent/tool integration patterns. Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic models or entity resolution. Experience with Pipedream or similar workflow/integration platforms. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures. Experience leading technical design or architecture for large-scale platforms. Why This Role This is a greenfield opportunity to help build the foundation for the next generation of supply-chain intelligence at Maersk. Our vision is: Data Foundation - Data Products Context - ML Intelligence - Recommendations - GenAI - Agentic AI. The data foundation is the core layer, providing trusted, reusable and contextualised data to products, ML models, GenAI applications and AI agents. The goal is to build a platform where new data and AI capabilities can be developed faster, reused across multiple use cases and scaled across the supply chain without repeatedly rebuilding the underlying foundation. You will help shape the architecture, data foundation, engineering practices and AI capabilities that will enable future digital supply-chain experiences at Maersk.

 Role Summary / Description
 
AI Powered Tech Talent

You will design scalable distributed training environments, model-serving foundations, automation patterns and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, cloud modernization, regulated workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust AWS-based AI infrastructure solutions.

 Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities.
 Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production.
 Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization.
 Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards.

description:
As a senior Systems Support Engineer you will play a critical role in ensuring the operational efficiency, stability and availability of complex application systems. You will contribute significantly to operational success, refine your expertise in incident management and DevOps and leave a lasting impact on the delivery of inventive solutions to our clients. 

 Job responsibilities 
 You will use your skills in incident management processes and tools, application monitoring metrics and tooling to generate reports and take corrective actions. You will understand complex application systems and find your way through them to debug a business impacting issue. You will follow standards and best practices to bring operational efficiencies, stability and availability of the system. You will use continuous delivery practices to evolve, support and deliver high-quality software, as well as value to end customers, as early as possible while working in a collaborative, value-driven teams to build innovative customer experiences for our clients. You will leverage your knowledge regarding the different logging techniques (various levels) and use them for alerting, monitoring and identifying the root cause of incidents. You will efficiently use DevOps tools and practices to deploy and run software. You will act as a mentor for less experienced peers through both your technical knowledge and leadership skills. You will apply the latest technology thinking from our to solve client problems. 

 Job qualifications 
 

 Technical Skills 
 You have experience working on programming languages Node and java , an understanding of cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP and scripting languages such as Python or Powershell. You have a high-level understanding of various architectures such as monolithic, N-tier, layered, microservices and serverless. You must possess strong debugging and triaging skills to troubleshoot code effectively. You have experience working with relational databases such as MS SQL, MySQL or PostgreSQL. You have experience working with containerization tools such as Docker and CI/CD tools such as Jenkins and Azure pipelines. You have experience working with relational or non-relational databases. You have an understanding of application monitoring tools such as DataDog, Prometheus or Grafana, the different metrics that go with it and are able to generate reports and take corrective actions. You have the ability to ensure that the deliverables, namely bug fixes and enhancements to the existing codebase, are high-quality and well-tested. You are comfortable with Agile methods, such as Scrum and/or Kanban. 

 Professional Skills 
 You enjoy influencing others and always advocate for technical excellence while being open to change, when needed. You have good communication and articulation skills. You have a presence in the external tech community and willingly share your expertise with others via speaking engagements, contributions to open source, blogs and more. You are resilient in ambiguous situations and can approach challenges from multiple perspectives. You advocate for and implement cloud best practices in the areas of resource optimization, monitoring and alerting. You advocate for security best practices and implementation of the same. You can guide and mentor junior-level consultants. You are willing to be part of a rotation- and need-based 24x7 available team. 

 Other things to know 
 

 Learning Development

We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.

 Curious about the role?

The ideal candidate must have a strong foundational background as an expert Data Science practitioner who has evolved into a strategic leader.

Core Algorithmic Design: Evaluate, select, and build appropriate Machine Learning and Deep Learning algorithms to ensure model accuracy, optimization, and statistical robustness.  Who do we expect ? 
 12+ years of total experience in data science, predictive modeling, or advanced analytics, having spent significant time as a hands-on, code-writing practitioners 5+ years of proven leadership experience managing, growing, and guiding specialized data science teams on production-level projects. Engineering & Scale: Strong hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP, or Snowflake), data pipelining, and operationalizing models via MLOps. Domain Track Record: Prior success in executing production projects within highly analytical sectors such as Retail, CPG or Manufacturing is highly desirable.

title: Opportunity For the Sales coordinator Role :: Sandu Pharmaceuticals Lt
description:
About Sandu Pharmaceuticals 
 Sandu Pharmaceuticals is a reputed name in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industry, with a legacy dating back to 1899. With over 125 years of experience, the company is committed to delivering quality healthcare solutions through its pharmaceutical and Ayurvedic product portfolio. 
 Job Summary We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Sales Coordinator to support the Sales & Marketing Department in managing sales operations, coordinating with field sales teams, monitoring sales performance, preparing reports and ensuring smooth communication between internal departments, stockists and super stockists. The ideal candidate should have good analytical, reporting, coordination and follow-up skills, preferably with experience in the pharmaceutical industry. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 A. Sales Analysis, MIS & Reporting Monitor and review daily sales force reports, including Daily Sales Reports (DSR), Tour Programmes (TP) and M-Reports. Monitor field activity and ensure adherence to prescribed daily call norms: DSR/SO/SSO: Maximum 10 doctor calls and 15 retailer calls. ADR: 25 retailer calls. Ensure timely submission of DSRs by field staff every Monday and Thursday. Collect monthly Tour Programmes by the 25th of every month for the subsequent month. Ensure submission of monthly expense statements by the 27th of every month. Coordinate with ASMs to collect stock and sales statements from all stockists by the 5th of every month and submit the consolidated information to the concerned authority. Prepare and analyse primary and secondary sales reports, including target versus achievement. Generate sales MIS reports based on HQ-wise, region-wise, product-wise, value-wise and month-wise performance. Monitor SKU-wise targets and achievements and follow up with respective HQs on a fortnightly basis. Prepare quarterly region-wise expiry and breakage stock reports. Monitor field coverage systems, route plans, samples distribution plans, annuity stockist status and preferred dealer status. Prepare and circulate incentive scheme reports and related communications for field staff. 
 B. Sales & Operational Coordination Coordinate with field sales personnel and address their day-to-day operational requirements. Coordinate with stockists and super stockists to resolve operational issues and grievances. Coordinate with the Accounts and Distribution Departments for credit note issuance and monthly ledger updates. Monitor branch indents, stock availability at branches and central warehouses, and coordinate order versus dispatch status. Follow up with stockists and super stockists for order placement and outstanding payments. Coordinate with the Distribution Department regarding the receipt and dispatch of orders, promotional materials and samples. Follow up with ASMs and field staff regarding collections, recoveries and remittance status. Monitor annuity contracts and coordinate with respective managers for timely updates and renewals. Follow up with branches and super stockists for outstanding payments and C-Form-related documentation. Coordinate with the Marketing and Field Sales teams to ensure adherence to individual tour programmes and route plans. 
 C. Meetings & Training Coordination Coordinate and arrange monthly sales managers' meetings. Attend monthly management meetings and prepare Minutes of Meetings (MoM). Organise and coordinate training programmes for sales personnel. Prepare monthly objectives and sales activity plans. Follow up on action points discussed during meetings and ensure timely completion. 
 D. Documentation & Management Reporting Prepare and share the status of DSRs, weekly reports, monthly sales reports and expense statements with the respective HODs in the prescribed formats. Maintain accurate records of sales performance, field activities, stockist information and outstanding payments. Prepare consolidated reports and provide timely updates to management regarding sales operations. Ensure proper documentation and timely communication between Sales, Accounts, Distribution and Marketing Departments. 
 Required Skills & Competencies Good knowledge of MIS reporting, Excel and data analysis. Strong coordination and follow-up skills. Good communication and interpersonal skills. Ability to handle multiple activities and meet deadlines. Analytical and problem-solving abilities. Attention to detail and accuracy in reporting. Ability to coordinate effectively with field sales teams and internal departments. 
 Educational Qualification & Experience Graduate in any discipline; preferably B.Com, BBA or equivalent. 05 years of experience in Sales Coordination, Sales Operations or MIS. Experience in the pharmaceutical industry will be preferred. Good working knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint. 
 Interested candidates can share their resume on hrd2@sandu.in

description:
Role Overview NPCI is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Android Developer to lead the design, development, and enhancement of Android-based SDKs and security-focused mobile platform capabilities within its R&D function. This role will be responsible for building robust, scalable, secure, and developer-friendly Android SDK components that support next-generation digital payment, authentication, and mobile ecosystem initiatives. The position requires strong expertise in Android platform internals, SDK architecture, mobile security, cryptographic integrations, secure transaction flows, and enterprise-grade software engineering practices. As a Team Leader, the role also includes technical leadership, mentoring, architecture governance, cross-functional coordination, and ownership of delivery quality across SDK and security workstreams. 
 Key Responsibilities 1) SDK Architecture, Design, and Development Lead the end-to-end design and development of Android SDKs, reusable libraries, APIs, and framework components for payment, authentication, device interaction, and mobile service enablement. Define clean, modular, scalable, and backward-compatible SDK architectures suitable for integration by internal teams, partner banks, fintechs, merchants, OEMs, or ecosystem participants as applicable. Develop developer-friendly SDK interfaces, abstraction layers, and integration models that simplify adoption while maintaining strict performance and security standards. Ensure SDKs are robust across multiple Android OS versions, device types, OEM customizations, and deployment environments. Establish standards for SDK versioning, dependency management, release control, and long-term maintainability. 
 2) Security Engineering and Secure Mobile Development Drive implementation of security-first mobile application and SDK design practices across all Android development work. Design and develop security-sensitive components involving: secure key handling device binding tokenization support encryption/decryption workflows secure storage certificate handling tamper detection runtime integrity checks app hardening techniques secure communication and API protection Integrate Android security capabilities such as: Android Keystore hardware-backed security where available biometric authentication secure device authentication attestation mechanisms permission and sandboxing controls Conduct secure code reviews and enforce remediation of vulnerabilities identified through internal testing or external assessments. Support design and implementation of controls aligned to payment-grade and regulated ecosystem requirements. 
 3) Research & Development Responsibilities Work within the NPCI R&D function to prototype and evaluate emerging mobile technologies relevant to secure payments, digital identity, authentication, embedded financial services, and future Android platform capabilities. Assess new Android OS features, APIs, security models, NFC interactions, device capabilities, and OEM variations for potential use in strategic product or infrastructure initiatives. Translate exploratory concepts into production-ready engineering artifacts, reusable SDK modules, and architectural recommendations. Contribute to technical innovation in areas such as: contactless and NFC-based ecosystems secure mobile transaction flows SDK-based ecosystem enablement trusted execution and integrity validation future-ready authentication and device-side controls 
 4) Team Leadership and Technical Governance Lead a team of Android developers within the R&D setup, providing hands-on technical guidance and delivery oversight. Break down product and research goals into technical work packages, development plans, milestones, and sprint deliverables. Mentor team members on Android architecture, secure development lifecycle practices, coding standards, testing frameworks, and debugging approaches. Review designs, code quality, architecture decisions, and implementation patterns to ensure consistency, security, and maintainability. Drive engineering discipline across documentation, reusable assets, issue tracking, release governance, and technical risk management. Collaborate with product, architecture, backend, security, compliance, QA, and partner teams to align engineering execution with business and ecosystem goals. 
 5) Integration, Performance, and Reliability Ensure developed SDKs and applications meet high standards of: performance memory efficiency startup latency battery optimization reliability under varied network/device conditions Troubleshoot complex production and integration issues across Android devices, OS versions, and partner application environments. Build instrumentation, logging, diagnostics, and observability support into SDKs to facilitate integration and support. Optimize compatibility with enterprise distribution requirements and controlled deployment environments. 
 6) Quality, Compliance, and Documentation Own technical documentation for SDK architecture, public APIs, integration guides, sample applications, security controls, release notes, and troubleshooting references. Ensure adherence to secure SDLC, coding standards, release validation, and quality assurance processes. Partner with internal security and compliance stakeholders to support reviews, audits, certifications, and control validation where required. Define and maintain automated testing approaches including unit tests, instrumentation tests, integration tests, and regression frameworks. 
 Required Qualifications Education Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or related discipline from a recognized institution. 
 Experience 10+ years of overall software development experience with significant hands-on expertise in Android development. Proven experience in Android SDK/library development, not only application-level development. Demonstrated experience in security-focused Android engineering, preferably in regulated, payment, fintech, banking, telecom, identity, or large-scale platform environments. Prior experience leading engineering teams or acting as technical lead/team leader is strongly preferred. 
 Required Technical Skills Android Development Expertise Strong proficiency in Java and Kotlin Deep understanding of: Android SDK Android framework components services, broadcast receivers, content providers app lifecycle and background execution models AIDL/Binder/IPC concepts where relevant multi-module Android architecture Experience building and publishing reusable Android SDKs/AARs/libraries Strong knowledge of Android build systems including Gradle Experience with Android debugging, profiling, and performance tuning tools

 Testing and Quality Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and automation frameworks for Android Experience with secure code review practices and static/dynamic analysis tools Familiarity with defect triage, reliability engineering, and issue root-cause analysis 
 Preferred Skills / Desirable Experience Experience in payments, digital transactions, mobile banking, cardless/payments acceptance, authentication, or regulated transaction ecosystems Exposure to NFC, secure contactless interactions, tokenized transactions, or device-based payment enablement Familiarity with backend/API integration patterns in secure mobile ecosystems Awareness of OEM customizations, device compatibility concerns, and enterprise mobility constraints Experience working in R&D, innovation labs, standards-driven environments, or platform engineering teams Understanding of compliance-oriented development expectations in high-trust transaction systems Exposure to white-box cryptography, attestation, HCE, secure elements, or trusted hardware concepts would be an advantage

title: Senior Data Scientist- Finance & Spend, Data Labs
description:
Job Summary 
 Anyone can build an AI agent. What makes SAP's agents different is accuracy grounded in the richest enterprise data and process context in the world. As a Data and Applied Scientist at SAP, you'll build the context engine grounded in SAP's Business ontology: the semantic infrastructure that transforms raw business data into the knowledge layer powering SAP's AI agents and assistants. What you'll build 
 The semantic and contextual foundation of SAP's AI. While generic AI agents operate on surface-level patterns, SAP agents are accurate because they understand the real semantics of enterprise business master data, process flows, and domain relationships. You'll build and scale the layer that makes that possible. Design and maintain enterprise ontologies and semantic models that give AI agents accurate, grounded understanding of SAP and connected business landscapes harmonizing data from SAP, Salesforce, Workday, ServiceNow, MES/IoT systems, and external providers into unified semantic layers. Build AI capabilities including RAG pipelines, embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge grounding that make SAP's agents accurate and reliable in production. Develop AI capabilities including generative AI and LLM-based solutions using enterprise business data, knowledge graphs, business process intelligence, and other structured and unstructured data assets. Leverage SAP's deep data and process context including SAP data models, metadata structures, and business process semantics across Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, and Plan-to-Produce to ground AI solutions in real enterprise reality. Work with cloud and data platforms including Databricks, SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud, AWS, Azure, and GCP to support reliable, scalable AI workflows. Partner across product, engineering, business, and customer-facing teams to translate ambiguous business challenges into concrete AI solutions from concept through deployment and continuous improvement. Apply machine learning, deep learning, and statistical modeling to develop and evaluate AI solutions using real-world enterprise datasets. 

 What you'll bring 

 Required Qualifications 
 8+ years of experience in knowledge engineering, semantic data systems, applied AI, or data science in industry, research labs, or advanced academic environments. Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field. Hands-on experience designing enterprise ontologies and semantic models; proficiency in at least one graph query language (SPARQL, Cypher, or GQL); understanding of trade-offs between RDF triple stores and property graph databases. Hands-on experience with modern GenAI systems RAG, embeddings, vector databases, semantic retrieval, and enterprise knowledge grounding. Strong Python and SQL skills with production-grade development practices; experience with ML libraries such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or scikit-learn. Proven track record deploying and operating AI/ML solutions in production including handoff, lifecycle support, and continuous improvement. Experience with big data infrastructure and cloud environments Databricks or equivalent, plus at least one major cloud (AWS, Azure, or GCP). Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross-functional in agile environments. 

 Preferred Qualifications 
 Deep working knowledge of SAP data models, metadata structures, and core business processes end-to-end. Hands-on experience with the SAP data and AI platform stack SAP Datasphere, SAP HANA Cloud Knowledge Graph Engine, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP One Domain Model, SAP Graph API, and SAP Business Accelerator Hub. Deep expertise across the W3C stack (OWL, RDF/RDFS, SKOS, SHACL) and/or property graph query languages (Cypher, GQL). Experience on Financial (example - accounting, close, reporting) and Spend (procurement, s2p, contracts) domain knowledge. Deep expertise in machine learning and deep learning, with experience developing, evaluating, and improving models on real-world datasets. Experience with agentic AI, reasoning frameworks, planning, orchestration, tool use, or multi-agent architectures. Experience contributing to reusable AI platforms, foundation model initiatives, or shared AI services adopted across multiple product areas. Ability to design upper-level and mid-level ontologies aligned with industry standards and apply semantic interoperability frameworks across complex application landscapes.

title: Data Engineer MAS Reports
description:
Data Engineer - MAS Reports Work Mode : Remote Experience : 5+ Yrs Location: Banglore/ Pune/ Aemdabad/ Gurgaon/Mumbai 

 Role overview The MAS Reports team owns the settlement and reporting layer of the Merchant Acquiring System (MAS). This batch ETL and reporting platform processes settlement, clearing and fee data, then distributes financial statements to acquirers, partner banks, merchants and internal Finance and Risk teams. This role combines hands-on maintenance and incident resolution with the incremental modernisation of an established, business-critical platform. The successful candidate will be comfortable working across legacy and modern technologies while taking ownership of data accuracy, report delivery and production stability. 
 Technology environment Perl and Shell ETL jobs • cron orchestration • MySQL • SAP BusinessObjects and Crystal Reports • Python • db • Docker • GitHub Actions • Coralogix 
 Key responsibilities Maintain, debug and evolve Perl, Shell and SQL ETL jobs that load settlement, clearing and fee data from the operational MAS database into reporting tables. Develop and maintain SAP Crystal Reports and BusinessObjects reports, including their underlying SQL and data logic. Contribute to the dbt transformation layer, progressively migrating business logic from legacy Perl and SQL scripts into maintainable transformation models. Improve automated testing using pytest, Test::More and coverage tooling, alongside CI/CD controls and production observability. Perform root cause analysis of data discrepancies, reconciliation mismatches and other issues affecting financial and transactional reports. Investigate and resolve production batch incidents, including failed loads, missed SLAs and report-delivery failures, through the formal Change Request process. Participate in the on-call support rota for production batch failures affecting report delivery and downstream stakeholders. Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Finance, Risk and other stakeholders to restore service, communicate impact and prevent recurrence. 
 Required experience and skills Bachelor's or Master's degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, with at least four years of relevant professional experience. Strong SQL and relational data-modelling skills, including the ability to write, troubleshoot and optimise complex queries against MySQL. Solid data-engineering fundamentals, including pipeline design, idempotency, data-quality controls, reconciliation and dependency management. Experience building, testing and operating batch ETL pipelines in production environments. Practical Python development experience. Ability to read and write Perl and Shell, or a demonstrated ability to become productive with them quickly. Experience using Docker for local development and test environments. Hands-on CI/CD and test-automation practice using GitHub Actions or an equivalent platform. Experience with observability platforms such as Coralogix, Datadog or OpenTelemetry. Proven root cause analysis involving financial, payment or other transactional data. Clear written and verbal communication in English. Ability to work effectively in a codebase containing both legacy and modern components, while owning production stability through on-call support and formal Change Request processes. 
 Nice to have Experience with dbt or another data-transformation framework. Experience with SAP BusinessObjects, Crystal Reports or comparable enterprise reporting tools. Additional software development experience in Java, Scala or Go. Exposure to Spark, Kafka, Airflow or comparable distributed-processing and orchestration technologies. Experience with cloud data platforms, such as AWS Redshift or Amazon EMR. Previous involvement in modernising a legacy data platform by introducing automated tests, CI/CD, observability and maintainable transformation patterns. Experience in financial services, payments or another regulated, data-intensive domain. 
 What success looks like Reliable and timely delivery of settlement and financial reports. Faster diagnosis and sustainable resolution of production and data-quality incidents. Improved automated test coverage, deployment controls and operational visibility. Measurable reduction of fragile legacy logic through incremental, well-tested modernisation.

 Job Summary: 
 About the Role 
 Bizmetric is looking for a hands-on Data Architect to design and deliver modern lakehouse and data engineering 
 solutions for our clients, primarily on Azure and Databricks. This is a build-and-lead role: you will own the 
 architecture of client data platforms end-to-end, lead delivery workstreams, set engineering standards for the 
 teams you work with, and act as the technical anchor in client conversations. 
 You will spend most of your time on data engineering and lakehouse architecture, with working ownership of 
 the BI/serving layer and architectural awareness of ML, MLOps, and GenAI so your platforms are ready to 
 support analytics and AI workloads. As a Databricks partner, we also expect you to contribute to pre-sales, build 
 reusable accelerators, and grow the engineers around you. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 1. Data Engineering & Lakehouse Architecture (primary focus) 
 Design and deliver Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold) lakehouse architectures on Azure 
 Databricks using Delta Lake and Unity Catalog.

 Event Hubs, Auto Loader) using PySpark and Spark SQL. 
 Build config-/metadata-driven, reusable ingestion frameworks rather than one-off pipelines.

 Monitor / Log Analytics).

Design the Gold/serving layer to feed Power BI efficiently (star schemas, aggregations, serving tables).

Monitoring, Reliability & Production Support Implement and maintain enterprise monitoring, logging, and observability solutions. Develop operational runbooks and support procedures for critical platforms. Apply Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) principles to improve system availability and reduce operational risk. Ensure compliance with organizational security policies, audit requirements, and regulatory standards. Support disaster recovery, business continuity, and resiliency initiatives. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of experience in DevOps, Infrastructure Engineering, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Operations. Extensive hands-on experience with Jenkins administration, pipeline development, automation, and integration. Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, and container orchestration platforms. Experience supporting Azure or GCP environments. Strong scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar languages. Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as Grafana, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor. Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Multi-cloud experience across Azure and GCP. Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Solutions Architect or related certifications. Experience managing large-scale hybrid cloud transformations. Knowledge of platform engineering and self-service infrastructure models. Experience supporting retail, distribution, supply chain, or large-scale customer-facing platforms. title: Senior Manager- International Logistics operations
description:
Job Overview We are seeking a seasoned, high-caliber logistics leader for the role of Senior Manager – Cross-Border Operations. Based out of our Gurgaon headquarters, you will lead end-to-end international logistics operations for Delhivery, overseeing cross-border import and export shipments across key global trade lanes. This is a strategic and execution-intensive role. You will spearhead the expansion of our international freight network by launching new country corridors and deferred air economy products, while driving revenue growth through strategic partnerships. This position owns P&L, SLA compliance, and operational efficiency for both air and ocean freight verticals. Key Responsibilities 1. End-to-End International Logistics Operations Lead end-to-end international logistics operations, managing and optimizing cross-border import and export shipments across global trade lanes. Supervise daily workflows for inbound and outbound cargo, ensuring smooth execution across origin handling, international linehaul, customs clearance, and last-mile delivery. Implement robust monitoring systems to track shipments, proactively resolve operational exceptions, and ensure high on-time delivery rates. 2. Network Expansion & Product Development Spearhead the physical and operational expansion of Delhivery's international freight network by identifying and launching new country corridors. Design, launch, and scale deferred air economy products to offer competitive, cost-effective cross-border shipping options to e-commerce, SME, and enterprise clients. Establish standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational readiness criteria for all newly launched corridors and lanes. 3. Strategic Partnerships & Carrier Management Identify, negotiate with, and onboard key global partners, including freight forwarders, customs house agents (CHAs), customs brokers, and commercial airlines/ocean carriers. Build and maintain strong strategic alliances to secure capacity commitments, preferential rate structures, and reliable transit times during peak and non-peak seasons. Manage partner performance SLAs, conducting regular reviews to ensure compliance with Delhivery's high operational standards. 4. P&L & SLA Compliance Management Take complete financial ownership of the Air and Ocean freight verticals, managing P&L, cost optimization, and overall unit economics (e.g., cost-per-kilogram and route margins). Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) such as Transit Turnaround Time (TAT), On-Time Delivery (OTD), Customs Clearance timelines, and first-contact dispute resolution. Control and minimize operational exceptions such as terminal storage costs, demurrage, detention fees, and flight offloads. 5. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Tech Enablement Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders including Sales, Business Development, Technology, and Legal/Compliance to support business growth and process standardization. Partner with Product and Engineering teams to build scalable, automated, and technology-driven processes for tracking, billing, and customs documentation. Ensure 100% adherence to international trade laws, customs regulations, aviation security standards, and safety compliances. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience & Education Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, International Business, Engineering, or a related field. An MBA or Post-Graduate degree is highly preferred. Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in international logistics, freight forwarding, or cross-border e-commerce shipping. Leadership: Minimum of 3+ years in a senior supervisory or managerial role directly overseeing air/ocean freight operations, partner management, or international linehaul. Core Competencies Domain Expertise: Deep working knowledge of air/ocean freight operations, global trade lanes, Incoterms 2020, customs clearance regulations, and HAWB/MAWB rules (aligned with our Global Air Freight Operations). Commercial & Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing P&L, negotiating complex commercial contracts, and optimizing unit economics. Analytical Rigor: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets for tracking operations, data analysis, and building performance dashboards. Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Exceptional negotiation and relationship-building skills to manage high-level partnerships across multiple geographies. Problem-Solving: Strong critical-thinking and crisis-management abilities to handle transit disruptions, customs bottlenecks, and capacity constraints in a high-pressure environment.

description:
Travel & Expense Analyst - VOIS 
 Who we are 
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture 
 About this Role 
We are seeking a Travel & Expense Analyst to join our Source to Pay function in Ahmedabad. This role is responsible for managing travel and expense operations, ensuring accurate and timely processing of financial transactions, maintaining compliance with company policies, and supporting continuous process improvement initiatives. The successful candidate will bring experience in travel and expense management, strong analytical capabilities, and hands-on knowledge of SAP, Concur, and MIS reporting tools. This position offers the opportunity to collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders, contribute to operational excellence, and support a high-quality employee and supplier experience. 
 What you will do 
 Manage the end-to-end travel and expense process, including resolution of stuck expense claims and ensuring compliance with company policies and procedures. Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of travel and expense policies aligned with legal and regulatory requirements. Collaborate with internal teams to identify opportunities for process optimisation, operational efficiency, and cost savings. Build and maintain effective working relationships with key vendors and service providers to ensure high-quality service delivery. Analyse travel and expense data to identify trends, provide insights, and recommend improvements. Maintain accrual records and prepare regular management reports on travel and expense activities. Provide guidance, training, and user support to employees on Concur processes and functionality. Respond to supplier and business queries in a timely and professional manner. Contribute to audit readiness and support successful completion of internal and external audits. Deliver assigned activities in line with defined productivity, quality, and accuracy standards. Who you are 
 Bachelors degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related discipline. Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in travel and expense management. Experience working with SAP, Concur, and MIS reporting tools. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting-related systems. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment. Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams and stakeholder groups. Capable of working independently while contributing positively within a team environment. Proactive, customer-focused, and results-oriented approach to work. Strong organisational skills and willingness to learn and adapt to new challenges. Commitment to company policies, procedures, values, and professional standards. 
 Not a Perfect Fit? 
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best. 
 Whats in it for you 
 Opportunity to work within a global shared services organisation supporting international stakeholders. Exposure to end-to-end travel and expense operations within the Source to Pay function. Experience contributing to process improvement and cost optimisation initiatives. Opportunity to collaborate with cross-functional teams, business partners, and suppliers. Exposure to audit support activities, compliance requirements, and operational reporting. A collaborative environment that supports continuous learning and professional development. What skills you will learn 
 Advanced Travel & Expense operations and governance. End-to-end expense management using Concur. SAP-based transaction processing and reporting. MIS reporting, data analysis, and business insight generation. Stakeholder management and supplier engagement skills. Process improvement and operational excellence methodologies. Audit support, compliance monitoring, and control management. Financial reporting and accrual management.

You lead a team and guide exploration and implementation of new methodologies, model building techniques, and cutting-edge algorithms. You remain at the forefront and drive innovation by applying these techniques to new business problems, use cases, and scenarios.
